jobs.title: Executive Assistant & Project Coordinator
jobs.description:
Description:### **Position Overview**


The Executive Assistant \& Project Coordinator is a key support role for the President and the broader organization. This position is ideal for someone who naturally takes ownership, follows through, stays organized, and enjoys figuring out what needs to happen next.


You will manage and follow up on the President’s priorities, coordinate smaller projects and business initiatives, communicate with employees and outside partners, and provide administrative and occasional personal\-assistant support.


The successful candidate will not simply wait for the next task. They will **anticipate needs, keep projects moving, identify potential problems, follow up consistently, and close the loop on outstanding items.**


This is a hands\-on position in a fast\-paced environment where priorities can change quickly. The ability to move comfortably between executive support, project coordination, administrative work, and special assignments is essential.

### **What You'll Do**

#### **Executive Support \& Task Management**

* Manage and maintain a centralized list of the President’s priorities, assignments, commitments, and pending decisions.
* Turn conversations, meetings, emails, and verbal direction into clear action items and deadlines.
* Follow up with employees, vendors, clients, contractors, and other contacts to ensure commitments are completed.
* Keep the President informed of progress, upcoming deadlines, outstanding items, and issues requiring attention.
* Resolve routine matters independently whenever possible.
* Help protect the President’s time by organizing information and bringing forward solutions rather than simply identifying problems.
* Anticipate scheduling, administrative, and logistical needs.

#### **Project Coordination**

* Coordinate smaller projects, business initiatives, facility matters, acquisitions, and special assignments.
* Maintain project timelines, task lists, budgets, purchases, deliverables, and supporting documentation.
* Coordinate with employees, vendors, clients, contractors, and service providers.
* Request and organize quotes and assist with comparing options and coordinating approvals.
* Schedule meetings, deliveries, installations, service appointments, inspections, and other project activities.
* Track estimates, invoices, receipts, purchases, and change requests.
* Identify delays, risks, and unresolved issues and recommend appropriate next steps.
* Follow projects through completion and ensure closeout items and records are organized.

#### **Administrative Support to the President**

* Manage calendar appointments, meetings, reminders, and scheduling priorities.
* Prepare correspondence, reports, spreadsheets, presentations, and meeting materials.
* Organize files, records, communications, and reference materials.
* Prepare for meetings by gathering information, confirming logistics, and documenting follow\-up items.
* Draft and coordinate routine communications on behalf of the President.
* Assist with travel arrangements, reservations, itineraries, and related logistics.
* Handle confidential company, employee, financial, client, and personal information with discretion.

#### **Personal Assistant Support**

* Assist with occasional personal appointments, reservations, purchases, errands, and administrative tasks.
* Help coordinate personal and professional commitments.
* Research products, services, vendors, events, and other requested matters and present organized options.
* Maintain a high level of professionalism and discretion when handling personal or confidential information.

#### **General Administration \& Special Projects**

* Support company\-wide administrative initiatives and special projects.
* Maintain organized electronic and physical records.
* Assist with data entry, document preparation, filing, and other administrative tasks as needed.
* Provide administrative support to other departments when directed by the President.
* Take on additional responsibilities as the company’s needs evolve.


Requirements:### **What We're Looking For**

* **Proactive:** You see what needs to be done and take action without waiting to be reminded.
* **Highly organized:** You can manage multiple projects, deadlines, conversations, and priorities without losing track of details.
* **Accountable:** When you take ownership of something, you follow it through to completion.
* **Resourceful:** You are comfortable researching answers, finding solutions, and figuring things out.
* **A strong communicator:** You communicate clearly, professionally, and consistently.
* **Detail\-oriented:** You catch missing information, deadlines, discrepancies, and potential problems.
* **Discreet:** You understand the importance of confidentiality when working with executive, financial, employee, client, and personal information.
* **Adaptable:** You can shift priorities and remain composed when the day does not go according to plan.
* **Solutions\-oriented:** You don't just bring problems forward — you think through possible solutions and next steps.

### **Qualifications**

* 2\+ years of experience in executive assistance, administrative support, project coordination, office management, or a related role.
* Strong organizational and time\-management skills.
* Demonstrated ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Strong follow\-through and ability to work independently.
* Strong research, documentation, and problem\-solving abilities.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office, Google Workspace, calendars, task\-management platforms, and standard business software.
* Ability to learn new software and systems quickly.
* Valid driver’s license and reliable transportation for occasional company\-related errands, appointments, or project needs.

### **Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience supporting an owner, President, CEO, or other senior executive.

**Commercial Construction Asst. Project Manager/Coordinator**  

**Project Controls and Field Coordination**  

Benefits: Health insurance • Vision insurance • Dental insurance • 401(k) matching • Company car  

**Be the Person Who Connects the Field, Project Manager, and Leadership**
=========================================================================


At BF Construction Inc., successful projects happen because the team is looking ahead, asking the right questions, following through on commitments, and keeping the field and office aligned.  

We are looking for an Assistant Project Manager with commercial construction experience who wants to continue growing toward a Project Manager role.  

  

  

This position works directly with Project Managers, Superintendents, Field Leads, subcontractors, vendors, and Leadership to support active commercial construction projects from preconstruction through closeout.  

  

  

The ideal candidate understands construction, is highly organized and detail\-oriented, follows through consistently, and takes ownership of execution.  

**WHAT YOU’LL DO**
==================



  

Project Controls and Scheduling  

* Help maintain and drive active project schedules and the company Master Schedule


* Build and maintain one\- and two\-week lookaheads


* Coordinate upcoming work with Project Managers, Superintendents/Field Leads, subcontractors, and vendors


* Identify schedule conflicts, missing information, delays, and sequencing risks


* Confirm completed work and update schedules when field conditions or decisions change



  

Subcontractor, Vendor, and Procurement Coordination  

* Coordinate subcontractors, vendors, manpower, material deliveries, equipment, inspections, access, and logistics


* Track procurement and long\-lead materials


* Follow open commitments through completion and flag missing or unconfirmed dates before they affect production



  

Field Coordination  

* Review field progress, Daily Project Updates, SiteCam photos, and project documentation


* Confirm reported progress aligns with actual field conditions


* Identify incomplete work, missing information, and coordination issues


* Maintain constant communication with Field Leads, including, but not limited to performing weekly project planning meetings



  

Project Documentation and Follow\-Through  

* Review drawings, specifications, Bluebeam markups, RFIs, and submittals


* Track RFIs, submittals, procurement items, change\-order follow\-up, and project action items


* Maintain accurate project records and communicate updates clearly


* Follow assigned actions through completion with detail, consistency, and accountability


**WHAT THIS ROLE IS NOT**
=========================


* This is not a purely administrative support role. The APM is expected to understand the project, stay organized, and actively support planning and execution.


* This is not simply maintaining schedules and project documents. This role requires close attention to detail, accurate follow\-through, and consistent execution from one step to the next.


* This is not a position that waits for the Project Manager or Leadership to identify every issue. The APM should recognize risks, missing information, and upcoming needs early and help drive them through resolution.


**WHAT YOU BRING**
==================


* 3\+ years of commercial construction experience


* Experience as a Project Engineer, Assistant Project Manager, Construction Project Coordinator, or similar construction role


* Ability to read and understand construction plans, specifications, and project documents


* Working knowledge of commercial construction sequencing and project workflow


* Experience with schedules, subcontractors, procurement, RFIs, submittals, and field coordination


* Strong attention to detail with consistent follow\-through and execution


* Ability to manage multiple priorities without losing accuracy or missing commitments


* Clear communication, strong organization, and a problem\-solving mindset


* Desire to grow into a commercial construction Project Manager


**PREFERRED EXPERIENCE**
========================


* Commercial tenant improvements, renovations, site work, exterior and/or ground\-up construction


* Smartsheet or comparable scheduling software


* Bluebeam and Procore or comparable construction\-management software


* Microsoft 365, Slack, Dropbox, and field\-documentation systems such as SiteCam


**WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE**
===========================


* Project schedules and documentation remain accurate and current


* Upcoming subcontractors, materials, inspections, and project needs are identified early


* Field progress is accurately reflected in the project plan


* Risks, missing information, and open items are communicated before they affect the schedule


* Commitments and action items are followed through consistently


* Project Managers and Superintendents can rely on the APM for accurate, detailed execution


**HARD REQUIREMENT**
====================


Candidates must have direct commercial construction experience and a working understanding of project schedules, subcontractor coordination, procurement, field conditions, and construction documentation.  

This role is designed for someone who already has a construction foundation and is ready to take on greater project\-management responsibility.  

**CAREER PATH**
===============


**Assistant Project Manager**  **Project Manager**  **Senior Project Manager**  

BF Construction is committed to developing people who want to build a long\-term career in construction project management. You will work directly with experienced Project Managers, Superintendents, Field Leads, and Leadership while learning BF Construction’s systems, processes, and standards.

jobs.title: Program Coordinator
jobs.description:
**About AADAP, Inc.**

The Asian American Drug Abuse Program (AADAP) is a 501(c)(3\) non\-profit organization dedicated to serving Asian Pacific Islanders and other underserved communities with substance abuse services throughout Los Angeles County. Programs and services are provided to all individuals regardless of race or ethnicity.

**Department Overview**

Youth \& Family Programs (YFP) provides AADAP’s Gang Reduction and Youth Development (GRYD) Prevention services. The program works with youth, families, community partners, and public agencies to support prevention, family case management, youth development, and community education activities.

**Position Summary**

The GRYD Program Coordinator supports the day\-to\-day operations and coordination of AADAP’s GRYD Prevention program. This position provides direct supervision and support to program staff, coordinates service delivery, monitors program performance and documentation, and helps ensure contractual and program requirements are met.

The Program Coordinator also serves as a liaison with the GRYD Office, LAPD, intervention partners, community organizations, and other stakeholders. The ideal candidate is an organized and collaborative supervisor who can support staff, manage competing priorities, and build strong relationships with youth, families, and community partners.

**Essential Job Functions \& Responsibilities**

**Program Coordination \& Service Delivery**

* Coordinate day\-to\-day GRYD program activities and ensure services align with program goals and objectives.
* Monitor program activities and action steps to support timely and effective implementation.
* Guide staff through GRYD implementation and program services.
* Coordinate and support GRYD Prevention and Family Case Management services.
* Support youth development activities, community education campaigns, and other program activities.
* Monitor the quality and quantity of services and take appropriate action to help ensure contract requirements and program goals are met.
* Participate in meetings and trainings relevant to the program’s target population and geographic area.

**Staff Supervision \& Development**

* Supervise Primary and Secondary level program staff, including regular check\-ins, performance monitoring, coaching, and support.
* Assess staff training and development needs and coordinate required GRYD and agency training.
* Conduct annual performance evaluations consistent with agency policy.
* Provide training, technical assistance, and consultation to GRYD and support staff.
* Support the recruitment and hiring of line staff, including candidate screening, interviewing, and hiring recommendations.

**Program Administration \& Compliance**

* Monitor and review GRYD case files and ETO data entry for completeness and accuracy.
* Prepare and submit required reports and billing documentation.
* Monitor GRYD case management performance and other program benchmarks.
* Monitor program expenditures in coordination with program leadership.
* Assist the Director with contract\-related activities, proposal writing, and fund\-seeking efforts.
* Perform duties of the Unit Director in their absence, as assigned.

**Community \& Partner Engagement**

* Develop and maintain collaborative relationships with the GRYD Office, LAPD, intervention partners, schools, community organizations, and other stakeholders.
* Serve as a liaison between AADAP services, GRYD programs, and outside services and programs.
* Represent AADAP and the program at community meetings, events, and partner activities.
* Support community outreach, youth development activities, and community education efforts.

**Minimum Qualifications**

* Six (6\) years of college education in a related field or equivalent work experience related to the field.
* At least two (2\) years of supervision experience.

**Nice to Have**

* Bilingual or bicultural proficiency in Arabic, Armenian, Cantonese, Farsi, Urdu, Khmer (Cambodian), Korean, Mandarin, Russian, Spanish, Tagalog, Vietnamese, or another language reflective of the communities served.
* Familiarity with the program target area and surrounding community.

**Knowledge, Skills \& Abilities**

* Demonstrated knowledge and skills in computer operations.
* Strong leadership and staff supervision skills.
* Strong organizational, planning, and time\-management skills.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities, documentation requirements, and deadlines.
* Strong verbal and written communication skills.
* Ability to establish and maintain effective working relationships with supervisors, coworkers, youth, families, community organizations, partner agencies, and the general public.
* Ability to provide constructive feedback, coaching, and support to staff.
* Ability to work effectively and respectfully with people of diverse cultural, educational, social, and economic backgrounds.
* Professional, dependable, collaborative, and tactful approach to working with others.
* Ability to work effectively with individuals from diverse cultural, educational, social, and economic backgrounds.

**Special Requirements**

* Employment contingent upon successful background check clearance.
* Proof of work eligibility required upon hire.
* Valid California Driver’s License, minimum automobile insurance, and access to a reliable motor vehicle.
* Ability to work a flexible schedule, including some evenings and weekends.

**Work Schedule, Travel \& Physical Demands**

* **Schedule:** Full\-time, 40 hours per week; requires flexibility for some evening and weekend program activities.
* **Travel:** Local travel is required for program activities, meetings, community events, and partner engagement.

jobs.title: Part-time Mentoring and Literacy Program Coordinator
jobs.description:
**Program Coordinator**

**Read Aloud Mentoring Program (RAMP)** 

**Serving Vine Street Elementary, Los Angeles, CA 90038**

**Location:** Vine Street Elementary School, 955 Vine Street, Los Angeles, CA 90038

**Schedule and Hours:** Up to 5 days a week, Monday through Friday. Hours will vary between approximately 10:45 am and 12:45 pm from September through June. Training and onboarding for the position will begin upon hire in August. Some availability is required outside of these times for data entry, communications, and meetings as needed. Up to 10 hours per week.

**Position Overview**

Do you believe every child deserves a caring mentor and the opportunity to fall in love with reading? Join Read to a Child as a Program Coordinator, where you'll play a vital role in bringing our Read Aloud Mentoring Program (RAMP) to life. By coordinating volunteers, partnering with schools, and supporting meaningful mentor\-student relationships, you'll help elementary students build confidence, improve literacy skills, and experience the power of reading.

Our Read Aloud Mentoring Program (RAMP) pairs volunteer mentors with Kindergarten through 4th grade students for a fun and rewarding weekly read\-aloud session during the school day. As the Program Coordinator, you'll be the heart of the program at your assigned school, ensuring every mentor, student, and school partner enjoys a positive, well\-organized, and impactful experience.

In this role, you'll coordinate the day\-to\-day operations of the program, build strong relationships with volunteers and school staff, manage scheduling and program records, and help create an environment where students can thrive.

**The current open Program Coordinator role is an on\-site position working in schools directly with students. Successful candidates must be comfortable working in an in\-school environment and in keeping with all safety protocols required by the school, as well as be comfortable/confident working with technology.**

This role is extremely important to the program’s function and success and will be an integral part of a fun and collaborative team! Our Program Coordinators are truly the face of our program and make a real difference in the lives of our students every year.

If you're organized, people\-focused, and passionate about making a difference in your community, we'd love to hear from you!

**Specific Job Responsibilities Will Include All or Some of the Following (will vary by Region \& School/Site)**

1\. Program Operations \& Coordination

* Ensure smooth program start\-up, including school partnership logistics (relationships, space, scheduling, absences, referrals, permissions, matching pairs)
* Facilitate and monitor reading sessions, which may be in\-person and/or virtual, to ensure smooth operation of program
* If coordinating on\-site, ensure hygiene/safety guidelines are followed and rooms are left clean and orderly
* Provide volunteers with book ideas; maintain an organized and inviting book cart (on\-site programs only)
* Facilitate other activities or tasks as requested (e.g., supporting other schools)

2\. Communication \& Relationship Management

* Communicate regularly with supervisor
* Communicate with volunteer mentors: provide program updates, notify of student absences, and share schedule changes
* Notify students, teachers, and potentially parents/guardians of volunteer mentor cancellations or schedule changes
* Provide ongoing support and guidance to volunteer mentors, including general and case\-specific advice (with supervisor input)

3\. Data Management \& Administrative Tasks

* Document reading session attendance and participant information changes in the database
* Collect mid\-year and year\-end surveys/assessments from mentors, students, and teachers
* Submit timesheets accurately and on time

4\. Volunteer Engagement \& Support

* Support volunteer recruitment efforts
* Assist students in making thank\-you cards for mentors
* Plan and implement year\-end celebration (as applicable)

5\. Training \& Professional Development

* Attend required Program Coordinator training sessions and meetings
* Participate in performance evaluation and goal\-setting process
* Interested Program Coordinators may be able to take on some Program Assistant roles (virtually or in person) at other schools

**Essential Job Duties For In\-Person Positions** This person working in this position will be in a school setting. It involves constant movement throughout the building and designated session areas, guiding students to their reading session. Depending on the school, this may require occasionally ascending/descending stairs. It also requires frequent positioning of books and/or program materials of various weights and sizes on a rolling book cart, as well as rolling the book cart to/from various locations within the school.

**Key Qualifications**

* Commitment to Read to a Child’s mission, viability and growth
* Experience working with young children
* Enthusiastic about children’s books, willingness to become familiar with the Read to a Child book collection
* Preferred \- Experience managing volunteers
* Communicates well in person, virtually, on the telephone \& via email
* Commitment to actively and continuously working toward achieving the organization’s Diversity, Equity and Inclusion goals
* Extremely organized and adept at successfully managing multiple projects simultaneously and prioritizing according to the organization’s strategic plan \-\- with flexibility and a positive attitude
* Comfortable working with and hosting group video conference platforms (eg: Zoom and/or Google Meets)
* Proficiency working with various technological platforms: E\-mail, Google Drive, word processing, spreadsheets, E\-book sources, and some data entry
* Access to transportation

***NOTE: Your application will not be considered without a cover letter.***

*Read to a Child is committed to providing resources to children most impacted

jobs.title: SOCIAL MEDIA + PR ACCOUNT COORDINATOR / JR. ACCOUNT MANAGER / ACCOUNT MANAGER
jobs.description:
RAGDOLL PR is looking for a creative, highly organized \+ social media\-savvy **Account Coordinator or Jr. Account Manager** (maybe even Account Manager) to join our growing team and work across our fashion, beauty, wellness, health \+ lifestyle clients.

This role is ideal for someone who **lives and breathes social media**, has a strong eye for content \+ branding, understands what performs across IG and TikTok, and also has experience within PR, influencer relations and/or brand communications.

A major part of this position will be **managing social media accounts for multiple RAGDOLL PR clients**, so we are specifically looking for someone who has hands\-on experience managing brand accounts and creating content. Candidates must be able to provide examples of social accounts they have managed as well as content they have personally created.

This is not strictly a social media position. The role will also support influencer collaborations, creator outreach, media relations \+ general PR account work depending on client needs.

RAGDOLL PR is a full\-service PR agency based in Manhattan Beach (Los Angeles), specializing in media relations, influencer \+ creator collaborations, celebrity/VIP PR and social media management.

This is a **full\-time hybrid position**, with three days per week in our Manhattan Beach office \+ two days WFH. We are looking for someone who wants to build a long\-term career with RAGDOLL PR and grow within the company.

**ROLE \+ RESPONSIBILITIES**

**Social Media \+ Content**

* Manage multiple client social media accounts, primarily IG with some TikTok support
* Develop monthly social media strategies \+ content calendars tailored to each client's brand, audience \+ goals
* Plan, create, schedule \+ publish engaging social content including Reels, Stories, carousels, static posts \+ short\-form video
* Write social copy \+ captions that reflect each client's individual brand voice
* Concept \+ create original content and identify opportunities using existing client assets
* Edit short\-form video/Reels and create graphics using Canva \+ other relevant editing tools
* Stay extremely current on social media trends, trending audio, platform updates, emerging creators \+ cultural moments
* Identify trends quickly and determine how they can be adapted appropriately for different client brands
* Manage daily community engagement, including comments, DMs \+ proactive engagement
* Monitor account performance \+ analytics and make recommendations based on what is/isn't working
* Participate in content shoots \+ help develop shot lists, concepts \+ creative direction when needed
* Maintain a strong visual eye and ensure client feeds/content remain cohesive \+ on\-brand
* Manage multiple client accounts simultaneously while keeping calendars, approvals \+ deliverables organized

**Influencer \+ PR**

* Identify, research \+ conduct outreach to relevant influencers \+ creators
* Manage influencer collaborations from outreach through execution, deliverables \+ reporting
* Coordinate organic gifting/seeding \+ product send\-outs
* Build \+ maintain relationships with influencers, creators \+ relevant industry contacts
* Support media relations, including research, media list building, pitching \+ follow\-up
* Assist with press releases, pitches, media alerts \+ other client\-facing materials
* Contribute creative ideas to client brainstorms, campaigns \+ PR/social strategies
* Participate in client calls and communicate directly with clients as appropriate
* Prepare weekly/monthly client updates, reports, recaps \+ trackers
* Support day\-to\-day account management across multiple fashion, beauty, wellness, health \+ lifestyle brands

**QUALIFICATIONS**

* 1–3\+ years of relevant experience in social media, PR, influencer marketing, communications or a related field
* **Hands\-on experience managing social media accounts for brands is required**
* **Must provide examples of social media accounts you have managed \+ content you personally created**
* Strong understanding of IG, TikTok, Reels, Stories \+ short\-form video
* Strong content creation \+ video editing skills
* Excellent eye for branding, aesthetics, photography \+ visual storytelling
* Strong copywriting skills with the ability to adapt to multiple brand voices
* Deep understanding of current social trends, creators, pop culture \+ digital content
* Experience with influencer outreach, gifting, collaborations \+ creator relationship management
* PR/media relations experience strongly preferred
* Experience within fashion, beauty, wellness, health and/or lifestyle strongly preferred
* Proficient in Canva; experience with CapCut and/or similar editing platforms strongly preferred
* Experience with Cision, MuckRack, Influencer Intelligence or similar platforms is a plus
* Extremely organized \+ detail\-oriented with the ability to manage multiple clients, deadlines \+ priorities simultaneously
* Proactive, resourceful \+ comfortable taking ownership of projects
* Strong written \+ verbal communication skills
* Positive attitude \+ ability to thrive in a fast\-paced agency environment
* Bachelor's degree in PR, communications, marketing, journalism or a related field preferred
* Must have reliable transportation and be able to work in our Manhattan Beach office three days per week

Pay: $45,000\.00 \- $65,000\.00 per year

Benefits:

* Dental insurance

**Executive Administrative Assistant \& Sales Coordinator**

**L. Johnson Construction, Inc. – Gardena, CA**  
**Full\-Time \| On\-Site \| $30\.00 per hour**

This is not an entry\-level administrative position. The role is primarily executive and administrative support, with an additional sales coordination component involving lead research and follow\-up.

The Owner is involved in L. Johnson Construction as well as three additional family\-owned business entities. This position will provide administrative support across those business interests and will also assist with occasional personal business during normal working hours.

* Comfortable receiving direct feedback and adapting to an executive's individual work and communication preferences.

**Preferred Qualifications**

About Hollywood Park  

  

Hollywood Park is a premier, nearly 300\-acre global sports and entertainment destination in Inglewood, California. Owned, operated, and being developed by Los Angeles Rams Owner/Chairman E. Stanley Kroenke, it stands as the largest urban mixed\-use development currently under construction in the Western United States. The vibrant "city within a city" features sophisticated residences, a dynamic outdoor retail and lifestyle district, creative office spaces, public parks, and a scenic lake. Anchored by the world\-class SoFi Stadium and YouTube Theater, with Hollywood Park Studios and a luxury boutique hotel forthcoming, the district creates the ultimate Live, Work, Play environment.
  

Home to the Los Angeles Chargers and Super Bowl LVI Champion Los Angeles Rams, the 3\.1 million\-square\-foot SoFi Stadium is the NFL’s largest venue, and the first indoor\-outdoor stadium. It seats approximately 70,000, expandable to 100,000, with more than 260 luxury suites and over 13,000 premium seats. A proven global leader that consistently ranks among the world’s top venues in ticket sales, the stadium has already hosted iconic events like eight FIFA World Cup 2026 matches, Super Bowl LVI, the 2023 College Football National Championship, WrestleMania 39, the CONCACAF Gold Cup Final, and numerous record\-breaking concerts. SoFi Stadium is set to host the Super Bowl LXI in 2027, the Olympic and Paralympic Opening Ceremonies for the 2028 Olympic and Paralympic Games (LA28\), along with being converted into the largest Olympic swimming venue in history.
Adjacent to the stadium and under the same sweeping translucent roof canopy sits the 2\.5\-acre open\-air American Airlines Plaza and the 6,000\-seat YouTube Theater. As an intimate, state\-of\-the\-art venue, YouTube Theater hosts a diverse line\-up of chart\-topping superstars, iconic comedy acts, awards shows, esports competitions, community gatherings, and corporate conferences. Named the “Top West Coast Club or Theater” by Billboard, YouTube Theater is a must\-play destination.

Hollywood Park is being brought to life by a deeply experienced team of creative forward\-thinkers. The project is a celebration of all that Los Angeles has to offer. We are inspired by our diverse Inglewood community as a place for the community to be, to see and to connect.
Hollywood Park is committed to building and maintaining a workplace that celebrates the diversity of our team members, allowing them to bring their authentic selves to work every day.

* **Resolve with Respect** – treat others with empathy, patience, and kindness
* **Safety Always** – maintain a safe and secure environment

**Air / Ocean Operations Coordinator**

**Location:** Los Angeles / Chicago**Employment Type:** Full\-Time**Department:** Operations

**Position Overview**

This role is designed for candidates who want to gain **hands\-on, end\-to\-end experience in international logistics**, rather than performing repetitive or limited system\-based tasks.

As an **Air / Ocean Operations Coordinator**, you will be directly involved in the full shipment life cycle — from booking and transportation to arrival, customs coordination, and final delivery. This position provides a strong foundation for long\-term growth in logistics operations, cost control, and cross\-functional coordination.

**Key Responsibilities1\. Customer \& Shipment Execution**

Communicate with customers to receive and confirm shipment requirements for air and ocean freight

Assist in developing practical and executable transportation plans based on customer needs and operational constraints

Monitor shipments from origin to final delivery, ensuring accuracy, timeliness, and clear communication

**2\. Air \& Ocean Freight Operations**

Coordinate bookings, flight schedules, vessel schedules, and space confirmations

Liaise with airlines, shipping lines, and overseas agents to ensure smooth execution of transportation plans

Track shipment status and provide timely updates through internal systems and direct customer communication

**3\. Arrival, Customs \& Delivery Coordination**

Work closely with customs, warehouse, and trucking teams to coordinate post\-arrival operations

Ensure smooth handoff between customs clearance, cargo release, and final delivery

Support the handling of inspections, documentation requests, delays, and other operational issues

**4\. Exception \& Issue Management**

Identify and follow up on operational exceptions such as delays, documentation discrepancies, or execution errors

Assist in analyzing root causes and coordinating solutions with internal and external partners

Gradually build the ability to handle more complex cases independently as experience grows

**5\. Cost \& Billing Support**

Assist with reviewing AR/AP charges related to shipments

Ensure billing accuracy and alignment with operational records

Develop an understanding of logistics cost structures to support future career advancement

**Qualifications**

Strong interest in international logistics, supply chain, or freight forwarding

Detail\-oriented, responsible, and capable of managing multiple shipments simultaneously

Effective communication skills and ability to coordinate across teams and external partners

jobs.title: Logistics Coordinator
jobs.description:
**About the Opportunity**

A leading aerospace metals manufacturer is seeking a **Logistics Coordinator** to support shipping, inventory, and warehouse operations. This role works closely with the Logistics Supervisor and Logistics Manager to ensure customer orders are processed accurately and shipped on time.

This is an excellent opportunity for someone with experience in manufacturing, aerospace, metals, forging, warehousing, shipping, or inventory control who enjoys a fast\-paced environment and takes pride in accuracy, organization, and customer service.

**Key ResponsibilitiesShipping \& Logistics Coordination**

* Create and process delivery orders to support customer requirements and shipment schedules
* Review inventory, sales orders, and customer portals to ensure on\-time deliveries
* Schedule domestic and international shipments
* Generate pick lists and shipping documentation
* Coordinate with certification teams to ensure proper shipment release
* Process bills of lading, shipping labels, ASNs, and export documentation
* Maintain accurate shipment records for audit compliance
* Coordinate pickups with freight carriers and transportation providers
* Process freight invoices and related shipping paperwork

**Inventory Management**

* Monitor inventory levels and maintain min/max stock requirements
* Review customer consignment inventory and internal stocking levels
* Track aging inventory and communicate recommendations to management
* Perform cycle count administration and inventory reconciliation
* Update ERP transactions and maintain inventory accuracy records

**Quality \& Customer Support**

* Assist with customer returns and discrepancy investigations
* Support resolution of quality\-related concerns
* Communicate with customers regarding shipment status and delivery issues
* Escalate concerns and work with internal teams to ensure customer satisfaction

**Reporting \& Metrics**

* Prepare reports on:
* Inventory levels
* Shipping performance
* On\-time delivery
* Lead times
* Quality performance
* Warehouse metrics

**General Office \& Administrative Support**

* Handle incoming calls and direct inquiries appropriately
* Process incoming and outgoing mail and courier services
* Coordinate office supply purchasing
* Support facility and vendor communication as needed
* Assist with budget tracking and administrative reporting

**Additional Responsibilities**

* Train and support Logistics Clerks
* Participate in internal ISO audits when required
* Request maintenance and repairs for equipment as needed
* Support safety, quality, environmental, and operational initiatives

**Qualifications Required**

* Minimum 1 year of logistics, shipping, inventory, warehouse, or supply chain experience in a manufacturing environment
* Experience with ERP systems and shipping transactions
* Strong organizational and communication skills
* Ability to work in a team\-oriented production environment
* Must be able to pass a background check and drug screen
* Must comply with ITAR and EAR requirements

**Preferred**

* Experience in aerospace, metals, forging, machining, or industrial manufacturing
* Knowledge of international shipping, export documentation, customs, or freight coordination
* Experience with cycle counting and inventory control

**We're looking for someone who:**

* Has experience in manufacturing logistics or shipping within a manufacturing
* Understands inventory control and ERP transactions
* Is highly organized and detail\-oriented
* Thrives in a fast\-paced production environment
* Takes ownership of safety, quality, and on\-time delivery performance
* Wants an opportunity that has strong potential to become a long\-term role

**Apply today to join a stable aerospace manufacturer supporting critical aerospace and defense programs.**

Pay: Up to $30\.00 per hour

Expected hours: 40\.0 per week

Benefits:

* Health insurance

Experience:

* Logistics Coordinating: 2 years (Required)
* Inventory management: 2 years (Required)

Ability to Commute:

* Paramount, CA 90723 (Required)

Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Event Operations Manager
jobs.description:
**Event Operations Manager**

**Location:** California (LA/San Diego) (Regional travel required)

**Contract:** Weekly / Event\-Based. Average 16\-30 hrs per week.

**Rate of Pay:** $28 per hour

**About XL Event Lab**

XL Event Lab is an international live events company producing a portfolio of successful

touring entertainment experiences across multiple markets.

As we continue to expand across North America, we're looking for an Event Operations

Manager to help deliver exceptional live events throughout California (LA/San Diego).

**The Role**

Reporting to the Head of Regional Development – Live Events, you'll take responsibility

for the operational delivery of our events once venues have been secured. From planning

and preparation through to the final guest leaving the venue, you'll ensure every event is

delivered safely, professionally and to an exceptional standard.

This is a practical, hands\-on role. You'll lead Event Crew, transport equipment, liaise with

venues, solve problems as they arise and ensure every event delivers a first\-class guest

experience.

If you enjoy leading people, thrive in fast\-paced environments and aren't afraid to roll up your sleeves, we'd love to hear from you.

***What You'll Be Doing***

**Event Delivery**

* Lead the operational delivery of live events across your region.
* Act as the operational lead on event day.
* Ensure events run safely, efficiently and on schedule.
* Resolve operational issues quickly and professionally.

**Venue Operations**

* Take ownership of venue operations following contract confirmation.
* Liaise directly with venue staff before and during each event.
* Ensure all operational requirements are in place ahead of every event.

**Team Leadership**

* Schedule Event Crew for upcoming events.
* Lead pre\-event briefings and provide direction throughout each event.
* Foster a positive, professional team environment.

**Equipment \& Logistics**

* Transport event equipment to and from venues using a U\-Haul vehicle.
* Manage event setup and pack\-down.
* Maintain equipment and monitor inventory levels.

**Guest Experience**

* Deliver an outstanding customer experience from arrival through to departure.
* Handle guest queries and resolve issues professionally.
* Represent XL Event Lab and our event brands to the highest standard.

**About You**

You'll be organised, dependable and comfortable taking responsibility for live events.

Previous experience in live events would be advantageous, but we'd also welcome

candidates from hospitality, visitor attractions, theatres, tourism or similar customer\-facing

environments.

Most importantly, you'll enjoy working as part of a team, take pride in delivering exceptional

experiences and remain calm under pressure.

**Working Pattern**

This role is centered around our live event schedule.

Most work takes place on Fridays and Saturdays, with occasional Thursday and Sunday

events depending on the tour schedule. Hours will average between 16\-30 each week.

Regular travel throughout California is required, with overnight stays only occasionally

necessary.

**Why Join XL Event Lab?**

* Join an established international live events company.
* Play a key role in delivering memorable live experiences.
* Work in a varied, hands\-on role where no two event days are the same.
* Become part of a growing business with ambitious plans across North America.

Pay: $28\.00 per hour

Work Location: On the road

jobs.title: Sales Account Manager – U.S. West
jobs.description:
**Company Overview**



Founded in 2004, Applied Biological Materials (abm) Inc. is a global leader in cell biology and cell engineering, leveraging advanced technologies and model systems including CRISPR gene editing, iPSC technologies, and advanced cell models to support groundbreaking discoveries in Life Sciences and Drug Development. Our headquarters in Vancouver, Canada, spans over 30,000 sq. ft. of state\-of\-the\-art wet lab and office space, serving as a hub for advanced R\&D and global logistics. Based in Canada, abm operates internationally with locations in the United States, China, and France, serving academic, biotechnology, pharmaceutical, CRO, government, and research customers worldwide.

 **About the Role**



As part of our continued expansion in the United States, abm is looking for a **Sales Account Manager** to manage and grow our **U.S. West Territory**, with a West Coast base location preferred. This role is responsible for managing and expanding existing customer accounts and developing new relationships across academic, biotech, pharma, CRO, government, and research institutions.



You will act as a key point of contact for customers in the region, identifying needs, proposing tailored solutions, and driving business growth. The ideal candidate will bring both sales expertise and a strong understanding of the life sciences sector, with a proactive, customer\-first mindset. Experience selling **cell lines, cell\-based products, or related life science research products** is strongly preferred.

 **Key Responsibilities:**


* Manage and expand customer accounts across the U.S. West Territory, including key life science hubs and academic, biotech, pharma, CRO, government, and research institutions
* Identify new business opportunities and drive revenue growth
* Build long\-term relationships with researchers, laboratory leaders, procurement contacts, and other key decision\-makers and influencers.
* Conduct regular customer meetings, both virtually and in person, to understand research needs and identify opportunities for abm products and services.
* Develop territory and account plans, prioritize high\-potential customers, and maintain a healthy sales pipeline.
* Identify customer needs and work with internal technical and product teams to recommend appropriate solutions.
* Meet or exceed assigned revenue targets, sales KPIs, and territory growth objectives.
* Maintain accurate and timely customer, opportunity, pipeline, forecast, and activity information in the CRM system.
* Collaborate closely with Technical Support, Marketing, Customer Service, Operations, and other internal teams to provide a strong customer experience.
* Represent abm at regional conferences, trade shows, scientific meetings, and other customer\-facing events.
* Monitor market trends, customer needs, and competitor activity and provide feedback to support commercial strategy.
* Travel regularly within the assigned territory for customer meetings, conferences, and events, with occasional travel to other abm locations as required.

  


**Qualifications:**


* Bachelor's degree in Life Sciences, Biotechnology, or a related discipline; an advanced degree is an asset.
* Minimum **2 years of experience in business development, account management, or technical sales within the life sciences or biotechnology sector**.
* Strong understanding of the U.S. life science research, biotechnology, and pharmaceutical markets.
* Experience selling **cell lines, primary cells, cell\-based products, research reagents, or related life science products** is strongly preferred.
* Experience managing customers within the Western U.S. and/or an established customer network in the region is an asset.
* Demonstrated ability to develop customer relationships, identify sales opportunities, and grow revenue.
* Strong interpersonal, presentation, negotiation, and communication skills.
* Self\-motivated and organized, with the ability to independently manage a geographic territory and competing priorities.
* Comfortable working in a dynamic, growth\-oriented environment.
* Proficiency with CRM systems and Microsoft Office.
* Willing and able to travel regularly throughout the assigned territory.

  


**Work Location**


* This is a **remote position**, with **California preferred**

  


**Employment Type**


* Full\-time, one\-year fixed\-term employment to start, with the expectation of conversion to permanent employment based on first\-year performance

  


**Compensation \& Benefits**


* **Base Salary: Annual USD $90,000 – $105,000**, commensurate with relevant experience and qualifications
* **Eligible for a performance\-based sales incentive plan**
* Paid time off and company holidays

  


* *We thank all applicants for interest in abm and the role. Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.*

S/he will manage a high volume of existing clients worth over $7M in revenue by communicating product/services updates, identifying product and client training gaps, ensure the delivery of quality customer and technical services, and resolve attrition issues to renew the client’s business. Account Managers are expected to drive continued market and competitive learning through research and customer outreach, as well as report findings to the team at regular intervals to maintain strong and ever\-evolving market knowledge among entire team.

 **Responsibilities:**

* Drive revenue through minimizing customer attrition and increasing sales to account base.
* Meet and exceed assigned quota targets.
* Quote and sell software and services to existing customer accounts.
* Manage contract renewals for an assigned book of business.
* Develop and maintain a business consultant relationship with client decision\-makers in higher revenue accounts.
* Analyze client business for new opportunities, suggesting relevant products and services, and presenting market\-specific content valuable to client growth.
* Build relationships with contacts across the organization to drive retention and mitigate attrition risk, primarily through regular, proactive contact.
* Relay market knowledge and client expertise to influence internal stakeholders with the intent of securing ACTIVE’s position in the market.
* Improve customer satisfaction and reduce attrition.
* Identify root causes of client “pain points” and issues.
* Liaise between teams to facilitate resolution of technical issues.
* Early identification of at\-risk clients and escalate potential risks or challenges to manager.
* Handle messaging and objection handling with clients regarding technical issues.

 **Requirements:**

* 3\-5 years’ experience in a previous Account Management or Customer Success position preferred
* Bachelor's Degree
* Proven experience and success in SaaS based market, preferable in a software sales setting
* Advanced communication (oral and written), objection\-handling, and conflict management skills
* Ability to leverage technology tools to fuel organization, efficiency, and productivity; advanced use of Microsoft Outlook, Excel, PowerPoint, and Word preferred
* Experience with using Salesforce.com is a plus
* Skilled in public speaking; can confidently create and deliver presentations to both client and internal audiences
* Ability to adapt and respond quickly to change
* Demonstrated ability to prioritize and multi\-task in a deadline\-driven environment
* Demonstrated ability to work independently and make sound decisions under the position guidelines with little direct supervision

About the Role

***Kurv*** is a trusted payment processor headquartered in Cleveland, Ohio, with locations across the country. As a leading provider, Kurv offers merchant services, credit card processing, mobile and contactless payment solutions (including Tap\-to\-Pay and QR payments), and eCommerce payment gateways for SMBs, delivering robust solutions that simplify and expedite how businesses accept payments.


We're looking for a Social Media Manager to own the day\-to\-day content, community, and performance of our social channels across two distinct B2B brands. * Plan 30\-day content calendars across Reddit, TikTok, LinkedIn, Facebook, Instagram, and X

* Partner with internal and external teams to create and amplify assets and campaigns

* Track KPIs (impressions, engagement, CTR) to continuously improve campaigns

* Deliver monthly performance recaps with wins, learnings, and recommendations
* Community Engagement
* Monitor DMs and comments; partner with the Communications Manager on responses, when applicable
* Liaise with the communications team to amplify PR, thought leadership, and customer loyalty content

* This is a high\-trust, high\-visibility seat. You'll be in constant communication with the Director of Brand and Creative and the CMO circulating insights and strategy, not just checking in on a schedule. You'll do well here if you:

**Qualifications**

* 4\-6 years of experience managing social media for a brand, agency, or in\-house marketing team

jobs.title: Client Experience Coordinator
jobs.description:
**Position Summary**

The Client Experience Coordinator (CEC) manages the client experience from the time an order has been released and acknowledged through installation, project completion, and closeout.

This role combines project coordination with proactive client communication. The CEC keeps clients informed, coordinates installation scheduling, prepares projects for installation, manages post\-installation issues and service items, and ensures consistent communication through final completion.

**Our objective:** Clients should always understand where their project stands, what happens next, and who to contact.

**Key Responsibilities:**

**Client Introduction \& Communication**

* Receive new projects from the Project Readiness Coordinator and review the complete project file before contacting the client.
* Introduce yourself as the client's primary Project Coordinator and establish expectations regarding communication and next steps.
* Maintain proactive communication throughout the remainder of the project and respond promptly and professionally to client questions.
* Personally communicate delays, changes, problems, or other exceptions rather than relying solely on automated communication.
* Document meaningful client communication within the CRM/ERP.
* Production \& Project Tracking
* Review manufacturer acknowledgements and anticipated product availability.
* Monitor project and product status and identify potential delays or issues that may impact installation.
* Keep clients informed of meaningful changes and coordinate internally with Project Managers and Operations when issues require attention.

**Installation Coordination**

* Coordinate installation timing based on product availability and operational capacity; schedule and confirm installation dates with clients.
* Create and complete installer packets and confirm required project and installation documentation is available.
* Verify projects are administratively prepared for installation and ensure clients receive appropriate pre\-installation instructions.
* Confirm upcoming installations and manage scheduling changes when necessary.

**Installation Support**

* Monitor project status during installation and coordinate with the Project Manager regarding installation progress.
* Receive documentation of missing parts, damage, service requirements, or incomplete work.
* Communicate promptly with clients when an installation is not First Time Complete (FTC) and establish clear expectations regarding next steps.

**Service \& Outstanding Items**

* Order required replacement parts or materials and track outstanding parts through receipt.
* Maintain accurate service and outstanding\-item records and coordinate return visits and service appointments.
* Keep clients proactively updated while outstanding items are being resolved.
* Work with Project Management and Operations to drive projects to final completion.

**Project Completion \& Closeout**

* Confirm completion with the client and conduct a post\-installation follow\-up call and/or email.
* Confirm client satisfaction and identify unresolved concerns.
* Coordinate final payment as part of project closeout and confirm all outstanding work has been completed.
* Request a client review when appropriate, complete all required closeout documentation, and formally close completed projects.

**CRM \& Automated Communication:**

The CEC is responsible for ensuring the CRM is used effectively to support the client experience. Automated communication may include production/project updates, installation confirmations and reminders, pre\-installation instructions, and appointment reminders.

Automation should supplement, not to replace personal communication. When a project falls outside the normal process, the CEC is responsible for personally communicating with the client.

**Skills \& Qualifications**

* Excellent verbal and written communication skills with strong customer service and relationship\-management ability.
* Highly organized, detail\-oriented, and accountable, with strong follow\-through.
* Ability to manage multiple active projects, competing priorities, and deadlines simultaneously.
* Comfortable communicating difficult news, project delays, and changing expectations professionally.
* Strong problem\-solving, conflict\-resolution, and cross\-functional coordination skills.
* Comfortable working within CRM, ERP, scheduling, and project\-management systems.
* Ability to maintain composure and professionalism when managing escalated client situations.
* Experience in construction, home improvement, windows and doors, or another project\-based client service environment preferred.

Pay: $25\.00 per hour

Expected hours: 40\.0 per week

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* Dental insurance
* Health insurance
* Life insurance
* Paid time off
* Vision insurance

**Location:** On\-Site — Santa Ana, CA (this is not a hybrid or remote role)

**About Us**  

Shameless Snacks makes low\-sugar gummy candy that tastes like the real thing. Every bag has 3g of sugar, is packed with fiber, and is vegan and gluten\-free. Our lineup of sour and fruit gummies (worms, bears, peach rings, Cherry Bomb, Green Apple Blast, and more) is sold on Amazon, DTC, and at major retailers across the country.


Shameless is part of eJam, a bootstrapped consumer products company that has built, scaled, and exited multiple brands without taking a dollar of outside capital. That means you get the focus of a single brand with the resources and playbook of a team that has taken products from zero to eight figures more than once. Small team, no bureaucracy, massive ownership.


If you want to learn how a food brand actually gets built, from flavor development and co\-manufacturing to packaging, labeling, and landing on retail shelves, there's no faster education than this.

**The Role**  

We're looking for a Product Development Coordinator to drive new product development for Shameless Snacks. This is a hands\-on role at the center of our innovation pipeline. You'll:

* Research new flavor, format, and line\-extension opportunities, and evaluate the better\-for\-you candy category and competitive landscape
* Coordinate with our manufacturers and ingredient suppliers, including overseas partners, on formulation, samples, and production timelines
* Manage sample rounds and taste testing, tracking feedback on flavor, texture, and shelf stability
* Own packaging development with our design team, including nutrition panels, claims, and label approvals
* Track every project timeline from idea to production\-ready, and present progress to leadership weekly


You'll be the person who takes a new Shameless product from concept to launch\-ready, working directly with the CEO and across our marketing, marketplace, and retail teams from day one.

**What You'll Do Everyday**


Research New Product Opportunities

* Use tools like Helium 10, Jungle Scout, and similar platforms to identify high\-potential SKUs and category opportunities across Amazon, DTC, and retail
* Conduct competitive research — pricing, features, positioning, packaging, reviews, and gaps in the market

Manage the Product Development Pipeline

* Own the product pipeline in ClickUp — Kanban boards, project lists, status updates, and timelines across all active SKUs
* Track all active development projects and keep deliverables on schedule
* Surface blockers early, flag slippage before it becomes a fire, and keep cross\-functional teams aligned
* Own the accuracy of project documentation — if it’s in the system, it’s correct and current


Coordinate with Manufacturers \& Vendors

* Manage the RFQ process: solicit quotes, organize vendor responses, maintain comparison documents
* Coordinate sample shipments, evaluate quality, and manage the feedback loop with manufacturers
* Track compliance documentation and product testing requirements
* Maintain vendor communication logs and track progress across SKUs


Drive Packaging \& Design

* Work with the design team on packaging concepts, dielines, and creative assets
* Manage the design approval process — route concepts through stakeholders, collect feedback, push to final approval
* Coordinate with printers and packaging vendors on specs, proofs, and production timelines


Present to Leadership Weekly

* Prepare and deliver a weekly product development presentation to management
* Make sure decision\-makers have what they need to make calls — not scrambling for data in the room
* Cover project status, milestones hit, blockers, timeline changes, and key decisions needed
* Distribute meeting notes, action items, and follow\-ups — everyone knows what they owe and when


Be the Communication Hub

* Follow up relentlessly — you are the person who makes sure things get done

  

**Requirements** **OU'RE A FIT IF**

* You have 2–4 years of experience in product development, sourcing, or product coordination in consumer products, CPG, eCommerce, or DTC

**BONUS POINTS (NOT REQUIRED)**

The International Distributor Account Manager owns the day\-to\-day commercial relationship with the distributor partners who represent OluKai, Melin, and Roark outside our directly operated markets. These distributors represent our brands in their local markets (i.e. Japan, LATAM, Australia, New Zealand, South Korea, etc).

You will be the commercial and operational center of gravity for an assigned book of distributor accounts: building and defending the seasonal forecast, driving prebook and at\-once order flow, tracking sell\-in against sell\-thru, and holding partners to brand standards in every market where they carry our labels.

  

We are looking for someone equally comfortable in a line presentation and in a pivot table, who can hold a partner accountable to a number without damaging the relationship, and who understands that in a distributor model your partner’s inventory position is your problem too.

**Forecasting and Planning**


* Build and maintain rolling seasonal forecasts by distributor, brand, and category, and reconcile them to the annual plan
* Partner with Planning and Production on demand signals, buy quantities, and inventory positioning for the International channel
* Track sell\-in against sell\-thru by partner, and flag risk to plan early with a recommended course of action rather than a report of the problem

  


**Commercial Performance**


* Own revenue, margin, and order fill targets for the assigned book of business

* Demonstrated ownership of a revenue book with personal accountability for forecast accuracy and delivery to plan
* Working command of the wholesale seasonal calendar and how prebook, at\-once, sell\-in, and sell\-thru each move the order book

jobs.description:
**Evening Kitchen Operations CoordinatorPosition Summary**

The Kitchen Operations Coordinator supports the day\-to\-day production and fulfillment operations of the company’s kitchen, which produces in\-house food products for two retail store locations and specialty catering. This is not a chef or cooking position.

The primary focus of the role is coordinating purchase orders from the retail stores, supporting the kitchen production team, ensuring products are properly labeled and packaged, maintaining quality and accuracy standards, and helping ensure completed products are ready for timely delivery to each store.

The Kitchen Operations Coordinator serves as an important link between the retail stores and kitchen production team, helping ensure that orders are accurately communicated, produced, packaged, labeled, and delivered according to company standards.

**Essential Duties and Responsibilities**

* Receive, review, and organize purchase orders and product requests from the company’s retail store locations to prepare for delivery.
* Communicate production needs and priorities to the kitchen production team.
* Track orders through the production process and help ensure products are completed accurately and on schedule.
* Coordinate the preparation of completed products for distribution to retail locations.
* Accurately label finished food products in accordance with company procedures and applicable labeling requirements.
* Verify product labels for accuracy, including product identification, dates, quantities, and other required information.
* Perform quality\-control checks on finished products, packaging, labeling, and order quantities before products leave the kitchen.
* Package and prepare products for delivery or retail distribution as needed.
* Compare completed orders against purchase orders to identify and resolve discrepancies.
* Maintain organized records related to orders, production, labeling, and fulfillment as required.
* Communicate shortages, production issues, quality concerns, or order discrepancies to appropriate management.
* Help maintain an organized and efficient production and fulfillment workflow.
* Coordinate with retail store employees regarding order status, changes, shortages, or other fulfillment needs.
* Transport products, supplies, or other company materials between the kitchen and retail locations as needed.
* Safely operate a company vehicle or authorized vehicle when driving is required.
* Follow company food\-safety, sanitation, quality\-control, workplace\-safety, and operational procedures.
* Maintain clean and organized packaging, labeling, storage, and work areas.
* Assist with inventory counts, supply organization, receiving, and other kitchen operations activities as needed.
* Provide hands\-on operational support to the kitchen production team as needed, excluding duties requiring a chef or specialized culinary role.
* Receive incoming deliveries.
* Perform other related duties as assigned based on operational needs.

**Qualifications**

* Previous experience in food production, manufacturing, fulfillment, retail operations, inventory, warehouse operations, or a similar environment preferred.
* Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.
* Ability to accurately quality control purchase orders, labels, quantities, and product information.
* Ability to prioritize multiple orders and communicate effectively with both kitchen and retail teams.
* Dependable and able to work independently while also functioning effectively as part of a team.
* Comfortable working in a fast\-paced food\-production environment.
* Basic computer, email, and data\-entry skills.
* Ability to follow established food\-safety, quality\-control, and operational procedures.
* Valid driver's license and acceptable driving record required as driving is an essential function of the position.
* Bi\-lingual, English/Spanish is required.

**Physical Requirements**

The physical requirements described below are representative of those necessary to successfully perform the essential functions of the position, with or without reasonable accommodation.

* Regularly stand and walk for extended periods.
* Frequently use hands for labeling, packaging, handling products, and performing other operational tasks.
* Regularly reach, bend, stoop, and move throughout kitchen, storage, and production areas.
* Lift, carry, push, and/or move products, boxes, supplies, and equipment weighing up to 50 pounds.
* Work in and around a commercial food\-production environment, which may include exposure to hot and cold temperatures, refrigeration areas, food products, cleaning products, and production equipment.
* Safely enter and exit a vehicle and load or unload products when performing delivery duties.

**Work Environment**

This position primarily works within a commercial kitchen/food\-production environment and regularly interacts with kitchen production employees, retail store personnel, and management. The position may also involve periodic driving between company locations and performing duties at retail locations.

**Classification**

**FLSA Status:** Non\-Exempt, Full\-Time. 3:30pm\-12:00am \- 5 days/week (Sundays required)**Reports To:** Kitchen Operations Manager

It is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities, or qualifications. Duties and responsibilities may be modified based on business and operational needs. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable qualified individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of the position.*

**PROGRAM DESCRIPTION:**

The Health and Wellness Division supports Contra Costa County residents aged 60 and older by offering companionship, education, and access to key services. Programs include friendly visits or phone check\-in calls, exercise classes, nutrition education, and CalAIM Community Health Worker (CHW) services. Its mission is to enrich the well\-being of older adults by fostering connection, providing essential resources, and encouraging active, healthy living.

**SCOPE OF WORK:**

The CalAIM Program Specialist is responsible for coordinating and tracking the day\-to\-day administrative and operational workflows that support the successful delivery, documentation of Friendly Programs, and claims processing of CalAIM Community Health Worker (CHW) services.

This position serves as a key point of coordination between the Friendly Services and CalAIM teams. The specialist ensures that referrals, eligibility verification, authorizations, claims, reporting, and client transitions and discharges are completed accurately, promptly, and in compliance with program requirements.

In addition to completing assigned tasks, the specialist is responsible for maintaining accurate data entry, preparing monthly GetCare reports, actively monitoring workflows, following up on outstanding issues, documenting actions taken, and ensuring all items are resolved and closed. Success in this role requires strong organization, attention to detail, and consistent follow\-through to ensure that no critical task falls through the cracks. This position is a 40\-hour\-per\-week position and reports to the Health \& Wellness Senior Manager.

**DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:**

* Manage MCP (Managed Care Plans) referrals, track status, and follow up on missing information to ensure timely service initiation.
* Verify eligibility and maintain accurate service documentation to support compliance and billing requirements.
* Coordinate billing activities, reconcile claims and payments, and address denials, discrepancies, and related issues.
* Prepare, review, and submit MCPreports and compliance documentation, ensuring data accuracy and timeliness.
* Track clinical approvals, client transitions, and discharges to ensure complete and compliant documentation.
* Identify and resolve data, authorization, claims, and reporting issues that impact program operations.
* Maintain tracking systems and work queues, ensuring timely follow\-up, documentation, and closure of all assigned tasks.
* Evaluate clients’ needs and make referrals using agency programs and community resources as needed.
* Participate in first client visits for the Friendly Visitors program in Walnut Creek and Concord areas.
* Manage Special Project as needed

**QUALIFICATIONS:**

* 2\+ years of experience in healthcare administration, care coordination, managed care, billing, or healthcare operations.
* Experience with CalAIM, CHW, Medi\-Cal, MCPs, claims, eligibility, or healthcare reporting preferred.
* Strong organizational, analytical, problem\-solving, and communication skills.
* Ability to manage multiple deadlines and priorities with a high level of accuracy.
* Ability to work independently and collaborate effectively with internal and external stakeholders.
* Knowledge of healthcare privacy and regulatory requirements.
* Ability to collaborate effectively across departments and with external partners while managing multiple priorities.

* Bilingual in English and Spanish preferred.
* Valid California driver’s license, proof of insurance, reliable transportation, and smartphone required.
* Must pass a background check.

You will be part of a collaborative team responsible for creating elevated imagery to showcase our new and signature products. As part of Williams\-Sonoma, Inc., a leader in home lifestyle and retail, The Sample Coordinator is part of a Photo Team that drives customer engagement and profitability through compelling visual storytelling.  

**About the Role**

In this role, you will be responsible for organizing, transporting, and staging merchandise, props, surfaces, grip, crafty, and other supplies necessary to efficiently execute each shoot. You will be relied on by the Producer for any updates regarding product issues, supply shortages, equipment and truck maintenance, etc. We are seeking someone who is a self\-starter, detail\-oriented, and able to work independently and proactively to constantly support all facets of our photo teams while maintaining a can\-do attitude.


**Duties \+ Responsibilities:**

* Work with Producers daily to review what’s needed to execute photoshoots including — ordering and organizing merchandise and props, prepping surfaces, equipment, and crafty items.
* Understand the sample ordering/returning process to help organize and track merchandise before and after photoshoots.
* Unpack and carefully re\-pack photo samples safely for transit between photo teams, WS buildings, locations, and the warehouse.
* Unpack, check in, and test (if applicable) product before each shoot.
  

Save/organize paperwork/empty boxes, alert Producers of any issues with product, and note quantity received on sample tracker.
* Ensure all merchandise and props are returned with proper labeling and wrapping, alerting any issues immediately to the shoot’s Producer.
* Maintain, organize and update/document: prop cage, surfaces, sample inventory kept in studios, and studio crafty.
* Needs to be in Richmond location by 8:00am start time daily.
* Help construct and maintain various set and surface rigs on\-set.
* Assemble furniture pieces for photoshoot.
* Remain attentive and proactive to anticipate the needs of the photo crew on set.
* Drive 15’ and 20’ truck, and sprinter van (both require no special license).
* Vehicle upkeep: keep clean, keep insurance binders on hand, park in designated area at studio and notify Producers when they need maintenance.
* Travel occasionally with photo teams for photoshoot on location.
* Unload and reload trucks with merchandise.
Maintain a professional and respectful demeanor with the photo team, merchants, vendors, and homeowners.  
* 

**Required Competencies:**

* Ownership attitude – you’re happy to jump up to help anyone, finding samples quickly and rapidly change out sets, thinking on the spot for quick yet effective solutions in high pressure time constraints.
* Great time management skills – you’re able to work quickly while maintaining safety, prioritizing tasks, pivoting when necessary and staying calm under pressure.
* Extremely organized and thorough – you’re able to stage samples thoughtfully, troubleshooting samples for anything missing, broken, or defective and alerting Producers immediately.
* Anticipate needs – you’re always two steps ahead, listening so you can foresee and resolve issues early.
* Maintain an “all hands\-on deck” mentality to jump in to help where needed.
Sense of urgency when the task calls for it.  
* 

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* 2\-4 years of related experience working as production assistant on photoshoot sets
* A high school diploma required
* Experience and ability to drive large trucks
* Must have a valid driver’s license \& satisfactory driving record
* Willing to complete a driver training program and participate in DMV’s employer pull notice program
* Must be able to lift and move merchandise up to 75 pounds
* Understanding of proper lifting techniques
* Strong interpersonal and communication skills
* Detail\-oriented and self\-motivated
* Working knowledge of Microsoft Office Suite
Ability to work in office and perform in corporate environment  
* 

**Physical Requirements:**

* Ability to lift up to 75 pounds
  

This is a very physically demanding role, and you will be expected to lift heavy items daily
* Ability to sit and stand for prolonged periods of time
* Ability to type on computer
* Ability to talk and text on a cell phone
Ability to work in office and perform in corporate environment  
* 
**Our Culture \& Values**

We believe that taking care of our people is vital to our success and we strive to offer equitable and transparent practices for all. We prioritize connection, growth, and wellbeing. Our associates are encouraged to bring their authentic selves to work, so they can be their best and achieve their personal and professional goals. We make inclusivity a cornerstone of our culture by welcoming associates with diverse cultures and backgrounds and celebrating them, together. We nurture an open, inclusive environment for all. Our differences—whatever they may be—are valued, explored, and appreciated. Together, we’re creating a more just and inclusive company culture where the only criteria for advancement are:


* The quality of our work
* The contributions we make to our teams and the business
Our ability to lead and connect  
* 

We firmly believe that working in a culture focused on diversity, equity, and inclusion (DEI) spurs innovation, creates healthy and high\-performing teams, and delivers superior customer experiences. Outside of WSI, we recognize the importance of playing a part in our communities through partnerships, collaborations, and commitments to a more just and inclusive world.
