jobs.description:
#### **About Our Company**


WeBox is the leading intelligent marketplace delivering personalized group orders.  

WeBox is driven by three core principles: customers first, value the strivers, and build with partners.

  

### **Our Mission and Vision**


WeBox strives to deliver personalized group orders, ensuring that every group member enjoys the happiness of delivery.By 2032, we will achieve $1 billion in revenue by leveraging technology to become a leading provider of intelligent and sustainable solutions for group orders.


### **Job Summary**


WeBox, the leading intelligent marketplace for personalized group orders, is seeking a proactive and resourceful Logistics Operations Coordinator to join our team. This role ensures seamless delivery operations, focusing on customer satisfaction, operational excellence, and efficiency. We're looking for someone flexible and tech\-savvy who thrives in a fast\-paced environment, manages last\-minute changes, and embodies our values of transparency, resilience, and accountability.


### **Core Responsibilities**


* **Route \& Process Optimization**: Provide support for route planning and identify key improvements to streamline delivery and sorting processes.
* **Driver \& Partner Support**: Train and assist drivers with our Driver App, troubleshoot and install printers, and provide vehicle management.
* **Corporate \& Onsite Support**: Offer on\-site assistance for corporate clients, support daily operations, and uphold food safety and quality standards.
* **Inventory \& Audits**: Conduct inventory management and daily audits, track materials, and support kitchen and equipment maintenance.
* **Team Development**: Assist with recruiting and training for sorting and driver workforce.
* **Quality Assurance**: Maintain and ensure compliance with quality standards and on\-time delivery (OTD).
* **Additional Tasks**: Perform other responsibilities as assigned to support operational needs.


### **Requirements**


* **Experience**: 2–3 years of delivery platform experience.
* **Professional Skills**: Team\-oriented, responsive, organized, with excellent customer\-facing and communication abilities.
* **Technical Skills**: Proficient in Google Workspace and project management tools.
* **Personality**: Professional, punctual, with an upbeat attitude and continuous improvement mindset.
* **Organization**: Detail\-oriented and consistent in reviewing work before delivery.
* **Language**: Fluent in English; Spanish is a plus.
* **With restaurant supervisor experience is a plus.**


### **Equal Opportunity Employer**


WeBox is an equal\-opportunity employer committed to hiring based on merit, competence, performance, and business needs. We do not discriminate based on race, color, religion, marital status, age, national origin, ancestry, physical or mental disability, medical condition, pregnancy, genetic information, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, veteran status, or any other status protected under federal, state, or local law.

If you meet the requirements and are interested in this position, please submit your application.

jobs.title: Event Operations Manager
jobs.location: San Francisco Bay Area, CA, US
jobs.description:
**Event Operations Manager**

**Location:** California (Bay Area/San Jose) (Regional travel required)

**Contract:** Weekly / Event\-Based. Average 16\-30 hrs per week.

**Rate of Pay:** $28 per hour

**About XL Event Lab**

XL Event Lab is an international live events company producing a portfolio of successful

touring entertainment experiences across multiple markets.

As we continue to expand across North America, we're looking for an Event Operations

Manager to help deliver exceptional live events throughout California (Bay Area/San Jose).

**The Role**

Reporting to the Head of Regional Development – Live Events, you'll take responsibility

for the operational delivery of our events once venues have been secured. From planning

and preparation through to the final guest leaving the venue, you'll ensure every event is

delivered safely, professionally and to an exceptional standard.

This is a practical, hands\-on role. You'll lead Event Crew, transport equipment, liaise with

venues, solve problems as they arise and ensure every event delivers a first\-class guest

experience.

If you enjoy leading people, thrive in fast\-paced environments and aren't afraid to roll up your sleeves, we'd love to hear from you.

***What You'll Be Doing***

**Event Delivery**

* Lead the operational delivery of live events across your region.
* Act as the operational lead on event day.
* Ensure events run safely, efficiently and on schedule.
* Resolve operational issues quickly and professionally.

**Venue Operations**

* Take ownership of venue operations following contract confirmation.
* Liaise directly with venue staff before and during each event.
* Ensure all operational requirements are in place ahead of every event.

**Team Leadership**

* Schedule Event Crew for upcoming events.
* Lead pre\-event briefings and provide direction throughout each event.
* Foster a positive, professional team environment.

**Equipment \& Logistics**

* Transport event equipment to and from venues using a U\-Haul vehicle.
* Manage event setup and pack\-down.
* Maintain equipment and monitor inventory levels.

**Guest Experience**

* Deliver an outstanding customer experience from arrival through to departure.
* Handle guest queries and resolve issues professionally.
* Represent XL Event Lab and our event brands to the highest standard.

**About You**

You'll be organised, dependable and comfortable taking responsibility for live events.

Previous experience in live events would be advantageous, but we'd also welcome

candidates from hospitality, visitor attractions, theatres, tourism or similar customer\-facing

environments.

Most importantly, you'll enjoy working as part of a team, take pride in delivering exceptional

experiences and remain calm under pressure.

**Working Pattern**

This role is centered around our live event schedule.

Most work takes place on Fridays and Saturdays, with occasional Thursday and Sunday

events depending on the tour schedule. Hours will average between 16\-30 each week.

Regular travel throughout California is required, with overnight stays only occasionally

necessary.

**Why Join XL Event Lab?**

* Join an established international live events company.
* Play a key role in delivering memorable live experiences.
* Work in a varied, hands\-on role where no two event days are the same.
* Become part of a growing business with ambitious plans across North America.

Pay: $28\.00 per hour

Work Location: On the road

jobs.description:
**About the Team**
------------------



Our mission is to promote growth in local economies by building connections with businesses across the nation and expanding access to the DoorDash platform. The DoorDash for Business Account Management (Post\-Sales) Team is focused on expanding revenue and deepening strategic partnerships across our managed customer base through cross\-sell, upsell, product adoption, and new use\-case development. While customer health and retention remain foundational, this is a growth\-focused team accountable for delivering incremental revenue.



Account Management is a fantastic stomping ground for employees to build both hard and soft skills, develop their relationship management and consultative sales skills, deploy strategic thinking to solve complex customer problems, and work collaboratively across functions as the conduit between customers' greatest needs and the solutions we can build to address them.

------------------



Account Managers are responsible for the strategic vision, growth, and optimization of programs for our largest corporate customers in North America. They retain and grow customer relationships and revenue across national markets, introducing new products and features while partnering cross\-functionally with S\&O, Analytics, and Product to unlock incremental business value and drive the DoorDash for Business business forward.


**You're excited about this opportunity because you will…**
-----------------------------------------------------------


* Own a growth\-focused book of business and consistently deliver against quarterly revenue and expansion quotas through cross\-sell, upsell, product adoption, and new use\-case development.
* Engage our largest and most complex customers in growth strategy conversations, identifying and executing new product opportunities that broaden partnership depth and increase revenue streams.
* Build and execute strategic account plans that prioritize expansion opportunities, accelerate adoption, and drive measurable revenue growth across your book of business.
* Maintain a strong understanding of account\-management fundamentals, including protecting against churn, resolving customer issues, and ensuring clients and DoorDash have an aligned financial picture.
* Be comfortable organizing and presenting quarterly business reviews, marshaling the right teammates and resources to achieve growth objectives and desired customer outcomes.
* Show a strong bias to action and attention to detail to ensure customer needs are prioritized and resolved in a timely manner.

**We're excited about you because you…**
----------------------------------------


* Have 6\+ years of experience managing complex enterprise clients, ideally in a quota\-carrying account management, customer growth, or consultative sales role.
* Have a demonstrated track record of achieving revenue, expansion, or growth quotas through consultative selling, cross\-sell/upsell motions, and strategic account planning.
* Can identify whitespace within complex customer organizations and translate customer needs into scalable product, expansion, and revenue opportunities.
* Have proven capability to thrive in an ambiguous environment.
* Are an effective communicator, both verbally and in writing.
* Have the ability to analyze, pull, and coordinate data across multiple sources.
* Have the ability to learn independently and juggle multiple priorities.
* Proactively inform teams of your workflow and raise your hand for special projects.
* Actively seek guidance from peers and cross\-functional partners, and both ask for and action feedback.
* Know how to take broad challenges or opportunities and turn them into actionable projects with clear milestones and goals, with minimal guidance.
* Have knowledge of CRM software, such as Salesforce.
* Have experience in food delivery and/or at a SaaS company.


Applications for this position are accepted on an ongoing basis

**About DoorDash**
------------------



At DoorDash, our mission to empower local economies shapes how our team members move quickly, learn, and reiterate in order to make impactful decisions that display empathy for our range of users—from Dashers to merchant partners to consumers. We are a technology and logistics company that started by enabling door\-to\-door delivery, and we are looking for team members who can help us go from a company that is known as the place you order food to a company that people turn to for any and all goods.  

  

DoorDash is growing rapidly and changing constantly, which gives our team members the opportunity to share their unique perspectives, solve new challenges, and own their careers. We're committed to supporting employees' happiness, healthiness, and overall well\-being by providing comprehensive benefits and perks including premium healthcare, wellness expense reimbursement, paid parental leave and more.

---------------------------------------------



We're committed to growing and empowering a more inclusive community within our company, industry, and cities. **Job Description**


ACTIVE Network, a Global Payments Company, is seeking a talented **Account Manager** to drive revenue through successful management and growth of their assigned book of business. S/he will manage a high volume of existing clients worth over $7M in revenue by communicating product/services updates, identifying product and client training gaps, ensure the delivery of quality customer and technical services, and resolve attrition issues to renew the client’s business. Account Managers are expected to drive continued market and competitive learning through research and customer outreach, as well as report findings to the team at regular intervals to maintain strong and ever\-evolving market knowledge among entire team.

 **Responsibilities:**

* Drive revenue through minimizing customer attrition and increasing sales to account base.
* Meet and exceed assigned quota targets.
* Quote and sell software and services to existing customer accounts.
* Manage contract renewals for an assigned book of business.
* Develop and maintain a business consultant relationship with client decision\-makers in higher revenue accounts.
* Analyze client business for new opportunities, suggesting relevant products and services, and presenting market\-specific content valuable to client growth.
* Build relationships with contacts across the organization to drive retention and mitigate attrition risk, primarily through regular, proactive contact.
* Relay market knowledge and client expertise to influence internal stakeholders with the intent of securing ACTIVE’s position in the market.
* Improve customer satisfaction and reduce attrition.
* Identify root causes of client “pain points” and issues.
* Liaise between teams to facilitate resolution of technical issues.
* Early identification of at\-risk clients and escalate potential risks or challenges to manager.
* Handle messaging and objection handling with clients regarding technical issues.

 **Requirements:**

* 3\-5 years’ experience in a previous Account Management or Customer Success position preferred
* Bachelor's Degree
* Proven experience and success in SaaS based market, preferable in a software sales setting
* Advanced communication (oral and written), objection\-handling, and conflict management skills
* Ability to leverage technology tools to fuel organization, efficiency, and productivity; advanced use of Microsoft Outlook, Excel, PowerPoint, and Word preferred
* Experience with using Salesforce.com is a plus
* Skilled in public speaking; can confidently create and deliver presentations to both client and internal audiences
* Ability to adapt and respond quickly to change
* Demonstrated ability to prioritize and multi\-task in a deadline\-driven environment
* Demonstrated ability to work independently and make sound decisions under the position guidelines with little direct supervision

jobs.description:
GardaWorld is shaping the future of cash management! We provide our clients with solutions in every phase of their cash supply chain, including secured transportation, cash management, cash vault processing, forecasting, ATM, and cash recycler services. We are equipped with the largest fleet of armored vehicles in the industry, sophisticated technology, and an expansive network of experienced employees and innovative partners. We process, manage, and move over $8B in cash every day while delivering 24/7 client support and logistical expertise.
  
  

Field Sales Representative
  
Own a territory. Build a market. Win new business.
  
GardaWorld Cash Services is seeking a driven Field Sales Representative to expand our presence with local and regional commercial customers. This field\-based new\-business development role is designed for a true sales hunter—someone energized by opening doors, building relationships, creating opportunities, and closing profitable business.
  
You will develop your assigned territory through face\-to\-face prospecting, consultative selling, networking, referrals, and targeted outreach. By understanding how prospective customers manage cash today, you will recommend GardaWorld solutions that improve security, visibility, efficiency, and control.
  
This is not an account\-management or primarily desk\-based sales position. Success requires a consistent market presence, disciplined pipeline development, and the resilience to turn initial conversations into long\-term customer partnerships.
  
**Compensation:** $65,000 \- $75,000 base salary plus commission.
  
**Location:** San Francisco, CA
  
**Travel:** Significant local and regional travel based on territory size, customer needs, and business requirements. Regular face\-to\-face prospecting and customer meetings are essential. Limited overnight travel may be required.
  
  

Responsibilities
  
* Develop and execute a new\-business sales strategy for an assigned geographic territory.
* Identify high\-potential prospects, industries, and commercial areas within the market.
* Build a qualified sales pipeline through in\-person prospecting, telephone outreach, referrals, networking, and other lead\-generation activities.
* Establish relationships with decision\-makers at local, regional, and multi\-location businesses.
* Conduct discovery conversations to understand prospective customers’ cash\-handling practices, operational challenges, and business priorities.
* Present GardaWorld Cash Services capabilities, including secure cash transportation, deposit solutions, cash automation, cash recycling, cash\-management services, cash information and reporting solutions, ClearValue, and other evolving solutions.
* Recommend solutions that align with each customer’s operational and commercial requirements.
* Prepare and deliver compelling sales presentations and proposals.
* Partner with Operations, Pricing, Finance, Legal, Implementation, and Sales leadership to develop solutions that can be successfully delivered.
* Participate in pricing and contract discussions and negotiate within established approval requirements.
* Advance qualified opportunities through the full sales cycle and close profitable new business.
* Maintain ownership of new opportunities through contract execution and support a successful transition to implementation.
* Maintain accurate and timely prospecting, pipeline, and sales activity information in applicable systems.
* Monitor market conditions, customer needs, competitive activity, and emerging growth opportunities.
* Provide leadership with actionable feedback regarding territory potential and market trends.
* Meet or exceed individual objectives for prospecting, customer meetings, qualified opportunities, pipeline growth, proposals, new\-customer acquisition, revenue, profitability, and territory penetration.
* Operate as a collaborative member of a high\-performance sales organization built on accountability, communication, positive energy, and execution.


Skills/Qualifications
  
* Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of relevant education and professional experience.
* Demonstrated success in B2B sales, outside sales, territory sales, or new\-business development.
* Proven ability to generate leads independently, build a qualified pipeline, and close new customers.
* Strong consultative selling, presentation, negotiation, and relationship\-building skills.
* Confidence initiating conversations with prospective customers through face\-to\-face and telephone outreach.
* Ability to understand customer business needs and translate them into practical solutions.
* Strong territory\-planning, organizational, and pipeline\-management capabilities.
* Self\-motivated, resilient, competitive, and comfortable operating with a high degree of independence.
* Ability to collaborate effectively across Sales, Operations, Pricing, Finance, Legal, and Implementation.
* Proficiency with CRM platforms and standard business technology.
* Valid driver’s license and the ability to travel regularly throughout the assigned territory.


Experience in cash management, payments, merchant services, financial services, commercial banking, treasury services, ATM technology, cash automation, secure logistics, route\-based commercial services, retail technology, business services, security services, or another complex B2B service environment is preferred.
  
Direct cash\-in\-transit or armored transportation experience is not required. We are looking for candidates with a demonstrated ability to enter a market, develop relationships, create pipeline, and win new business.

GardaWorld is an equal opportunity employer and drug free workplace. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to their race, color, religion, national origin, sex, protected veteran status or disability.

jobs.description:
As the industry leader in water technology, we’re growing and need talented people like you to help us continue to protect the world’s most vital resource.

  

Nalco Water, an Ecolab Company, seeks a **Technical Sales Representative** to join its industry leading sales team. You’ll be responsible for revenue and profit growth of programs and services in targeted accounts. Using a consultative sales approach, you’ll build relationships with existing customers by executing system assurance programs that meet their key business needs. With strong account leadership, you’ll also convert strategic competitive accounts and sell new technologies to current customers.

 **What’s in it For You:**

* You’ll join a growth company offering a competitive base salary, bonus structure and benefits
* A company vehicle and cell phone
* A long term, advancing career path in service, sales or management
* Access to the industry’s most innovative training programs
* Support from a dedicated technical service team
* A culture that values safety first, including training and personal protection
* Pride in working for a company that provides clean water, safe food, abundant energy and healthy environments

 **What You Will Do:**

* Generate and execute sales plans in existing customer base and in assigned competitively\-held accounts, to meet profit increase goals.
* Work closely with current and prospective customers to understand business needs and recommend continuous improvement and innovation plans that will maintain and grow sales
* Develop strong relationships with key stakeholders in current and prospective customers, including plant or facility executives
* Provide technical support to customers; identifying and resolving customer challenges, escalating as required
* Engage in problem solving by performing system analysis, interpreting data and providing written recommendations to ensure customer operations are performing at optimal levels.
* Actively sell and support Nalco Water innovations and technology in assigned customers to promote long\-term business relationships with Nalco Water

 **Territory/Location Information:**

* This position is based in **San Francisco, CA**
* Territory covers about a **200\-mile radius** of the surrounding area
* Targeted accounts are within the **Institutional** industry
* **\<10%** overnight travel required

  

As a trusted partner, your customers will rely on you for their success. Nalco Water is committed to seeing you succeed and provides innovative training programs to ensure you’re prepared to solve any customer problem.

  

Training programs are held in the field and at Nalco Water Headquarters in Naperville, IL; travel is arranged and paid for by Nalco Water. Based on your skill level and experience, topics covered may include technology, product, service, business and industry acumen, direct coaching and mentoring, sales management and leadership, classroom training and certifications.  



  

**Minimum Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree
* Technical sales or field sales support experience
* Possess a valid Driver's License and acceptable Motor Vehicle Record
* Immigration sponsorship is not available for this role

 **Preferred Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree in engineering (chemical, mechanical, industrial) or life sciences (biology, chemistry, etc.)
* Water treatment or specialty chemical industry experience
* Working knowledge of OR operations, wet end chemistry, pulp mill operations\>

In a world with increasing water shortage and contamination challenges, Nalco Water, an Ecolab company, helps customers conserve more than 161 billion gallons of water each year. We work with customers across the world in the light industry (institutional, food \& beverage, transportation and manufacturing), heavy industry (chemical, power and primary metals industries), paper and mining operations to reduce, reuse, and recycle their water while protecting their systems and equipment. Nalco Water provides the unique opportunity to work with a broad suite of technologies to deliver automated monitoring systems, data analysis and deep technical expertise to increase efficiency, sustainability and performance for our customers.

jobs.title: Influencer Marketing Specialist
jobs.description:
San Mateo, CA, United StatesMarketing and CommunicationsID: 43019
  
Every day, tens of millions of people come to Roblox to explore, create, play, learn, and connect with friends in 3D immersive digital experiences– all created by our global community of developers and creators.


At Roblox, we’re building the tools and platform that empower our community to bring any experience that they can imagine to life. Our vision is to reimagine the way people come together, from anywhere in the world, and on any device.We’re on a mission to connect a billion people with optimism and civility, and looking for amazing talent to help us get there.


A career at Roblox means you’ll be working to shape the future of human interaction, solving unique technical challenges at scale, and helping to create safer, more civil shared experiences for everyone.


We're looking for an Influencer Marketing Specialist to join our and help bring influencer campaigns to life. This is an execution\-focused role built for someone who is highly organized, creator\-savvy, and eager to get hands\-on experience across all facets of influencer marketing — from day\-to\-day campaign coordination to supporting live events on the ground.



You'll work closely with senior team members to support a roster of creators, keep campaigns running on time, and be a key point of contact for influencers throughout their partnership journey. If you love being in the mix, thrive in fast\-paced environments, and take pride in getting the details right, this role is for you.


**You will****:**
-----------------


**Campaign Support**


* Assist in the end\-to\-end execution of influencer campaigns — supporting briefing, content review, posting coordination, and performance tracking
* Manage campaign timelines and deliverable trackers, flagging risks and keeping all parties aligned
* Partner with internal teams to draft creator briefs, talking points, and campaign recaps under the direction of senior team members
* Coordinate with internal teams (creative, legal, social, events) to ensure influencer content is on\-brand and delivered on schedule
* Pull and compile performance data from influencer platforms and internal dashboards to support weekly and campaign\-level reporting


**Event Support**


* Serve as an on\-the\-ground point of contact for influencers at live events — managing logistics, schedules, and real\-time needs
* Help coordinate influencer travel, accommodations, and event\-day itineraries in partnership with the events and operations teams
* Support event activations from pre\-production through wrap, ensuring creator experience is smooth and on\-brand
* Assist in capturing content moments and documentation at events for post\-event recaps and learnings


**Relationship Management**


* Act as a day\-to\-day contact for a defined roster of creators and their management teams, building trust and maintaining positive ongoing relationships
* Track creator deliverables, communicate deadlines, and follow up to keep partnerships on schedule
* Help onboard new influencers into the program — sending contracts, answering questions, and walking partners through the process
* Maintain accurate and up\-to\-date records in the influencer CRM, including contact info, campaign history, and relationship notes
* Monitor creator content, community sentiment, and platform activity to surface relevant updates to the team

**You have:**
-------------


* 3\-4 years of experience in influencer marketing, creator relations, talent management, social media, or a closely related field
* A genuine understanding of the creator landscape — you follow creators, know the platforms, and can speak fluently about content trends
* Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple tasks and deadlines simultaneously without dropping the ball


**You are:**


* Clear, professional communicator — comfortable drafting emails to creators and their reps, and working cross\-functionally with internal teams
* Comfortable working in a fast\-paced environment where priorities can shift and no two days look the same
* Detail\-oriented and proactive — you spot what needs to happen next and take initiative to make it happen
* Familiar with influencer platforms, social media analytics tools, or creator CRM systems is a plus

**Nice to Have**
----------------


* Experience supporting live events or experiential marketing activations
* Exposure to influencer contracting, gifting programs, or affiliate/commission structures
* Background in gaming, entertainment, or consumer tech with knowledge of UGC creator communities
* Proficiency in Google Suite and knowledge of creator focused tools like Tubular, CreatorIQ, etc


For roles that are based at our headquarters in San Mateo, CA: The starting base pay for this position is as shown below. The actual base pay is dependent upon a variety of job\-related factors such as professional background, training, work experience, location, business needs and market demand. Therefore, in some circumstances, the actual salary could fall outside of this expected range. This pay range is subject to change and may be modified in the future. All full\-time employees are also eligible for equity compensation and for benefits as described on **this page**.

**About the job**

As a Social Media Manager on the Platforms and Devices (P\&D) Marketing team, you will lead strategy and execution for Google Chrome. jobs.title: Social Media Manager
jobs.description:
**About Campfire**  

Campfire is a next\-gen core accounting platform built for modern mid\-market finance teams. We’re building the future of ERP by replacing outdated systems and manual accounting processes with an AI\-native platform that helps finance teams move faster and operate more efficiently.  

  

**About the role**


You'll run Campfire's social presence and turn it into a real channel: the company voice on LinkedIn and YouTube, a credible presence in the Reddit communities where our buyers ask questions, and the executive and employee voices that make a B2B brand feel human. You'll own strategy, programming, community management and reporting, working closely with our content, video and influencer teams.

**What you'll do**

* Own the social strategy and content calendar across LinkedIn, YouTube and Reddit, with channel goals tied to reach, engagement, community growth and assisted pipeline.
* Program and publish daily: write posts, adapt video with the Content / Storytelling team, and run YouTube channel operations (titles, thumbnails, playlists, Shorts, community posts).
* Build Campfire's Reddit approach with the SEO \& AEO Manager: find the right communities, participate transparently and helpfully rather than promotionally, and track how that presence shows up in AI answers.
* Run executive and employee social programs: ghostwriting and coaching for founders and leaders, employee advocacy, and launch amplification.
* Own community management and social listening: respond, escalate, and route insights to Product, Product Marketing and Support.
* Partner with Influencer Marketing on creator amplification and with Paid Media on organic\-to\-paid handoffs (boosting, thought\-leader ads).
* Report monthly on channel performance and what we learned, and test formats constantly.

**What you'll bring**

* 6\+ years managing B2B social for a company or brand, with proof you've grown a channel and an audience.
* Excellent short\-form writing and a sharp eye for what works on LinkedIn, YouTube and Reddit specifically; you know these are three different cultures.
* Hands\-on YouTube channel management (analytics, packaging, Shorts).
* Reddit fluency: you understand subreddit norms and moderation, and how to build credibility without getting the brand banned.
* Comfort working with video (briefing, light editing, captions) and with scheduling and listening tools.
* Judgment and speed; you can handle a live moment or a tricky thread without escalating everything.

**Nice to have**

* Experience building executive or founder personal brands.
* Basic design skills (Figma or Canva) for on\-brand templates.
* An understanding of how social and community content influences AI\-answer visibility.

**What success looks like in 30 days**

* Channels and audience audited; social strategy, cadence and KPI framework published.
* Executive social program live with at least two leaders.
* Reddit playbook agreed with SEO \& AEO and active participation under way.

We continually work with our farmers, distributors and suppliers to establish fair trade and sustainability in the South Pacific Islands. Respect the Root continues to celebrate the tradition of kava while maintaining its inherited roots as we share this elixir and experience with you.

**Work Environment — Please Read Carefully**

This role is based in a private warehouse, and you will be working **mostly alone**. There is no supervisor standing next to you for most of your shift. Day\-to\-day direction, questions, and updates happen over **Slack**, so the ability to communicate clearly, promptly, and professionally in writing is essential to this job — not a nice\-to\-have.

The person who will excel in this role is someone who feels genuinely comfortable and capable working independently: self\-directed, organized, steady without supervision, and confident making reasonable decisions on their own. If you do your best work with a quiet space, a clear task list, and a Slack thread, you will thrive here.

Just as important: **you must be able to stay productive while waiting for an answer.** Questions come up, and a reply may not be instant. We expect you to ask the question, then move on to the next productive task rather than stopping all work and waiting. Filling that time well is part of the job.

**Responsibilities**

* Receiving incoming kava shipments and properly entering them into our CRM system, then organizing and labeling the product with the date it was received.
* Following established SOPs to properly label and fill bags using our equipment — including scales, an impulse heat sealer, a printer, and a label printer.
* Generating and printing order paperwork, and correctly labeling properly packaged boxes for outgoing orders. This includes Shopify orders and dropping shipments off at the post office.
* Learning and accurately executing different recipes for our various retail offerings, including products that require combination and mixture of multiple ingredients.
* Inventory and clearly communicating reorder needs to the team in a timely way.
* Picking up supplies as needed.
* Identifying, locating, and preparing equipment or packaging materials for the next stage of production, such as scales, paper bags and glass containers.
* Inspecting and organizing equipment or packaging materials to ensure quality and accuracy, and reporting any defects.
* Maintaining supply inventory and communicating with team members to ensure smooth production flow.
* Assisting with machine setup and changeover, gathering tools, and preparing materials.
* Keeping accurate records of production activities, ensuring traceability and proper labeling.
* Maintaining a clean and safe work environment, following company policies, and reporting any potential hazards.
* Communicating with other team members over Slack to keep production moving smoothly.
* Brewing kombucha or bottling/kegging, which is at a secondary location.
* Performing other tasks as assigned by leadership.

**Requirements**

* **Reliable personal transportation is a must.** You may be asked to drop packages at the post office, pick up ingredients and supplies, or other miscellaneous tasks. Reimbursement for transportation required for work will be provided.
* **Strong, self\-directed time management.** Because you are working largely on your own, the ability to organize your own day, prioritize, and manage your own time is a high requirement of this role.
* **Effective written communication over Slack**, including clear status updates, questions, and reorder requests.
* Comfort and confidence working independently in a private warehouse setting for the majority of your shift.
* Willingness and ability to be trained on new recipes, SOPs, and to cover a shift at a secondary location, potentially on short notice.
* Understanding of manufacturing processes and machinery.
* Ability to identify and address defects in parts and products.
* Ability to communicate effectively with team members.
* Ability to manage inventory and maintain a clean work environment.
* Must be able to regularly lift up to 25 pounds, and occasionally lift up to 50 pounds (25 kg).
* Must be able to safely lift, pick up or otherwise handle bags, boxes, equipment or packaging materials.
* Associate's degree in Food Science, Engineering, Business, or related field preferred.
* 1\-2 years of experience in the coffee, tea, or similar beverage production industry preferred.
* Experience working in a manufacturing environment, especially as a production assistant, is preferred.

**What We Offer**

* A competitive salary and benefits package, commensurate with experience and qualifications.
* The opportunity to join a passionate and driven team of kava enthusiasts, dedicated to revolutionizing the kava industry.
* Ongoing learning and professional development opportunities to expand your skillset and advance your career.
* The satisfaction of contributing to a thriving global kava community and be at the ground floor of an exciting and new drink phenomena.

If this exhilarating opportunity resonates with you, apply now! Become an integral part of our mission to transform the kava industry and let your passion for kava and e\-commerce propel y

jobs.description:
**Boys Program Coordinator**

**Position Type:** Part time

**Organization Information:**


Riverside Hawks Hope Health \& Hoops Inc.


490 Riverside Drive


New York, NY 10027

 **Website:**


www.riversidehawks.org


Mission Statement


The Riverside Hawks promote athletic achievement, educational excellence and character development for our student athletes. We accomplish our mission by meeting the following objectives:

  

* Providing academic guidance and support through our afterschool and tutoring programs.
* Working with our young people to establish and achieve their short\- and long\-term personal goals.
* Promoting the development of strong moral character and the value of fair play.
* Offering a support system to our families to ensure our young people become successful in all of their pursuits.


Who We Are


The Riverside Hawks Academic/Athletic Program is a year\-round organization serving more than 700 boys and Boys, ages 5\-17, who live primarily in the New York/New Jersey Metropolitan area. Founded in 1961 by the Riverside Church, it has long been nationally recognized for its success and leadership in the field of youth development. The goal of the program is to help our students leverage basketball, to attain better academic outcomes, attend high performing high schools and go to and graduate from college.


The success of our basketball program is legendary and evidence by the number of alumni who have used sports to have academic success in college. Many of our students have had tremendous athletic success in college and ultimately have played or are playing professionally. These former Riverside Hawks students include Nate Archibald, Kenny Smith, Kenny Anderson, Malik Sealy, Chris Mullin, Elton Brand, Donovan Mitchell, Rafer Alston, Omar Cook and Ty Jerome.


The Riverside Hawks are unashamedly seekers of excellence in every facet of our program. We are committed to promoting general health, educational advancement, character development and spiritual development through our program. Our program has a tremendous reputation for supporting academic excellence. Over the last three years 100% of our students have graduated high school and gone on to attend college.


The Riverside Hawks Program is under the auspices of Riverside Hawks Hope Health and Hoops, Inc., a 501(c)(3\) not\-for\-profit corporation. The Board of Directors and Associate Board are comprised of a highly committed, diverse group of professionals, who are dedicated to building upon the outstanding Hawks tradition of developing children and teenagers through a holistic process.

At The Connell Company, no two brands tell the same story. The Social Media \& Marketing Coordinator will help bring those stories to life across a dynamic portfolio of hospitality, lifestyle, and business brands, creating digital experiences that feel distinct, engaging, and connected to each audience.

You’ll turn marketing strategy into action by building content calendars, writing copy that captures each brand’s voice, creating and publishing social content, supporting events and campaigns, engaging with our online communities, and helping keep our digital presence fresh and relevant. We’re looking for someone who loves the creative side of social media but knows great marketing also lives in the details. You can move between brands, audiences, and priorities without losing the story, the deadline, or the details that make the work exceptional.

**How You’ll Make an Impact**

* Manage content calendars, approvals, assets, deadlines, and publishing schedules across multiple brands, keeping everything organized and on track.
* Schedule and publish social content across Instagram, Facebook, LinkedIn, TikTok, and other platforms using Metricool and similar social media management tools.
* Write engaging social copy and support the creation of Stories, Reels, short\-form video, event coverage, and other day\-to\-day content.
* Coordinate photography, video, graphics, and other creative assets with internal teams, designers, photographers, vendors, and outside partners.
* Support events, campaigns, openings, and special initiatives with social content and digital promotion.
* Keep websites, event listings, apps, Google Business Profiles, and other digital channels accurate and up to date.

* Keep projects and materials moving from request and approval through production, printing, and distribution, making sure the details don’t get lost along the way.
* Stay connected to our online communities by monitoring comments, messages, mentions, reviews, and user\-generated content, responding when appropriate and escalating when needed.
* Maintain each brand’s distinct voice and identity while keeping our overall digital presence polished and consistent.
* Track social performance to understand what’s working, what isn’t, and where we can improve.
* Keep digital files, marketing materials, and recurring assets organized and easy to find.
* This is a fully on\-site role with a regular Monday through Friday office schedule. Occasional evening, weekend, and holiday availability will be needed to support events, campaigns, and other business needs.

* 2–3 years of foundational professional experience in social media, digital marketing, marketing coordination, or content creation.
* An Associate’s degree in Marketing, Communications, Business, Public Relations, or a related field is welcome, but relevant hands\-on experience matters to us too.
* Hands\-on experience with social media scheduling and management tools such as Metricool, Meta Business Suite, Sprout Social, Hootsuite, Buffer, Later, or similar platforms.
* The ability to move comfortably between administrative work and creative work, understanding that both are important to keeping a marketing team running well.
* Strong writing skills and experience creating and publishing content across Instagram, Facebook, LinkedIn, TikTok, and other social platforms.
* Experience building and managing content calendars, coordinating approvals, and keeping content and deadlines on track.
* Strong organization and attention to detail. You can manage multiple projects, requests, deadlines, and priorities without things falling through the cracks.
* Experience supporting the day\-to\-day coordination of marketing materials, digital content, creative assets, or similar projects.
* Experience with Canva and working knowledge of Adobe Creative Suite.
* A good understanding of social media analytics and how to use performance results to improve content.
* Strong communication and follow\-through, with the ability to work across different teams, brands, and outside partners.
* An understanding of how different brands speak to different audiences, while keeping each brand’s voice and identity consistent.
* You stay current on social media trends and know how to recognize the ones that actually make sense for the brands you support.

**Supporting Your Success**

* 100% employer\-paid medical and dental coverage
* Exceptional retirement benefits, including a generous employer\-funded pension
* Paid time off and company\-paid holidays
* Employer\-paid membership to a premier fitness and wellness facility
* Company\-paid life insurance and additional employee benefits

* Professional development and opportunities for continued growth

**About Us**

This position is employed by Gateway Licensing, with the employee working full\-time, on\-site at iApparel Brands LLC. iApparel Brands LLC, established in 2007, is a New York–based apparel company focused on building and scaling men's, women’s, and kid’s apparel businesses. iApparel operates a portfolio of high\-velocity brands including **Dickies, Von Dutch, Perry Ellis, Southpole, and Warner Bros**. iApparel partners with major U.S. retailers to deliver trend\-right product at scale. The team is hands\-on, execution\-driven, and built for people who move quickly, take ownership, and expect results.

**Role Description**

This is a full\-time, on\-site licensing and marketing role based in Manhattan, NY, working exclusively with iApparel Brands LLC. This is an entry\-level position — we are looking for a person who knows how to drive business and keep things moving. You will own and manage relationships internally and externally with licensors and licensees. The right candidate has experience in marketing, and experience in licensing is a strong plus. You should be comfortable managing multiple projects at the same time, reacting quickly to tasks, and pushing your items forward in a fast\-paced, high\-volume environment. This is a highly visible role with real responsibility, on a lean, execution\-driven team.

**Objectives**

* Serve as a key point of contact for licensing activity across iApparel Brands LLC's portfolio — driving internal movement, tracking, reporting, and submissions from start to finish.
* Build and manage relationships with external licensing partners (Licensors and Licensees), representing iApparel Brands LLC with professionalism and responsiveness.
* Support brand marketing efforts, including influencer and talent coordination, to help execute high\-velocity, trend\-right go\-to\-market plans.
* Create, maintain, and continuously improve Licensing SOPs to keep a lean, execution\-driven team moving efficiently.

**Reports To**

* Reports to Manager.
* Partners and communicates with President and Owner.

**Daily Activities**

· *As a Licensee Coordinator — manages all company\-licensed brands in partnership with Manager:*

* Submit all required reporting requests on time for Licensors (Placements, Forecasts, Finance, etc.).
* Partners with Sales and Design teams to understand current activities and timelines.
* Partners with Design team on all submissions and artwork requests.
* Partners with Sales team to fill out and finalize all reporting requested by Licensor.
* Assists Operations/Finance in quarterly royalty reporting and payment schedules.
* Assists Manager on any Licensor requests/updates.
* Assists Manager on any presentations required for Licensing.
* Schedules and sets agendas for all Licensing status meetings, internally and externally.
* Organizes all data, contracts, information, and communications on the company server to serve as depository records and for ease of access.

· *As a Licensor Coordinator — manages the family brands' licensing in partnership with Manager:*

* Delivers regular communications and updates to current Licensees.
* Routes internally all Licensee submissions for timely approval or denial.
* Organizes all data, contracts, and communications on the company server to serve as depository records and for ease of access.
* Updates regularly all Brand PowerPoints and Brand guidelines with new activities and visuals.
* Partners with Operations/Finance to secure all Licensee reports, royalties, and payments.
* Requests and collects semi\-annual forecasts from licensees using the forecast template.
* Schedules and sets agendas for all quarterly and semi\-annual meetings with Licensees.
* Schedules and sets agendas for all quarterly and semi\-annual internal Licensing review meetings with key company members.

*As a Marketing Coordinator — manages social media platforms and websites and helps identify and execute new marketing opportunities:*

* Builds and manages brands' social media calendars.
* Manages and updates brands' websites and brand decks.
* Identifies and coordinates influencer and talent partnerships in support of brand marketing initiatives.
* Manages day\-to\-day communications with influencers and talent, including outreach, scheduling, and deliverable tracking.
* Identifies new possible marketing opportunities and presents to Manager.
* Executes agreed\-upon marketing plans.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Communications, Business, or a related field.
* Experience in marketing required; experience in licensing is a strong plus.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Highly organized, with the ability to manage multiple projects and deadlines simultaneously.
* Comfortable in a fast\-paced, high\-volume, execution\-driven environment.
* Proactive, ownership\-oriented mindset — able to react quickly and keep tasks moving with minimal oversight.
* Strong proficiency in Microsoft Suite, including Word, Excel, and PowerPoint.
* Experience with Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, InDesign, and Illustrator) is a strong plus.

Pay: $50,000\.00 per year

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* 401(k) matching
* Health insurance
* Paid time off

Ability to Commute:

* Manhattan, NY 10018 (Required)

Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Private Events Sales Coordinator
jobs.description:
**Reports to:**

General Manager (dotted line coordination with Maître'd and Chef)

**Employment type:**

Part\-time — Hourly, non\-exempt, plus commission

**Schedule:**

Standard business hours, with regular evening and weekend availability required for client site tours and to attend events in progress

**Scope:**

Maxwell Alley private events (recommended initial scope — see note at end of document)

**POSITION SUMMARY**

Maxwell Alley is seeking a Private Events Sales Coordinator to own the full sales cycle for our private dining and event space — from first inquiry through signed contract — and to actively grow our events business through outbound outreach. This person is the primary point of contact for prospective event hosts during the decision\-making and booking process, with a hand off to our on\-site events team (Maître'd and General Manager) once a contract is signed. He or she remains financially and administratively responsible for the event through final settlement.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

**Lead Management \& Sales**

* Respond promptly to all incoming private event inquiries — website intake form, email, phone, and other sources — with an acknowledgement the same business day, and a full response/quote within 36 hours.
* Maintain a single, up\-to\-date pipeline of every lead from first contact through signed contract, using Tripleseat software.
* Provide prospective hosts with everything needed to make a decision: availability, pricing, menu options, room capacity, layout possibilities, and decor/rental options.
* Prepare and send proposals, customized menu packages, and floor plans; recommend add\-ons (premium bar packages, florals, AV/entertainment, custom cakes, late\-night extensions) to grow average event value.
* Follow up consistently on open leads through a defined cadence until they convert or are closed out.
* Secure deposits and signed BEOs/contracts, and book confirmed events in Resy.

**Business Development / Outreach**

* Proactively prospect and generate new (“cold”) event business through targeted outreach — cold calling/emailing, list\-building (corporate offices, law firms, nonprofits, wedding and event planners), networking events, and referral relationships with planners and corporate concierges.
* Build and maintain a preferred\-vendor list (florists, bands/DJs, photographers, rental companies) for client referrals.

**Client Management**

* Meet prospective clients on\-site as part of their decision\-making process, including evenings/weekends as needed.
* Work along side the restaurant’s Maître’d to address client questions on room layout, decor, and other event logistics throughout the planning process.
* Adjust the BEO as event details change, keeping all stakeholders current.

**Cross\-Functional Collaboration**

* Participate in regular pre\-event meetings with the on\-site events team (GM, Maître'd, Chef, Bar Manager) to review upcoming events and confirm details.
* Hand off confirmed events cleanly to the on\-site team, ensuring nothing is lost in translation.

**Performance Monitoring \& Optimization**

* On an ongoing basis, monitor conversion rates, ease and success of event execution, and other relevant business metrics.
* Collaborate with the GM to adjust event parameters (pricing, packages, minimums, policies, etc.) as needed to keep offerings competitive and attractive to prospective hosts while remaining efficient for restaurant operations.

**Financial \& Administrative**

* Collect deposits and progress/final payments per the contract schedule.
* Ensure signed contracts include cancellation/postponement terms, deposit schedule, and certificate\-of\-insurance requirements for any outside vendors.
* Close out each event financially: final invoicing, settling the bill, and return of deposit where applicable.

**Post\-Event**

* Solicit post\-event feedback from hosts.
* Flag repeat\-booking opportunities (annual corporate holiday parties, recurring galas, etc.) and re\-engage past clients on a proactive schedule.
* Track and report on conversion rate, booked revenue, and pipeline status on a regular (e.g., weekly) basis.

**COMPENSATION**

* **Base hourly rate:** $20–$24/hour.
* **Commission basis: Share of Event Admin Fee collected.**  Warm leads (inbound via website, email, phone, or other unsolicited contact): 33% of Event Admin Fee collected. Cold leads (sourced through this person's own outreach/prospecting): 67% of Event Admin Fee collected
* **Definition of “cold”:** a lead with no prior inbound contact or marketing touch, directly attributable to this person's own prospecting (cold call/email, networking, referral relationships)

**SKILLS \& EXPERIENCE**

* Prior experience in restaurant, catering, or event planning/sales strongly preferred. If none, other hospitality experience is required.
* Familiarity with Tripleseat or comparable event booking/CRM software.
* Strong math skills; comfortable calculating pricing, deposits, and payment schedules accurately.
* Proficient with Excel/spreadsheets.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills — proposals and client correspondence are a core part of the job.
* Fluent English language skills required.
* Highly organized, with the ability to manage multiple events at different stages of planning simultaneously.
* Sales\-driven, client\-facing personality with strong follow\-through.

Pay: $20\.00 \- $24\.00 per hour

Work Location: In person

jobs.description:
Simon \& Schuster was named to Forbes magazine list of America's Best Mid\-Size Employers 2022\. Simon \& Schuster is a global leader in general interest publishing, dedicated to providing the best in fiction and nonfiction for readers of all ages, and in all printed, digital and audio formats. Its distinguished roster of authors includes many of the world's most popular and widely recognized writers, and winners of the most prestigious literary honors and awards. It is home to numerous well\-known imprints and divisions such as Simon \& Schuster, Scribner, Atria Books, Gallery Books, Pocket Books, Adams Media, Simon \& Schuster Children's Publishing and Simon \& Schuster Audio and international companies in Australia, Canada, India and the United Kingdom, and proudly brings the works of its authors to readers in more than 200 countries and territories. For more information visit our website at www.simonandschuster.com.
  
  

Simon \& Schuster is seeking a Video Production Coordinator to help produce engaging video content that connects readers with books and authors across our corporate marketing channels.
  
  

Reporting to the Executive Director, Video Production, this role supports every stage of the production process—from pre\-production planning and on\-set production to post\-production and content delivery. Working alongside our in\-house production team, you'll help create a wide range of content, including author interviews, social\-first video, event coverage, book trailers, and branded marketing campaigns.
  
  

This is an ideal opportunity for someone who is passionate about visual storytelling, eager to develop their production skills, and excited to help create content that inspires readers to discover their next great book.
  
  

Production Support
  
You'll play an active role in bringing Simon \& Schuster's video productions to life. A well\-run production starts with well\-maintained equipment and organized workflows. This includes:
  
* Assisting with pre\-production planning, including production schedules, call sheets, equipment preparation, and shoot logistics.
* Coordinating studio and location shoots, ensuring productions run smoothly and efficiently.
* Preparing cameras, lighting, audio, and production equipment for filming.
* Troubleshoot minor technical issues during production.
* Ensure equipment is production\-ready for upcoming shoots.
* Supporting the production team during author interviews, marketing shoots, live events, and other productions.
* Assisting talent, crew, and internal partners throughout production days.


Content Creation \& Production
  
As a member of the Video Production team, you'll contribute to creating compelling content for readers across multiple platforms. Responsibilities include:
  
* Assisting with the production of short\-form and long\-form video content.
* Operating cameras, lighting, and audio equipment under the guidance of the production team.
* Capturing behind\-the\-scenes content and additional footage as needed.
* Collaborating with Corporate Marketing teams to support integrated campaigns across social media, website, email, and events.


Post\-Production \& Content Delivery
  
You'll help ensure projects move efficiently from production through final delivery. You'll:
  
* Organize and maintain production footage and project files.
* Assist with video editing using Adobe Premiere Pro and other editing software.
* Prepare video assets for distribution across social media, YouTube, websites, presentations, and additional marketing channels.
* Maintain organized project archives and production documentation.


Learn, Experiment \& Grow
  
The video landscape is constantly evolving—and we're looking for someone who's excited to evolve with it. You'll:
  
* Stay current on video production techniques, editing workflows, and social\-first storytelling.
* Explore emerging video formats and production tools.
* Identify opportunities to improve production workflows and creative execution.
* Continuously develop your production, editing, and storytelling skills.

We're looking for someone who is creative, organized, collaborative, and passionate about visual storytelling. Qualified candidates will ideally have:

* Experience operating DSLR, mirrorless, or cinema cameras, lighting, and audio equipment.

* Ability to manage multiple projects in a fast\-paced creative environment.
* Familiarity with YouTube, Instagram, TikTok, and emerging video platforms.
* Willingness to work occasional evenings and weekends for productions and events.
* A passion for storytelling, creativity, and book

jobs.title: Marketing Coordinator
jobs.description:
**ABOUT US**

Golden Steer is a digitally native food brand and restaurant company. We are anchored by the original Golden Steer Steakhouse in Las Vegas, a true dining institution as the oldest steakhouse in the city. What started as a single location restaurant has grown into two locations and a high growth eCommerce business where we ship our seasonings nationwide. We're scaling across channels, products, and geographies and we're building the team to match.

**THE OPPORTUNITY**

Golden Steer is hiring a Marketing Coordinator to be the operating engine behind marketing across all three of our businesses: our seasonings eCommerce line, Golden Steer Las Vegas, and Golden Steer New York. This is the person who turns the plan into shipped work. You will be the operational back bone, owning the marketing calendar, executing email, coordinating creative across paid and organic, while supporting restaurant marketing for both restaurants, and keeping every marketing initiative on schedule across three brands at once.

This is a senior coordinator seat. We are hiring someone who has already held this job, knows how the pieces fit, and is ready for the next rung. You will report to our Director of Organic Marketing. We are a small team and you’ll have an opportunity to work on several exciting projects that will set you up to have a big creative voice and eventually drive the direction of day to day marketing.

**WHAT YOU'LL OWN**

* Own one marketing calendar across all three brands, covering promos, product launches, restaurant events, and seasonal peak moments, with owners, dates, and dependencies the whole team can trust.
* Email execution for eCommerce \& Steakhouse. Sometimes that will require building one off emails, planning the schedule for sending. We have an email partner so the emphasis will be more on reporting back on what performed and what you would change.
* Creative operations. Write and route briefs, traffic assets into paid and organic, hold naming conventions in Motion and Meta Ads Manager, and work with our Content Coordinator to keep the asset library clean enough that anyone can find the right file in under a minute.
* Organic social coordination under the Director of Organic Marketing. Own the Social calendar across brands, coordinate posts with creative partners, schedule and publish, and keep community response times tight.
* Project\-manage campaigns and launches from brief through go\-live and post\-mortem. Build timelines, coordinate stakeholders, track deliverables, proactively flag roadblocks, and make sure nothing falls through the cracks.
* Paid media support. Keep trafficking, tagging, and QA airtight, pull weekly performance numbers, and flag what needs attention before it turns into a problem.
* Restaurant marketing for Las Vegas and New York. Local partnerships, reservations platforms, events, in\-restaurant collateral, and whatever the GMs need to drive covers.
* PR and influencer logistics. Press requests, sample sends, hosted visits, and content collaborations, coordinated end to end.
* Weekly reporting. Pull the numbers, put them in a consistent format every week, and surface the three things worth acting on.
* Post\-mortems. Every promo gets closed out with what we spent, what we made, and what we do differently next time.

**WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR**

**We're prioritizing skills in this order:**

* Execution (must be expert). You get things done, on time, without being chased. You take an ambiguous priority, break it into steps, and close it out. This is the most important thing.
* Organization (must be excellent). Your calendars, trackers, and files are clean and current. Nothing falls through, and the team can see status without asking you for it.
* Marketing judgment (must be capable, owned expertise). You understand why a campaign is built the way it is, you can read the numbers, and you have opinions. We will keep developing this with you.

**In addition, you should bring:**

* Real reps. 3 to 4 years in a marketing coordinator, marketing associate, or marketing operations role, ideally at a DTC brand, a hospitality group, or an agency serving them. You have run a calendar, sent the sends, and owned deadlines that mattered.
* Ownership without hand holding. You are given the outcome and you figure out the path.
* Comfort with numbers. AOV, ROAS, CTR, CVR, open and click rates. You can pull them, format them, and explain what moved.
* Range across brands. eCommerce, a Las Vegas institution, and a new New York restaurant have different customers and different needs. You can hold all three in your head in the same week.
* A genuine love of food and hospitality. You will be working inside two restaurants and a seasonings brand, and this should excite you.
* Flexibility. Restaurants and launches do not run on a 9 to 5\. Some evenings and weekends come with the territory.

**YOU'LL THRIVE HERE IF YOU...**

* Have already done this job somewhere and are ready for the promotion.
* Are the most organized person on any team you have been on, and it shows in the systems you leave behind you.
* Move fast and close loops. Nothing sits untouched in your inbox for three days.
* Would rather ask a blunt question today than surface a problem next week.
* Get real satisfaction from making other people's work land on time and land well.
* Are comfortable executing within a small team but interacting with big senior leaders across lines
* Have an appreciation for the brand. We opened in 1958, the history matters, and every asset has to feel like us.
* Understand personas. On eCommerce our customers are largely suburban Gen X, Boomer, and Silent Generation home cooks, which is a different audience from the people booking a table in New York or Las Vegas.
* Like being in the room. This role is in person in New York, with periodic travel to our Las Vegas restaurant.

**TOOLS WE USE**

* CapCut
* Canva
* Sprout Social
* Google Analytics
* Shopify
* Klaviyo
* Motion
* Slac

jobs.title: Account Manager
jobs.description:
Account Manager

**Overview**
------------

  

Company Overview:
Allied Universal®, North America’s leading security and facility services company, offers rewarding careers that provide you a sense of purpose. While working in a dynamic, welcoming, and collaborative workplace, you will be part of a team that contributes to a culture that positively impacts the communities and customers we serve.**Job Description**
-------------------

  

Allied Universal® is hiring an Account Manager. As an Account Manager, you are the driving force behind daily security operations, ensuring the safety and well\-being of the people and places you protect. You will lead from the front—guiding, developing, and motivating your team of security officers and supervisors to deliver exceptional service. This is your opportunity to lead with purpose, make a real impact, and create a safer environment for those who count on you.
**Why Join Allied Universal?*** **Career Growth:** Opportunities to advance within a global leader in security services
* **Impactful Work:** Play a vital role in protecting people, property, and businesses
* **Supportive Team:** Work with caring professionals dedicated to safety and excellence

**RESPONSIBILITIES:*** **Manage scheduling:** Leverage AI\-powered technology to effectively schedule security officers, meeting client contract hours while minimizing unbilled overtime
* **Lead and Develop Security Teams:** Hire, coach and manage security officers and supervisors while overseeing payroll, performance, and employee relations
* **Enhance Client Relationships:** Serve as the primary point of contact for clients, ensuring high\-quality service that protects people and property
* **Handle Security Incidents and Emergencies:** Respond to escalated issues professionally, coordinating with clients and internal teams
* **Direct Compliance and Security Operational Excellence:** Oversee training, safety, and site operational standards as well as managing inventory (uniforms, equipment, and other essential supplies)

**QUALIFICATIONS (MUST HAVE):*** High school diploma or equivalent
* 1 year plus Armed Security / law Enforcement or Militlary Experience
* Licensing requirements are subject to state and/or local laws and regulations and may be required prior to employment
* Valid driver’s license if driving a company vehicle, or personal vehicle while conducting business
* Minimum of two (2\) years of experience in business operations, security management, or supervising teams in a fast\-paced environment
* Experience in leading, developing, and retaining a dynamic team while building positive client relationships
* Knowledge of emergency preparedness, physical security protocols, risk assessments, and law enforcement coordination
* Proven ability to evaluate situations, make sound independent decisions, and resolve conflicts in an efficient manner
* Proficiency in web\-based applications and computer systems, including Microsoft Office
* Ability to communicate effectively with clients and employees while managing multiple projects and driving operational excellence
* Financial acumen; able to manage staffing levels while minimizing non\-billed overtime and managing turnover costs; planning and organizing skills to control costs related to inventory (uniforms, equipment, etc.)

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS (NICE TO HAVE):*** College degree in Business Administration or a law enforcement\-related field
* Law enforcement, military, and/or contract or proprietary security services, or facility management experience
* American Society of Industrial Security (ASIS), International Certified Protection Professional (CPP) certification
* Previous payroll, billing, or scheduling experience
* Aptitude with security systems: CCTV, access control, and badge administration

**Location: New York City \- Hybrid Role. Only candidates currently living in NY, NJ, and CT will be considered.**

Afficiency is seeking an Account Manager (NY\-Hybrid) to support and grow relationships with our distribution partners. Reporting directly to the Chief Growth Officer, this individual will play a critical role in onboarding new partners and agents, coordinating successful launches, and driving ongoing engagement and growth across Afficiency’s distribution network.

**This is a high\-activity role that requires exceptional organization, urgency, resourcefulness, and follow\-through. The Account Manager must be able to manage numerous partner needs and workstreams simultaneously while using AI, automation, and other productivity tools to create a scalable and consistently high\-quality partner experience.**

The successful candidate will be highly solutions\-oriented and proactive in identifying impediments to success, whether within their own responsibilities or across agent onboarding, contracting, and partner launch processes. This person will work collaboratively with internal teams to understand root causes, develop practical solutions, and continually improve operational performance and the partner and agent experience.

Success in this role means more than completing assigned tasks. The Account Manager is expected to identify what may prevent partners and agents from succeeding, take ownership of moving issues forward, and work across the organization to develop solutions that improve onboarding speed, contracting efficiency, partner performance, and the overall distribution experience.

**Responsibilities**

**Partner and Agent Onboarding**

Lead onboarding activities for new distribution partners, ensuring a seamless and well\-organized launch experience.

Support the onboarding and contracting of agencies, agents, and other distribution partners, helping ensure requirements are completed accurately and efficiently.

Serve as a primary point of contact for partners and agents throughout the onboarding and implementation process.

Coordinate with internal stakeholders across Growth, Operations, Licensing and Contracting, Compliance, Product, and Technology to drive successful launches.

Develop and maintain onboarding plans, timelines, deliverables, responsibilities, and success metrics for each partner.

Monitor onboarding and contracting activity, identify incomplete requirements or process bottlenecks, and proactively drive outstanding items toward resolution.

Anticipate potential impediments to onboarding, contracting, integration, or launch and address them before they affect timelines or the partner experience.

Identify recurring points of friction and work with the appropriate teams to implement practical, scalable solutions.

**Account Management and Partner Success**

Build trusted relationships with distribution partners and serve as their primary day\-to\-day contact.

Manage a high volume of partner and agent communications, requests, meetings, deliverables, and follow\-up activities.

Maintain a clear understanding of each partner’s priorities, performance, open items, impediments, and growth opportunities.

Conduct regular business reviews and identify opportunities to increase sales, engagement, and partner satisfaction.

Monitor key performance indicators and provide partners and internal stakeholders with actionable insights and recommendations.

Proactively identify issues that could affect partner or agent success and coordinate the appropriate internal resources to resolve them.

Support partner retention and expansion by identifying unmet needs and opportunities to deepen the relationship.

**Solutions Development and Continuous Improvement**

Proactively identify impediments that could prevent the Account Manager, an agent, or a distribution partner from achieving a successful outcome.

Investigate the root causes of delays, errors, recurring questions, or underperformance rather than addressing only the immediate symptoms.

Bring forward thoughtful recommendations and potential solutions rather than simply escalating problems.

Work collaboratively with internal teams to design and implement improvements to processes, technology, communication, documentation, and training.

Look for patterns across partner and agent experiences and use those insights to identify broader improvement opportunities.

Develop practical, scalable solutions that improve onboarding speed, contracting efficiency, data quality, partner responsiveness, and overall performance.

Monitor the effectiveness of process improvements and refine solutions based on performance data and stakeholder feedback.

**Activity Management and Process Optimization**

Manage numerous accounts, projects, agent onboarding cases, contracting activities, and partner workstreams simultaneously while maintaining accuracy, responsiveness, and attention to detail.

Maintain clear visibility into account activity, ownership, deadlines, dependencies, impediments, and next steps.

Establish effective systems for prioritizing work, documenting decisions, tracking commitments, and ensuring timely follow\-through.

Develop scalable processes, templates, workflows, and reporting practices that enable Afficiency to support a growing partner and agent base.

Use AI, automation, CRM, and productivity tools to improve workflow efficiency, prepare communications, summarize meetings, organize information, maintain documentation, and identify required follow\-up.

Apply sound judgment when using AI tools, including reviewing outputs for accuracy, protecting confidential information, and complying with company policies.

Identify repetitive or manual activities that can be standardized, automated, or completed more efficiently.

Use reporting and operational data to identify delays, trends, capacity constraints, and opportunities for improvement.

**Sales Enablement and Business Growth**

**Business Development Executive**


When you are part of Thermo Fisher Scientific, you’ll do challenging work and be part of a team that values performance, quality, and innovation. As part of a successful, growing global organization, you will be encouraged to perform at your best. With revenues of $40 billion and the largest investment in R\&D in the industry, we give our people the resources and opportunities to make significant contributions to the world.

As a Business Development Executive within our Pharma Services Biotech Account Management team, you will support the development and execution of territory and account plans to drive sales growth within your assigned accounts and prospect opportunities within your assigned territory across our broad range of drug modalities, which may include Steriles, Solid Dosage, Biologics, Cell and Gene Therapy, Viral Vector, and API.


In the role you will be responsible for implementing business strategies, annual marketing \& business plans, forecasting, providing marketing/competitive feedback and customer satisfaction relative to sales activities and profitable growth.


To be successful in the role you will need strong scientific and commercial acumen, be target\-focused, and excel at building trusted relationships and demonstrating deep customer insight. You will also need strong customer relationship, communication, and consultative selling skills, with the ability to identify opportunities and support customer success, data\-driven decision\-making, and resilience, alongside exceptional communication, and the ability to work well in complex and competitive environments.

**Location:** We are seeking Business Development Executives to join our Pharma Services Group, with opportunities available on both the East and West Coast.

* Participate in customer meetings, events, and site visits to support business development activities
* Champion customer experience proactively with urgency, integrity, and accountability
* Provide feedback to improve customer experience and internal processes
* Collaborate effectively with internal stakeholders to support customer needs and sales objectives
