* 5\-8 years of quota\-carrying field sales or business development experience
* Previous sales, deal design, and relationship management experience essential
* Experience of sales within a CDMO, and in one or more of our current drug modalities (Steriles, Solid Dosage,
* Biologics, Cell and Gene Therapy, Viral Vector, and API) will be a distinct advantage
* Strong analytical skills including financial competence
* Strong relationship\-building skills with customers and internal stakeholders
* Experience managing sales opportunities and customer relationships within a matrix environment
* Experience progressing opportunities through a consultative sales process
* Strong commercial acumen with experience shaping solutions and influencing deal outcomes
* Confident communicator with executive presence and strong negotiation skills
* Highly competitive, self\-directed, and results\-driven mindset
* Comfortable operating with urgency, ambiguity, and limited structure

jobs.description:
**Highsnobiety** is a platform dedicated to the latest in style, culture, and the community pushing them forward. We don't just report on what's happening \- we are shaping it. From industry deep dives to product curations to our very own in\-house garments, our goal is to bring you not anything and everything, but only the best of the best on all fronts. And we want you to be a part of that!


We are looking for an experienced **Account Manager, Client Services** to join our award\-winning in\-house creative agency, Highsnobiety\+. In this role, you will lead the execution of engaging, on\-brand B2B campaigns, grounded in a deep understanding of the client, creative brief, and overall campaign vision.


Embedded within our B2B division, you’ll collaborate closely with internal teams across our creative agency to produce culturally relevant, strategic content that helps our partners connect authentically with a young, style\-conscious audience. We're looking for a reliable, self\-motivated team player who thrives in a fast\-paced, creative environment and is committed to delivering best\-in\-class work and building lasting client relationships.

**MISSION:**

* Strategically plan, organize, and oversee client and in\-house project timelines from inception to completion, working closely with creative teams, production, brand partnership, editorial, and global counterparts.
* Collaborate closely with the Senior Director and Head of Client Services to ensure cross\-functional alignment, uphold client satisfaction, and inform broader business decisions tied to project performance and team resourcing.
* Develop and maintain comprehensive campaign timelines and budgets, ensuring smooth execution and effective resource allocation across teams.
* Ensure all projects are delivered on schedule, within defined scope, and within budget parameters, carefully monitoring progress and adjusting as needed.
* Maintain accountability across internal and external teams to meet established deadlines and drive project efficiency.
* Serve as the primary liaison between clients and Highsnobiety\+, ensuring clear communication of deadlines, budgets, and approvals, and optimizing outcomes for both parties.
* Proactively identify potential challenges or obstacles in project delivery and take corrective action to minimize their impact, ensuring timely resolution and maintaining project momentum.
* Cultivate and maintain strong client relationships throughout the project lifecycle, fostering trust and satisfaction to drive client retention and future business.
* Maintain a comprehensive understanding of project status at any given moment, providing clients with timely, transparent updates and setting clear expectations.

* Organize and archive all project assets, ensuring efficient project management and availability for future reference, and maintaining a structured archive system.
* Collaborate with external vendors and maintain positive, productive working relationships to ensure quality deliverables and optimal outcomes.

* Your role is pivotal in delivering a seamless and exceptional experience to our clients, ensuring the successful execution of projects while driving client satisfaction and business growth.

We partner with advertisers to reach Amazon customers on Amazon.com, across our other owned and operated sites, on other high quality sites across the web, and on millions of devices. This role is highly collaborative, working with Creative, Senior Sales, Product, and Retail partners and will drive process improvement to gain efficiency and foster collaboration. Key job responsibilities  

* Become a knowledgeable partner on Amazon Advertising solutions
* Develop annual brand and media strategies for growth based on overall advertiser goals/objectives
* Develop campaign strategies and audience targeting recommendations per brand and product line

jobs.title: Field Sales Representative
jobs.description:
GardaWorld is shaping the future of cash management! We provide our clients with solutions in every phase of their cash supply chain, including secured transportation, cash management, cash vault processing, forecasting, ATM, and cash recycler services. We are equipped with the largest fleet of armored vehicles in the industry, sophisticated technology, and an expansive network of experienced employees and innovative partners. We process, manage, and move over $8B in cash every day while delivering 24/7 client support and logistical expertise.
  
  

Field Sales Representative
  
Own a territory. Build a market. Win new business.
  
GardaWorld Cash Services is seeking a driven Field Sales Representative to expand our presence with local and regional commercial customers. This field\-based new\-business development role is designed for a true sales hunter—someone energized by opening doors, building relationships, creating opportunities, and closing profitable business.
  
You will develop your assigned territory through face\-to\-face prospecting, consultative selling, networking, referrals, and targeted outreach. By understanding how prospective customers manage cash today, you will recommend GardaWorld solutions that improve security, visibility, efficiency, and control.
  
This is not an account\-management or primarily desk\-based sales position. Success requires a consistent market presence, disciplined pipeline development, and the resilience to turn initial conversations into long\-term customer partnerships.
  
**Compensation:** $65,000 \- $75,000 base salary plus commission.
  
**Location:** New York, NY
  
**Travel:** Significant local and regional travel based on territory size, customer needs, and business requirements. Regular face\-to\-face prospecting and customer meetings are essential. Limited overnight travel may be required.
  
  

Responsibilities
  
* Develop and execute a new\-business sales strategy for an assigned geographic territory.
* Identify high\-potential prospects, industries, and commercial areas within the market.
* Build a qualified sales pipeline through in\-person prospecting, telephone outreach, referrals, networking, and other lead\-generation activities.
* Establish relationships with decision\-makers at local, regional, and multi\-location businesses.
* Conduct discovery conversations to understand prospective customers’ cash\-handling practices, operational challenges, and business priorities.
* Present GardaWorld Cash Services capabilities, including secure cash transportation, deposit solutions, cash automation, cash recycling, cash\-management services, cash information and reporting solutions, ClearValue, and other evolving solutions.
* Recommend solutions that align with each customer’s operational and commercial requirements.
* Prepare and deliver compelling sales presentations and proposals.
* Partner with Operations, Pricing, Finance, Legal, Implementation, and Sales leadership to develop solutions that can be successfully delivered.
* Participate in pricing and contract discussions and negotiate within established approval requirements.
* Advance qualified opportunities through the full sales cycle and close profitable new business.
* Maintain ownership of new opportunities through contract execution and support a successful transition to implementation.
* Maintain accurate and timely prospecting, pipeline, and sales activity information in applicable systems.
* Monitor market conditions, customer needs, competitive activity, and emerging growth opportunities.
* Provide leadership with actionable feedback regarding territory potential and market trends.
* Meet or exceed individual objectives for prospecting, customer meetings, qualified opportunities, pipeline growth, proposals, new\-customer acquisition, revenue, profitability, and territory penetration.
* Operate as a collaborative member of a high\-performance sales organization built on accountability, communication, positive energy, and execution.


Skills/Qualifications
  
* Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of relevant education and professional experience.
* Demonstrated success in B2B sales, outside sales, territory sales, or new\-business development.
* Proven ability to generate leads independently, build a qualified pipeline, and close new customers.
* Strong consultative selling, presentation, negotiation, and relationship\-building skills.
* Confidence initiating conversations with prospective customers through face\-to\-face and telephone outreach.
* Ability to understand customer business needs and translate them into practical solutions.
* Strong territory\-planning, organizational, and pipeline\-management capabilities.
* Self\-motivated, resilient, competitive, and comfortable operating with a high degree of independence.
* Ability to collaborate effectively across Sales, Operations, Pricing, Finance, Legal, and Implementation.
* Proficiency with CRM platforms and standard business technology.
* Valid driver’s license and the ability to travel regularly throughout the assigned territory.


Experience in cash management, payments, merchant services, financial services, commercial banking, treasury services, ATM technology, cash automation, secure logistics, route\-based commercial services, retail technology, business services, security services, or another complex B2B service environment is preferred.
  
Direct cash\-in\-transit or armored transportation experience is not required. We are looking for candidates with a demonstrated ability to enter a market, develop relationships, create pipeline, and win new business.
  
  

EOE, Drug\-Free Workplace
  
  

GardaWorld is an equal opportunity employer and drug free workplace. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to their race, color, religion, national origin, sex, protected veteran status or disability.
  
  

Cash Services Headquarters
  
2000 NW Corporate Boulevar

jobs.description:
**Description**


Position Summary


The Business Development Market Research Intern supports business development initiatives through market research, data collection, and analysis. This includes gathering and maintaining market intelligence, identifying prospective owners and partners, and supporting research projects that assist the Business Development team.


Success requires strong organization, attention to detail, analytical skills, and the ability to manage information from multiple sources while supporting various research initiatives.

**Responsibilities include (but are not limited to):**

* Research residential buildings, management companies, ownership entities, and market segments using public records and internal resources.
* Gather and organize market intelligence related to prospective business opportunities and industry trends.
* Maintain databases, spreadsheets, and research records using internal systems and available resources.
* Keep research information accurate and complete, with appropriate documentation and updates.
* Analyze market information and industry activity relevant to business development initiatives.

jobs.title: Digital Marketing Intern - Technical AI & Automation
jobs.description:
Eulerity is an AI\-native marketing automation platform. Our software runs paid advertising, social, listings, reputation, and call tracking for thousands of locations across enterprise franchises and SMB networks, executing autonomously across Google, Meta, Apple, and Microsoft. The Technical Operations team is the analytical engine that keeps that execution sharp.



We are hiring an intern to sit with this team for the summer.


**Who we are looking for**
--------------------------



This is not just a marketing internship. We are looking for someone who is genuinely analytical. The kind of person who opens a messy dataset and gets curious instead of overwhelmed. Who enjoys figuring out why a number moved. Who can read a chunk of SQL or Python and follow what it does, even if they would not write it from scratch. Who would otherwise be heading toward an analyst seat at a consulting firm or a product role at a startup.



If you love spreadsheets, you will feel at home here. If you have ever built a model in Excel just to understand something better, even more so.


**What you will actually do**
-----------------------------



You will work directly with our Technical Account Management and Analytics teams on the parts of campaign management that require thinking, not clicking. That includes:


* Diagnosing why specific campaigns are underperforming and proposing fixes grounded in the data.
* Building and refining Excel and Sheets models that our account teams use to make decisions.
* Auditing campaigns at scale, often across hundreds of locations for a single brand, and surfacing patterns no one else has noticed.
* Pulling, cleaning, and analyzing performance data from Google Ads, Meta, LinkedIn, and our internal platform.
* Helping operationalize new analytical workflows, including ones we are building on top of AI tooling.
* Contributing to internal projects that make our team faster and smarter.


You will not be writing ad copy or designing creative. You will be doing the analytical work that makes the campaigns actually perform.


**What we want from you**
-------------------------


* Current student or recent graduate, ideally with coursework in something quantitative. Economics, statistics, computer science, engineering, math, finance, or similar. A traditional marketing background is not what we are looking for here.
* Strong Excel chops. Comfort with pivot tables, lookups, conditional logic, and building models from scratch.
* Basic code literacy. You do not need to be a programmer, but you should be able to read SQL, Python, or JavaScript and roughly understand what it is doing.
* Comfort with AI tools as a daily part of how you work. We expect everyone here to use them aggressively and intelligently, and you should be the kind of person who already does.
* Sharp written communication. You can take a messy analysis and explain the takeaway in three sentences.
* Detail\-oriented and self\-directed. You catch things other people miss and you do not need to be told twice.

**Logistics**
-------------


* Fall 2026, October start with potential to extend based on performance.
* Hybrid out of our NYC office, 2 to 3 days per week in person.
* Minimum 20 hours per week, flexible schedule.
* $18 to $20 per hour.
* Lunch credits and unlimited snacks when in\-office.
* Direct mentorship from senior operators on our team.

We are looking for strong **field sales professionals** to expand our network of station placements across Manhattan.

This is a highly active, street\-level sales role. You will spend a significant part of your working day **walking your assigned territory, visiting businesses in person, introducing yourself to owners and managers, and negotiating station placements face\-to\-face.**

This is **not a desk\-based sales position** and not an inbound sales role. You are expected to actively create your own pipeline, approach businesses directly, and consistently generate new opportunities.

The strongest candidates already have experience with **door\-to\-door or field B2B sales in New York City** and know how to get access to decision\-makers.

An existing network or contact list of NYC businesses is a major advantage.

**What You Will Do**

* Walk your assigned territory in Manhattan and actively prospect businesses in person.
* Enter stores, restaurants, gyms, salons, hotels, offices, and other commercial locations without waiting for inbound leads.
* Identify and reach owners, general managers, operators, and other decision\-makers.
* Conduct cold face\-to\-face outreach and introduce the station placement opportunity.
* Build your own pipeline through both direct street prospecting and open\-source research.
* Schedule and conduct follow\-up meetings when needed.
* Negotiate placement terms and close agreements.
* Agree on the installation of stations with business partners.
* Transfer confirmed installation details to the operations team.
* Maintain regular follow\-up with prospects until the deal is closed.
* Develop long\-term relationships with business owners and local operators.
* Maintain accurate reporting on visits, leads, negotiations, closed placements, and installations.
* Meet monthly installation and rental targets.

**What We Are Looking For**

* Proven experience in **field sales, door\-to\-door sales, outside sales, or B2B business development**.
* Strong preference for candidates with sales experience specifically in **New York City**.
* Comfortable approaching businesses cold and starting conversations with people you have never met.
* Able to walk extensively around Manhattan and visit a high number of locations every day.
* Strong ability to identify and reach decision\-makers.
* Proven ability to negotiate and close deals.
* Persistent and comfortable hearing “no” repeatedly while continuing to prospect.
* Self\-driven and able to work independently without constant supervision.
* Confident face\-to\-face communication.
* Strong spoken English.
* Existing NYC business contacts are a significant advantage.
* Must be legally authorized to work in the United States.

**Compensation**

Compensation is performance\-based and depends on your monthly results.

**Junior Field Sales Manager$3,500/month base \+ KPI bonus.** Minimum: **5 installations per month.** Up to **20 rentals**

**Mid\-Level Field Sales Manager$6,000/month base \+ KPI bonus.** Minimum: **8 installations per month. 40\+ rentals**

**Senior Field Sales Manager$8,000/month base \+ KPI bonus.** Minimum: **10 installations per month 60\+ rentals**

**Senior Manager — Networks \& Corporate Accounts$10,000/month base \+ KPI bonus.** Target: **200 rentals per month** plus station installations based on business demand.

**Performance Expectations**

Your grade is based on actual monthly performance.

To move to a higher compensation level, you must meet the minimum performance requirements for that grade in the previous month.

If minimum targets are not met, the grade may be adjusted downward.

Cancellations and returns within the first three months are included in performance quality metrics. A cancellation/return rate above **10%** may reduce credited results.

**Career Growth**

Top performers can grow into a **Team Lead** role and take responsibility for a field sales team.

**Important:** this position requires daily active prospecting in the field. You should be comfortable spending hours walking through Manhattan, entering businesses, talking to owners and managers, and creating sales opportunities from scratch.

**Ready to take your sales career to the next level? Join Recharge City and help us power NYC.**

Pay: From $60,000\.00 per year

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule

Work Location: On the road

jobs.description:
**Who We Are:** CAMBA is a community of staff, volunteers, clients, donors, neighbors and partners who work together to build an inclusive New York City, where all children and adults have access to the resources and supports they need to thrive. We take a comprehensive approach by offering more than 180 integrated programs in: Education \& Youth Development, Family Support, Job Training \& Employment Support Services, Health, Housing, and Legal Services. We reach more than 72,000 individuals and families each year at our 100 locations, including 10,000 youth. CAMBA serves a diverse cross section of New Yorkers from new mothers in Brownsville to job seekers in the Rockaways. More than half of our clients are immigrants and refugees from around the globe. Over 85% of our families live in poverty, reflecting the challenges faced by nearly 1\.7 million New Yorkers today.

**PROGRAM**: Since 1991, CAMBA has been addressing the City’s housing crisis and today this portfolio includes permanent affordable and supportive housing, homelessness prevention, housing relocation, emergency and transitional housing. In response to a pressing need for permanent, stable and affordable housing for New York City residents, CAMBA created an affiliated non\-profit affordable housing development corporation in 2005 called CAMBA Housing Ventures, Inc. CHV’s mission is to elevate the definition of affordable and supportive housing by creating and preserving sustainable, high\-quality, and energy\-efficient developments that provide residents with a healthy, stabilizing, and beautiful home. jobs.description:
**Neptune Technology Group Inc.** is a technology company serving water utilities across North America. Since 1892, we have continually focused on the evolving needs of water utilities — revenue optimization, operational efficiencies, and improved customer service. With our portfolio of smart water meters, data collection systems and software, we make data actionable for our customers — so they can remain focused on *the business of water*. For additional information, please visit the company website at www.neptunetg.com (http://www.neptunetg.com/).

  


**Project Coordinator**


**Position Summary**


* Support the Project/Program Manager in planning, scheduling, and tracking tasks and deliverables across one or more concurrent projects.
* Maintain accurate and up\-to\-date project documentation, including project plans, status reports, meeting minutes, and action item logs.
* Coordinate and schedule project meetings with stakeholders, ensuring agendas, materials, and follow\-up notes are distributed in a timely manner.
* Track project risks, issues, and action items, following up with owners to help ensure timely resolution.
* Maintain project management tools (e.g., Jira, SharePoint, Smartsheet) to keep task status, timelines, and dependencies current.
* Prepare status reports, dashboards, and presentation materials summarizing project progress for leadership and stakeholders.
* Support onboarding of new team members and vendors to project processes, tools, and PMO standards.
* Facilitate communication and information flow between technical and non\-technical teams involved in a project.
* Help enforce PMO governance, templates, and standard processes across assigned projects.
* Perform other administrative and coordination duties as assigned by the Project/Program Manager or PMO leadership.

  


**Skills:**


* **Organizational skills** — Tracking multiple tasks, deadlines, and deliverables across projects without letting details slip. This includes maintaining schedules, action item lists, and document repositories in a way others can follow.
* **Communication skills** — Clearly conveying updates, status reports, and requests to project managers, team members, and stakeholders, both in writing (emails, meeting notes) and verbally (status meetings, check\-ins).
* **Basic project management tool proficiency** — Comfort with tools like Jira, MS Project, Smartsheet, or Asana for tracking tasks, timelines, and dependencies, since coordinators are often the ones keeping these systems updated day to day.
* **Attention to detail** — Catching inconsistencies in schedules, budgets, or documentation before they become bigger problems; accuracy matters a lot at this level since coordinators often handle the granular tracking that PMs rely on.
* **Problem\-solving and adaptability** — Handling shifting priorities, scheduling conflicts, or last\-minute changes calmly, and knowing when to escalate an issue versus resolving it directly.

  


**Requirements**


**Education:** Typically requires an associates or bachelor's degree (or international equivalent)


**Experience:** 0–2 years of relevant experience in project coordination, administrative support, or a related discipline.

  


**Preferred Qualifications:**


* Associate's or Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Project Management, or a related field.
* Proficiency with project management and collaboration tools such as MS Project, Smartsheet, Jira, or Confluence.
* Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast\-paced environment.

jobs.title: Purchasing Coordinator-Manufacturing
jobs.description:
**Purchasing Coordinator – Manufacturing**

Starflex Fabrication is seeking a dependable, organized, and proactive Purchasing Coordinator to manage purchasing activities supporting our manufacturing operation.

This position will be responsible for the procurement of all materials, components, supplies, and consumables required to keep production running. The ideal candidate understands that purchasing in a manufacturing environment is more than placing purchase orders—it requires monitoring material requirements, maintaining supplier relationships, tracking deliveries, controlling costs, and communicating potential shortages before they impact production.

Experience in sheet metal fabrication or a similar manufacturing environment is a strong plus.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Manage day\-to\-day purchasing activities for the facility, including:
* Sheet metal and plate
* Structural steel, tubing, angle, channel, and other raw materials
* Hardware and fasteners
* Welding supplies and consumables
* Powder coating and finishing supplies
* Shop supplies, tooling, and production consumables
* Safety and maintenance supplies
* Most general office supplies
* Review production requirements and MRP data to identify material and purchasing needs.
* Create, issue, and maintain purchase orders.
* Monitor open purchase orders and follow up with suppliers to ensure materials arrive when required.
* Communicate material shortages, delivery delays, back orders, and other supply concerns before they affect production.
* Obtain and compare supplier quotations for pricing, availability, lead time, and freight.
* Collaborate with suppliers to maintain competitive pricing and reliable delivery performance.
* Coordinate purchasing requirements with Operations, Production, Engineering, Quality, and Accounting.
* Verify purchased materials and components meet required specifications, quantities, and revisions.
* Assist with resolving receiving discrepancies, incorrect shipments, damaged material, and supplier quality issues.
* Maintain accurate purchasing information, supplier records, pricing, and lead times within the MRP system.
* Monitor inventory levels of commonly used production supplies and consumables.
* Identify opportunities for cost savings, improved lead times, supplier consolidation, and inventory reduction.
* Support supplier evaluation and purchasing documentation requirements associated with Starflex Fabrication's ISO 9001:2015 Quality Management System.

**Qualifications**

* Previous purchasing, procurement, buyer, or material planning experience in a manufacturing environment preferred.
* Strong working knowledge of MRP/ERP systems required.
* Experience with ProfitFab is highly preferred.
* Sheet metal fabrication, metalworking, or structural fabrication experience is a strong plus.
* Familiarity with purchasing carbon steel, stainless steel, aluminum, structural materials, hardware, and manufacturing consumables is preferred.
* Ability to read and understand purchase requirements, part numbers, material specifications, quantities, and basic manufacturing documentation.
* Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple open purchase orders and priorities simultaneously.
* Strong supplier communication and follow\-up skills.
* Comfortable obtaining competitive quotations and negotiating pricing, lead times, freight, and delivery requirements.
* Proficient with Microsoft Excel, Outlook, and general computer applications.
* Must be proactive and able to identify potential shortages or supply issues before they disrupt production.
* Strong attention to detail and accuracy.

**What We Offer**

* Full\-time, hourly position
* 4\-day regular workweek: Monday through Thursday
* Overtime on Friday as needed
* Medical, dental, and vision insurance
* 401(k) with company match
* Short\-term and long\-term disability insurance paid 100% by the company
* Life insurance paid 100% by the company
* Compensation based on experience

**About the Position**

This is a hands\-on purchasing position supporting a fast\-paced fabrication environment. The Purchasing Coordinator will have direct responsibility for ensuring the materials and supplies needed by Production are available when required.

Success in this position requires someone who takes ownership of purchasing requirements, follows open orders through delivery, communicates problems early, and understands how purchasing decisions directly affect production schedules, customer deliveries, and overall manufacturing performance.

Experience with ProfitFab and purchasing within a sheet metal or structural fabrication environment will be given strong consideration.

Pay: $22\.00 \- $26\.50 per hour

Expected hours: 40\.0 per week

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* 401(k) matching
* Dental insurance
* Health insurance
* Health savings account
* Life insurance
* Paid time off
* Vision insurance

Application Question(s):

* Do you have experience using an MRP or ERP system to determine purchasing requirements and manage purchase orders?
* Which MRP/ERP systems have you used?
* Are you comfortable being responsible for purchasing across multiple categories—including production raw material, hardware, consumables, shop supplies, maintenance items, and general office supplies?
* Do you have experience working in a sheet metal fabrication, structural fabrication, metalworking, or similar manufacturing environment?

Experience:

* Purchasing: 3 years (Preferred)

Ability to Commute:

* College Park, GA 30349 (Required)

Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Business Operations Coordinator
jobs.description:
**We Put the World on Vacation**


Travel \+ Leisure Co. is the world’s leading vacation ownership and travel membership company, with a dynamic and growing portfolio of resort, travel club, and lifestyle travel brands. Our dedicated associates help the company achieve its mission to put the world on vacation. Innovation and growth keep our work interesting and fun. Every day is a chance to learn something new and turn vacation inspiration into exceptional experiences for millions of travelers worldwide.  

As a Business Operations Coordinator for Travel \+ Leisure at Club Wyndham Nashville, this person will be responsible for delivering quality support for our Sales and Marketing processes. This person provides exceptional customer service to all guests and business partners, ensures that operational processes and procedures are met, protects data integrity throughout our systems, and partners with their team and leadership to implement changes or new initiatives. As part of the Business Operations team, this individual helps support the steps to put the world on vacation and make memories of a lifetime!

**You will be responsible to:**

* Provide exceptional customer service to our guests, business partners, and team
* Work with leadership to implement ways in which to improve our customer service or processes
* Protect data when interacting with our guests to ensure they receive the best experience with us
* Ensure company assets are always protected and supporting policies and procedures are executed
* Understand and implement operational procedures that govern our business
* Support new initiatives and help impacted teams understand what the changes means to them
* Maintain and validate daily, weekly, monthly, or quarterly reporting needs
* Consistently leverage your resources (your team, leadership, procedural guides, etc.) to provide quick support to questions as they arise and escalates appropriately to leadership

**You will partner with:**

* Sales and Marketing teams
* Human Resources and Recruiting
* Resort Operations leadership

**Examples of projects you will work on:**

* Helps to provide the onboarding/training of new team members
* Implement changes across any area/function that Business Operations supports

**Requirements:**

* Proficient in Microsoft Suite
* Have availability to support the business throughout weekends and holidays
* Experience delivering outstanding customer service, with excitement!

**In Summary:**


You should be an individual that enjoys working in a fast\-paced environment, interacting with guests and business partners, and being part of a highly engaged team. You should be a communicative, reliable, organized person who is not afraid of learning new processes and embraces change.

 **How You'll Be Rewarded:**


We offer a diverse range of comprehensive health and welfare benefits to associates who work 30 or more hours per week to meet your needs and support you throughout your career with us. Certain benefits may be available to associates working fewer hours where required by applicable law. Travel \+ Leisure Co. benefits include:


***Note: Temporary and/or seasonal associates are ineligible for Paid Time Off.***

* Medical
* Dental
* Vision
* Flexible spending accounts
* Life and accident coverage
* Disability
* Depending on position, paid time off, parental leave and holidays (speak to your recruiter for additional information)
* Wish day paid time to volunteer at an approved organization of your choice
* 401k with employer match (subject to eligibility requirements, including tenure \- speak to your recruiter for additional information)
* Legal and identify theft plan
* Voluntary income protection benefits
* Wellness program (subject to provider availability)
* Employee Assistance Program

 **Where Memories Start with You**


Hospitality is at the heart of all we do at Travel \+ Leisure Co. Here, you’ll find an inclusive environment where we deliver excellence and take time to have fun, celebrate together, and support one another. We're always looking ahead to what’s next and how we can strengthen our business, its neighboring communities, and the customer experience. Join our global team and build a career where memories start with you.


We are an equal opportunity employer, and all applications will be considered for employment without attention to their membership in any protected class. If you require any reasonable accommodation to complete your application or any part of the recruiting process, please email your request to MyCareer@travelandleisure.com, including the title and location of the position for which you are applying.

jobs.title: Channel National Account Manager - Digital, MRO, OEM & Industrial
jobs.description:
Eaton’s ES AMER NAS division is currently seeking a Channel National Account Manager \- Digital, MRO, OEM \& Industrial. This is a hybrid\-based position where candidates must reside within 50 miles of one of our following locations to be considered for the position: Beachwood, OH; Chicago, IL; Moon Township, PA; Peachtree City, GA; Smyrna, GA; Grapevine, TX or City of Industry, CA.


**What you’ll do:**
-------------------

**Position Overview:**  

The primary function of the National Account Manager – Digital, MRO, OEM and Industrial is to drive profitable growth across a portfolio of strategic national accounts by building customer\-specific growth strategies, leading joint business planning and executing initiatives that expand revenue, margin and market share. This role is responsible for strengthening executive\-level customer relationships, accelerating digital commerce performance, identifying new business opportunities and coordinating cross\-functional resources to deliver outstanding customer experience and sustained commercial results. This position can be in Pittsburgh, Pennsylvania; Cleveland, Ohio; Peachtree City or Smyrna, Georgia or Chicago, Illinois.  

  



**In this function you will:**  

• Develop and grow strategic relationships with key national accounts across Digital, MRO, OEM, and Industrial channels to increase revenue, profitability and customer loyalty
  

• Create and execute joint business plans with assigned accounts, establish growth priorities, financial targets, promotional strategies and measurable milestones
  

• Lead digital commerce initiatives by improving online assortment, product content, search visibility, conversion, pricing execution and promotional effectiveness across customer platforms
  

• Analyze sales, profitability, inventory and market trends to identify whitespace opportunities, improve account performance and drive fact\-based business decisions
  

• Lead product launches, promotional programs, and strategic growth initiatives in partnership with marketing, product management, supply chain, finance and field sales teams
  

• Build strong relationships with customer leaders in merchandising, category management, procurement, operations, eCommerce and sales to strengthen alignment and execution
  

• Maintain strong knowledge of assigned markets, customer business models, competitive activity, and Eaton solutions to position differentiated value with national accounts
  

• Identify, prioritize and capture new opportunities across key product categories, customer programs, and channel motions that support profitable growth
  

• Influence and align internal stakeholders across functions and regions to ensure strong execution of customer commitments, national agreements and growth plans
  

• Own account forecasting, performance reviews and strategic business updates, ensuring disciplined execution against revenue, margin and market share objectives


**Qualifications:**
-------------------

**Required (Basic) Qualifications:**  

• Bachelor’s degree from an accredited institution
  

• Minimum five (5\) years of experience in national account management, channel sales, strategic account management, or business development in electrical, industrial, OEM, MRO, or related markets
  

• Possess a valid driver’s license
  

• No relocation benefit is being offered for this position. Only candidates within a 50\-mile radius of Beachwood, OH; Chicago, IL; Moon Township, PA; Peachtree City, GA; Smyrna, GA; Grapevine, TX or City of Industry, CA will be considered. Active\-Duty Military Service member candidates are exempt from the geographical area limitation.  



**Preferred Qualifications:**  

• Bachelor’s degree in Business or Engineering
  

• MBA
  

• Sales experience in North American digital, MRO, OEM, industrial, electrical or datacom channels
  

• Experience leading strategic account plans, joint business planning and customer\-facing commercial negotiations
  

• Experience with digital commerce, product content optimization, channel marketing or go\-to\-market execution


**Skills:**
-----------

**Position Criteria:**  

• Possess excellent communication skills
  

• Must be able to work in the United States without corporate sponsorship now and within the future
  

• Market knowledge
  

• Knowledge of electrical products and distribution channels
  

• Strategic planning and profit planning experience
  

• Knowledge of sales techniques, customers, customer relations and personnel development
  

• Strong professional presence and communication style
  

• Experience of setting aggressive sales plans and achieving ambitious targets and stretch goals
  

• Ability and demonstrated experience to identify existing and future growth market opportunities and tailor strategic sales plan and resources to maximize Eaton’s topline and market share position
  

• Ability to establish rigor, consistency and a business cadence that drives the team forward and achieves results, even in times of challenging market conditions with the capability to synthesize information and leverage data\-driven arguments to make and guide informed decisions
  

• Strong customer orientation and focus. Ability to work with all levels of the customer organizations to sell and support products as well as to understand the customer’s current and future business needs
  

• Negotiation skills and expertise; ability to cope with ambiguity, successfully resolve problems, manage conflict and navigate resistance and develop buy\-in
  

• Technical aptitude to understand and position solutions within the Utility segment
  

• Ability to influence without authority in a matrix environment
  

• Experience and ability to assess, select, develop, motivate and energize a diverse team in critical areas of sales planning, negotiation and customer pursuit with the ability to swiftly address performance issues
  

• Ability to travel up to 50%

jobs.title: Key Account Manager (Atlanta, GA)
jobs.description:
**Description:**

The Key Account Manager (KAM) is responsible for the promotion of products and achievement of assigned goals, within legal and regulatory guidelines, to customers and accounts within a geographic territory. The KAM role also involves targeted educational and promotional efforts leading to the identification and development of new customers and accounts within the territory and increased therapy/ product adoption for appropriate patients. This will entail presenting information on products and services associated with the products to physicians, health care professionals, pharmacy directors and staff, buyers, professional groups, and others involved in the decision\-making process in the clinical environment as well as at conferences and other similar events.  



  

**Essential Functions:**

* Drive regional sales performance through effective account management.
	+ Exceed sales targets by leveraging data to strategically prioritize activities and allocate resources.
	+ Develop strong relationships with HCPs by understanding each customer's needs, goals and prescribing habits and competitive product standing.
	+ Effectively sell a portfolio of products and balance priorities and responsibilities so that territory goals are exceeded for all products promoted.
	+ Manage sales efforts within assigned promotional and operational budgets
	+ Utilize and leverage all available sales data to prioritize activities and resources and achieve territory objectives.
	+ Consistently target, develop, maintain and sell to existing customers and accounts. This includes accessing difficult to see customers on a regular basis.
	+ Routinely identify and develop new business opportunities within assigned territory.
	+ When applicable to products reimbursed through a buy and bill model, use good judgement in establishing and negotiating contracts for customers within a framework of company pricing strategy and parameters.
* Support the development of Key Opinion Leaders from targeted accounts.
* Identify and attend industry events, including society conferences.
* Participate in regional and national sales meetings.
* Complete call reporting and samples records, maintain accounts records and submit timely and thorough account and territory reports.
	+ Comply with all deadlines including territory information requests, project assignments and other requests by various departments.
* Share important learnings and information, such as best practices, opportunities and competitive threats with sales management and peers.
* Maintain a high degree of competence in the areas of product knowledge, disease state knowledge, and industry knowledge impacted by Amneal's products.
* Successfully complete all required training.
* Responsible for maintaining a high degree of honesty, integrity, diplomacy and ethical behavior.

  
**Education:**

Bachelors Degree (BA/BS) preferably in a scientific/medical or business discipline \- Required  

* 

**Experience:**

5 years or more in in the pharmaceutical, medical device, and or biotech industries  

* 

**Skills:**

* Two consecutive years of documented sales success in the top 20% of the nation and verifiable performance review ratings of Exceeds Expectations or Outstanding in the last two years
* Demonstrated ability to sell in a competitive marketplace
Strong clinical sales acumen  
* 

**Specialized Knowledge:**

* Hospital pharmacy sales experience ideal
Product focus on biologics, expensive therapies, or injectables  
* 

The base salary for this position ranges from $140,000 to $160,000 per year. In addition, Amneal offers a short\-term incentive opportunity, such as a bonus or performance\-based award, with this position within the first 12 months. Amneal ranges reflect the Company’s good faith estimate of what Amneal reasonably believes that it will pay for said position at the time of the posting. Individual compensation will ultimately be determined based on a variety of relevant factors, including but not limited to, qualifications, experience, geographic location and other relevant skills.


At the heart of our Total Rewards commitment is a comprehensive, flexible and competitive benefits program for eligible positions that enables you to choose the plans and coverage that meet your personal needs. This includes above\-market, diverse and robust health and insurance benefits to meet the varied needs of our employees as well as a significant 401(k) matching contribution to help our employees save for retirement. We also promote employee well\-being with programs that help you enjoy your career alongside life’s many other commitments and opportunities.


  
Amneal is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, genetic information, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local laws. If you require a reasonable accommodation to complete the application process or to participate in any part of the hiring process, please contact us at accommodations@amneal.com . jobs.title: Account Manager
jobs.description:
**What We Do:**



Florence software advances cures by helping the world’s most important research sites do their best work. Our solutions are now used by over 30,000 research teams in 70 countries around the world—we’re the most widely deployed site workflow tool in the industry. By the end of the decade, we’ll double the pace at which new medicines get to market by doubling the output of trial site teams. To date, we were named a Deloitte Fast 50 business, G2 Category Leader, an Inc. \& AJC best place to work, and an Inc. 5000 company five years in a row.



At Florence, we are committed to make the world a better place by accelerating research while providing an environment for our employees where they can be happy in their lives, enjoy their jobs, and grow.

**What You’ll Bring To The Team:**



As an Account Manager, you will be responsible for managing a portfolio of key accounts, ensuring their satisfaction, driving renewals, and fostering growth opportunities. You will serve as the primary commercial point of contact for our valued clients, understanding their needs, and proactively working to strengthen the relationship. You will work in conjunction with our customer success team to ensure that clients receive the value from their investment in Florence solutions.



If you are a motivated and client\-focused professional with a passion for account management, renewals, and driving account growth, we invite you to apply and join our team at Florence Healthcare. Help us continue to build strong client partnerships and make a significant impact on our clients' success


**You Will:**


* Client Relationship Management:
* + Build and maintain strong relationships with existing clients, becoming a trusted advisor.
	+ Understand clients' business objectives and challenges to align our solutions with their needs.
* Renewal Management:
* + Develop and execute strategies to ensure high renewal rates for subscription\-based services.
	+ Monitor contract expiration dates and proactively engage with clients to secure early and multi\-year renewals.
* Account Health Monitoring:
* + Regularly assess the health of client accounts and identify potential issues or opportunities.
	+ Collaborate with cross\-functional teams to address any client concerns and deliver solutions.
* Account Growth and Upselling:
* + Identify opportunities to expand our services and upsell additional solutions to existing clients.
	+ Develop account plans and strategies for account expansion and growth.
* Client Advocacy:
* + Act as a client advocate within the company, representing client interests and feedback.
	+ Provide clients with insights, best practices, and recommendations to maximize the value of our offerings in conjunction with your customer success partner.
* Reporting and Analytics:
* + Maintain accurate records of client interactions, renewals, and account growth activities.
	+ Utilize data and analytics to track progress, identify trends, and make data\-driven decisions.
* Cross\-functional Collaboration:
* + Collaborate with customer success, customer support, marketing, product, and sales to ensure a seamless client experience.
	+ Provide feedback to internal teams to improve product/service offerings based on client input.
	+ Onboard new clients in partnership with sales and professional services to ensure a successful beginning to the relationship.

**An Ideal Candidate Has:**


* Bachelor's degree in Business, Marketing, or a related field (MBA is a plus).
* 4\+ years proven experience as an Account Manager, Senior Account Manager, or similar role within a SaaS environment.
* Ability to grasp complex technical concepts.
* Exceptional communication, negotiation, and presentation skills.
* Results\-driven with a track record of meeting and exceeding renewal and growth targets.
* Proficiency in CRM software and data analysis tools.
* Excellent organizational skills and attention to detail.
* Ability to travel to meet with clients as needed.


**We’ll Be Extra Excited If You Have:**


* Strong understanding of the Healthcare, Life Sciences, or Clinical Trials landscape
* CRO/Sponsor experience
**What’s in it for you?**


* **Do well.** We offer a competitive compensation package, medical and dental insurance, and office space in the heart of the city.
* **Do good.** We insist that health technology is the highest calling for software development. We pride ourselves on working on something bigger than ourselves; helping advance cures and therapies.
* **Make the leap.** Join our high\-output culture to create innovative, modern, and purposeful software solutions.


Florence supports workplace diversity and does not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, military service eligibility, veteran status, sexual orientation, marital status, physical disability, or any other protected class.


*Please be cautious of potential recruitment fraud.* *Florence Healthcare will never ask you to pay a fee or download software as part of the interview process with our company. In addition, Florence Healthcare will not ask for your personal banking information until you have signed an offer of employment and completed onboarding paperwork that is provided by our People Operations team. All communications with Florence Healthcare employees will only be sent from @florencehc.com email addresses.*

jobs.title: Key Account Manager- The Home Depot
jobs.description:
**Job ID:** 18112

**Location: Atlanta, GA**

 **Newell Brands** is a leading consumer products company with a portfolio of iconic brands like Graco®, Coleman®, Oster®, Rubbermaid®, Sharpie® and Yankee Candle® \- and 24,000 talented teammates around the world. Our culture is built on values in action: Integrity, Teamwork, Passion for Winning, Ownership, and Leadership. We work together to win, grow, and make a real impact—supported by a high\-performing, inclusive, and collaborative environment where you can be your best, every day.

 **Job Summary:**


The Key Account Manager is responsible for supporting the development and execution of the omni sales plan. Successful candidates will work in collaboration with the Omni Sales Team, Sales Planning, and Supply Chain to develop sustainable growth strategies. This role will provide guidance and support in developing and achieving Newell’s strategies for assigned category. **Responsibilities:**

  

* Leads the development of specific account strategies and annual operating plans that deliver Newell Brands budget and Omni Distribution, Shelving, Merchandising, and Price expectations at the category level.
* Leads the execution of annual Innovation Summits, development and delivery of customer Joint Business Plans, and successful execution of annual Line Reviews at the category level.
* Frequently interact with customer personnel to drive the execution of the customer category plan, building strong relationships at the Merchant/Buyer level
* P\&L responsibility for business across the customer account. Must demonstrate strong financial acumen and the ability to manage all account P\&L levers including List price, sales allowances, rebates, markdowns, trade marketing spend and other customer investments (i.e., Retail Media, Customer Data) at the category level.
* Strong cross\-functional expertise in operational disciplines such as providing a monthly sales forecast and end to end supply planning with the customer. Must possess a strong understanding of customer distribution network and customer related metrics (i.e. Fill Rate, On\-Time, Vendor Lead time, In\-Stocks).
* Participates in the monthly Customer Business Review with Segment and Enterprise Leadership, highlighting risks and opportunities to annual operating plan and customer JBP.
* Participates in the monthly Segment Demand Review as a key step of the Newell S\&OP process
* Networks and builds strong relationships with key customer decision makers and key internal stakeholders.
* Externally advocates for the Newell business and internally advocates for the customer.
* Leads all facets of Talent Management (recruiting, selection, performance management, and career planning) with direct reports.
* Use data, information systems, and metrics around financial, brand, and shopper trends to maximize market share, sales, and gross margin.
* Manages trade spend/customer programs in collaboration with trade and finance to deliver \\exceed Newell annual budget and customer JBP targets
* Negotiates and manages trade funds to create customer and company value by consistently measuring and enforcing trade terms and identifying opportunities for improvement
* Works with demand planning to develop accurate sales forecasts and achieve specified levels of forecast accuracy Monitors the competitors' brands and products as well as our market share, competitor market share, and target market share to understand shopper trends and opportunities and communicating to appropriate sales, trade and brand management
* Leverages our brands and product mix to improve profitability and meet customer, shopper, and Newell Brands targets
* Leverage category development management, customer planning, commercial finance, and customer supply chain resources in the development and activation of customer category business plans.

jobs.title: Field Sales Representative
jobs.description:
GardaWorld is shaping the future of cash management! We provide our clients with solutions in every phase of their cash supply chain, including secured transportation, cash management, cash vault processing, forecasting, ATM, and cash recycler services. We are equipped with the largest fleet of armored vehicles in the industry, sophisticated technology, and an expansive network of experienced employees and innovative partners. We process, manage, and move over $8B in cash every day while delivering 24/7 client support and logistical expertise.
  
  

Field Sales Representative
  
Own a territory. Build a market. Win new business.
  
GardaWorld Cash Services is seeking a driven Field Sales Representative to expand our presence with local and regional commercial customers. This field\-based new\-business development role is designed for a true sales hunter—someone energized by opening doors, building relationships, creating opportunities, and closing profitable business.
  
You will develop your assigned territory through face\-to\-face prospecting, consultative selling, networking, referrals, and targeted outreach. By understanding how prospective customers manage cash today, you will recommend GardaWorld solutions that improve security, visibility, efficiency, and control.
  
This is not an account\-management or primarily desk\-based sales position. Success requires a consistent market presence, disciplined pipeline development, and the resilience to turn initial conversations into long\-term customer partnerships.
  
**Compensation:** $65,000 \- $75,000 base salary plus commission.
  
**Location:** Atlanta, GA
  
**Travel:** Significant local and regional travel based on territory size, customer needs, and business requirements. Regular face\-to\-face prospecting and customer meetings are essential. Limited overnight travel may be required.
  
  

Responsibilities
  
* Develop and execute a new\-business sales strategy for an assigned geographic territory.
* Identify high\-potential prospects, industries, and commercial areas within the market.
* Build a qualified sales pipeline through in\-person prospecting, telephone outreach, referrals, networking, and other lead\-generation activities.
* Establish relationships with decision\-makers at local, regional, and multi\-location businesses.
* Conduct discovery conversations to understand prospective customers’ cash\-handling practices, operational challenges, and business priorities.
* Present GardaWorld Cash Services capabilities, including secure cash transportation, deposit solutions, cash automation, cash recycling, cash\-management services, cash information and reporting solutions, ClearValue, and other evolving solutions.
* Recommend solutions that align with each customer’s operational and commercial requirements.
* Prepare and deliver compelling sales presentations and proposals.
* Partner with Operations, Pricing, Finance, Legal, Implementation, and Sales leadership to develop solutions that can be successfully delivered.
* Participate in pricing and contract discussions and negotiate within established approval requirements.
* Advance qualified opportunities through the full sales cycle and close profitable new business.
* Maintain ownership of new opportunities through contract execution and support a successful transition to implementation.
* Maintain accurate and timely prospecting, pipeline, and sales activity information in applicable systems.
* Monitor market conditions, customer needs, competitive activity, and emerging growth opportunities.
* Provide leadership with actionable feedback regarding territory potential and market trends.
* Meet or exceed individual objectives for prospecting, customer meetings, qualified opportunities, pipeline growth, proposals, new\-customer acquisition, revenue, profitability, and territory penetration.
* Operate as a collaborative member of a high\-performance sales organization built on accountability, communication, positive energy, and execution.


Skills/Qualifications
  
* Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of relevant education and professional experience.
* Demonstrated success in B2B sales, outside sales, territory sales, or new\-business development.
* Proven ability to generate leads independently, build a qualified pipeline, and close new customers.
* Strong consultative selling, presentation, negotiation, and relationship\-building skills.
* Confidence initiating conversations with prospective customers through face\-to\-face and telephone outreach.
* Ability to understand customer business needs and translate them into practical solutions.
* Strong territory\-planning, organizational, and pipeline\-management capabilities.
* Self\-motivated, resilient, competitive, and comfortable operating with a high degree of independence.
* Ability to collaborate effectively across Sales, Operations, Pricing, Finance, Legal, and Implementation.
* Proficiency with CRM platforms and standard business technology.
* Valid driver’s license and the ability to travel regularly throughout the assigned territory.


Experience in cash management, payments, merchant services, financial services, commercial banking, treasury services, ATM technology, cash automation, secure logistics, route\-based commercial services, retail technology, business services, security services, or another complex B2B service environment is preferred.
  
Direct cash\-in\-transit or armored transportation experience is not required. We are looking for candidates with a demonstrated ability to enter a market, develop relationships, create pipeline, and win new business.
  
  

EOE, Drug\-Free Workplace
  
  

GardaWorld is an equal opportunity employer and drug free workplace. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to their race, color, religion, national origin, sex, protected veteran status or disability.
  
  

Cash Services Headquarters
  
2000 NW Corporate Boulevard

jobs.description:
**Description**


Are you motivated by the satisfaction of positively affecting someone’s day?!


As a Part\-Time Sales Representative you will be responsible for greeting and assisting customers, maintaining a neat, maintain in stock of merchandise, organized and clean sales floor promoting the Northern Tool credit card program, selling extended service protection plans on qualifying items, and supporting the management team with day\-to\-day store merchandise and operations directions. At Northern Tool \+ Equipment we get up every day to serve the tradespeople who keep our country running strong and the weekend warriors who want to work like them. It’s our mission to make sure they have the right tools for the job, and an easy, hassle\-free experience at our store so they can get in, get out and get on with the job at hand. Your positive and professional attitude contributes to our winning culture and makes sure we leave a lasting impression.  



  

Role Specific Details:

* Schedule Requirements: Open Availability


Key Responsibilities:

* Create a one\-stop shopping experience with exceptional customer service, ask probing inquiries to better understand the customer's needs.
* Greeting customers wherever they are in the store, assisting them with product selection, merchandising aisles and endcaps, and positioning merchandise appropriately.
* Offering our Protection Plans on all eligible products and offering our credit card on all customer transactions (Incentive pay for selling protection plans and credit cards).
* Being a team player by assisting with tasks that improve the way your team serves our consumers.


What you will bring to the table:

* Prior retail sales, cashier or customer service experience admired, but not required.
* Flexible availability and willingness to work some weekends and holidays as needed.
* A love of tools \& equipment.
* Excellent communication skills.
* Ability to lift 70 Lbs.
* Service focused mindset.


About Us


Northern Tool \+ Equipment is a family business with roots stretching back three generations to Minnesota’s Iron Range, where our blue\-collar work ethic and commitment to serving the people who do the tough jobs was born. Our mission is to be the best in the world at serving the professional tradespeople and those who want to work like them. With over 130 retail stores across 24 states, top national brands and global manufacturing operations designed to create our own specialized tools and equipment, we are busting our knuckles to deliver the products, prices and advice our customers need to succeed. We’re looking for people who share our blue\-collar work ethic. If you’re the kind of person who likes to put your nose to the grindstone to help your customers and company succeed, we’d love to talk to you about becoming a member of our team.


Northern Tool \+ Equipment is proud to be recognized by Forbes as a Top Midsize Employer in 2023\. We are committed to creating a workplace where your contributions are valued, and your professional growth is encouraged. When you join our team, you’ll enjoy a comprehensive and competitive compensation package that includes:

* Competitive Pay: Earn $14\.00 \- $20\.70 hourly, with your exact compensation personalized based on your skills, experience, and location. We believe in rewarding top talent with pay that reflects your value.
* Flexible Work Schedule: Achieve the work\-life balance you deserve with our flexible scheduling, this is a part\-time position.
* Comprehensive Benefits Package: Your health and well\-being are our priority. We offer a variety of health plans, so you can choose what best fits your needs. Employees working 30\+ hours per week enjoy a robust benefits package, including medical, dental, vision, and a 401(k) plan with an enhanced company match to support your financial future.
* Generous Employee Discount: Love our products? So do we! Enjoy a significant discount on the quality tools and equipment we offer, helping you save on the items you love to use.
* Get Paid on Your Terms: With our Daily Pay option, you don’t have to wait for payday—access your earnings whenever you need them for added financial flexibility.
* Holidays and Time Off: We believe in giving our team time to relax and recharge. Our stores are closed on Easter, Thanksgiving, and Christmas, ensuring you can enjoy these special occasions with your loved ones. Additionally, we operate with reduced hours on five other federal holidays, recognizing the importance of personal time. Employees working 30\+ hours per week are eligible for paid holidays and paid time off.
* Incentives: Be rewarded for eligible incentive programs.


When you join Northern Tool \+ Equipment, you're not just starting a job—you're joining a community that supports your success. Come be a part of a team where your skills, dedication, and passion are recognized and celebrated. Your future starts here!

jobs.title: Community Manager
jobs.description:
TriBridge Residential is seeking a **Community Manager** for our Collier Trailside property, located in West Midtown Atlanta.  

The ideal candidate will be responsible for managing the day\-to\-day operations of our apartment community, adhering to the company's policies and procedures. We are looking for a candidate who brings enthusiasm, passion, and a creative spirit to help ensure the team's success.

**Job Summary**: The Community Manager will successfully execute the property’s leasing strategy, financial plan, and operating budget. This includes marketing, budgeting, operations, team management, and development.

 **Essential Functions:**

* Provide daily leadership and direction to the team. Ensure that all leasing tasks are performed according to established guidelines and that all associates receive appropriate training.
* Manage community operations to achieve expense and income levels in alignment with monthly, quarterly, and annual budget goals. \-  

 Communicate effectively with residents, addressing and resolving issues as they arise while involving additional resources when necessary.
* Manage and schedule the team, contractors, and vendors to ensure efficient turnover of vacant units, maintenance and repairs, and upkeep of common areas.
* Oversee collections, rent postings, and deposits to ensure they are completed in a timely and accurate manner.
* Supervise leasing operations to confirm that applications and paperwork are accurate and comply with company policies and guidelines.
* Demonstrate an ongoing understanding and commitment to fair housing, equal employment, and diversity policies.
* Ensure all staff members are appropriately trained on federal, state, and local Fair Housing laws.

**Knowledge and Experience:**

* A bachelor’s degree is preferred.
* A minimum of three years of experience in multifamily property management, with progressively increasing responsibilities.
* Proficiency in MS Office applications (Outlook, Word, and Excel) as well as property management software, preferably Yardi.
* Excellent organizational skills with the ability to work independently while maintaining high accuracy and productivity.
* A strong customer service orientation and effective oral and written communication skills, along with a positive and professional attitude.
* Ability to read and interpret documents such as leases, operating instructions, and procedure manuals.
* Ability to pass a background check and drug screening while maintaining a record that satisfies these requirements.

Quality Craftsmen is a recognized leader in bathroom remodeling, delivering exceptional products, professional installations, and outstanding customer service. We believe top performers deserve to be rewarded for their results. That's why we provide the resources, support, and earning potential necessary to build a long\-term, six\-figure career.

**Apply Today**
---------------


If you're looking for a sales opportunity where your earnings are driven by your performance, not limited by a salary cap, this is the role for you.


Join Quality Craftsmen and build a career with unlimited income potential, pre\-qualified leads, and a company committed to your success.

For over 75 years, Ashley Furniture has been the largest home furnishings manufacturer, transforming homes worldwide. The Local Customer Success (LCS) Lead is a frontline operational leader who guides agents in their daily work, answers process and approval questions, and supports consistent execution across LCS day\-of\-delivery activities. The role provides real\-time support for VIP deliveries, same\-day and next\-day saves, store support, proactive communication, customer and driver chats, case work, and escalations. Maintain reliable attendance.

What You Bring  


Legally authorized to work in the US

Extended health, dental benefits, and vision insurance

Austin Powder is seeking a Business Development Representative focused on new business development to accelerate revenue growth across construction, quarry, and industrial blasting markets. This role is responsible for identifying, qualifying, and securing new accounts while converting customers to APC’s preferred product and service offerings, including emulsions, electronic initiation systems, technical solutions and blasting services.  

  

This position will execute APC’s commercial strategy through outbound prospecting, structured pipeline management, and value\-based selling. * Lead preparation of proposals, ROI discussions, and competitive bids.

* Strengthen APC’s reputation by delivering consistent, professional messaging aligned with corporate positioning and commercial strategy.

**Core Knowledge \& Business Acumen**

* Maintain strong understanding of explosives applications, customer production cycles, and key industry drivers.
* Develop working knowledge of pricing models, margin expectations, and cost\-to\-serve considerations.
* Represent APC’s brand, values, and professionalism in all customer engagements.

**Core Competencies**

* **Hunter Sales Mindset:** Demonstrated ability to prospect, qualify, and close new business.
* **Commercial Acumen:** Strong negotiation skills, ability to articulate value, and comfort navigating extended buying cycles and complex customer decision\-making structures.
* **Technical Aptitude:** Ability to learn blasting fundamentals, product specifications, relevant software tools and applications, and regulatory requirements.
* **Execution Discipline:** Proficient in CRM use, pipeline management, and structured sales processes.

* **Resilience \& Adaptability:** Thrives in field\-based, fast\-paced environments; persistent and self\-motivated.

* Valid driver’s license and ability to travel extensively within assigned territory.
* Strong CRM proficiency and familiarity with structured sales processes.

-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------

**Vonage Communications APIs:**
-------------------------------



As an emerging leader in the $10B\+ communications API market, we empower global brands to connect better with their customers, employees, and partners through transformative communications experiences. For example, Vonage API solutions empower organizations to build their custom omnichannel communications structure. This allows them to reach and engage customers on their preferred schedule and channel — including voice, video, and messaging. Think of a rideshare service instantly connecting with customers, hospital staff conducting remote monitoring, customers verifying their identity before completing a purchase, AI virtual agents servicing customers around the clock, and much more.


**Why this role matters:**
--------------------------



As an Outbound Sales Development Representative (SDR), you'll be the first point of contact for potential customers, playing a crucial role in generating and qualifying new sales opportunities. Your primary goal is to identify prospects, assess their needs, and schedule meetings with the sales team to drive pipeline growth.  

This role provides tremendous career growth opportunities within Vonage. We expect our SDRs to develop their sales careers and advance within the organization.


**Your key responsibilities:**
------------------------------


* Identify and qualify new sales opportunities through outbound prospecting, including calls, emails, and LinkedIn outreach.
* Leverage sales tools such as LinkedIn Sales Navigator and CRM software to research and engage with potential customers.
* Customize outreach strategies by researching prospects' goals, market trends, and pain points.
* Educate prospects on how Vonage API solutions can address their business challenges.
* Maintain detailed records of customer interactions and insights in our CRM system.
* Collaborate with marketing, account managers, and sales leadership to refine messaging and improve sales strategies.
* Consistently achieve and exceed monthly targets for qualified meetings and new opportunities.

**What you'll bring**
---------------------


* A proactive and determined mindset with a passion for delivering solutions to customers.
* Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage high volumes of outreach efficiently.
* Excellent communication skills \- both written and verbal \- with a strong ability to listen and engage.
* A highly collaborative approach with a focus on teamwork and shared success.
* Creativity in prospecting strategies and the ability to take initiative.
* Proven ability to meet and exceed ambitious targets.
* Previous experience in Sales Development, particularly in a fast\-paced SaaS environment, is preferred. However, we welcome candidates eager to develop their sales careers.
* Familiarity with Salesforce, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, and other sales tools is an advantage.

**Where you will work:**
------------------------


* Hybrid work in Atlanta, GA
* Legal authorization to work in the USA is required. We are unable to sponsor individuals for employment visas, now or in the future, for this job opening.
* This is a salaried role and would be part of our Commission Compensation structure. The overall compensation would be based on a 70/30 split.
