jobs.title: Youth Program Coordinator (High School - Academics)
jobs.description:
**Project: VISION is a nonprofit organization with a mission to help youth of Chicago’s Greater Chinatown community achieve their full potential by providing them with tools for educational, personal, and civic development. PV serves over 500 middle and high school youth each year out of its two Chinatown youth centers as well as three local school\-based sites. We are seeking a mission\-driven, creative, and energetic individual to join our team and serve as a Youth Program Coordinator within our High School Scholars Program.**

**The ideal candidate is committed to our mission and has experience and passion for working with young people. They are also driven by a growth mindset and thrive in a fast\-paced, impact\-based work environment.** 

The Youth Program Coordinator’s role will focus on supporting youths’ academic achievement via after school tutoring and enrichment programs. These programs aim to help youth build foundational knowledge and effective study skills and habits, which promote high school graduation and college access and success. The Coordinator will also work collaboratively with other team members to support other program components such as service learning and leadership programs.

The primary responsibilities of the Youth Program Coordinator will include the following:

* Oversee the daily after school tutoring program
* Facilitate day to day tutoring activities, ensuring that all students are engaged with their homework and getting the support that they need from their assigned tutors
* Supervise and facilitate the workflow of Lead Tutors and Tutors
* Develop and implement weekly academic enrichment activities, which strengthen student knowledge and skills in core high school subjects
* Coach and mentor a cohort of 20\-30 youth who experience academic challenges, including English Language Learners, by holding regular one\-on\-one goal\-setting and check\-in meetings with each youth
* Ensure accurate and thorough documentation of students’ academic activities and progress
* Understand the process and performance metrics that need to be captured for program evaluation and support program evaluation by collecting data and utilizing evaluation tools:
* Track weekly student attendance and follow up with students to encourage consistent attendance and participation
* Collect and evaluate students’ quarterly grades, and coordinate additional academic support or interventions for students as needed
* Report program data and metrics via PV or funder designated tracking and reporting tools
* Train and evaluate Lead Tutors, Tutors, and volunteers, setting up and leading 1:1 meetings for feedback loops and continuous support/improvement, including, but not limited to hosting development sessions on best practices for tutoring and mentoring
* Recruit and enroll youth into the program
* Conduct outreach and build partnerships and collaborations with other local organizations and schools when needed as well as host community building events for youth
* Communicate with youth about program expectations and standards and create improvement plans with youth as needed

Other responsibilities include:

* Support other program activities when needed, including coordinating service learning activities and leadership workshops in collaboration with other Program Coordinators
* Provide administrative support to service and leadership programs, including student recruitment, data collection, and other grant compliance and administrative tasks
* Work with the Parent Engagement Coordinator to engage parents with regular communications and other supports
* Work with the Case Manager to identify youth who may need additional external services (e.g. supporting mental health, basic needs, etc.) and help coordinate access to resources as needed
* Help identify program improvement needs and implement program improvement plans
* Attend and actively participate in team meetings
* Attend trainings regularly to stay abreast of best practices in youth programming as well as to meet funder requirements
* Create and implement a 6\- week summer program, lesson planning, record keeping, and field trip planning for approximately 40\-45 youth participants, ages 14\-15 years old.

**Qualifications:** 

* Bachelor's degree required
* Minimum of 1 year of experience working with high school youth required
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office tools and Google applications
* Minimum of conversational spoken Chinese Cantonese and/or Mandarin highly preferred
* Other qualifications for consideration will be:
* Demonstrated strong interest in a nonprofit career in youth development
* Values alignment with the organization, including commitment to its mission and goals and the issues of AAPI and immigrant youth and families and the local Chinatown community
* Ability to problem solve, offering ideas and suggestions while working with team members to overcome challenges
* Self\-driven work ethic and resilience as demonstrated by exhibiting ownership of projects, taking initiative, and able to adapt to shifting priorities and needs of the organization
* Strong organizational skills with attention to detail and capacity to manage multiple projects and occasional high volume of work with efficiency and without sacrificing quality
* Positive attitude with ability to problem solve in the face of challenges and turn negative outcomes into learning opportunities as well as using feedback to implement changes as needed
* Comfortability with working independently but also able to work in a team environment and willing to ask for help when needed
* Strong verbal and written communication skills along with strong interpersonal skills
* Understanding of restorative justice and implementation within a program as well as conflict resolution skills
* Experience managing others, including providing training, supervision, and feedback to team members

**To apply, please send a cover letter and resume to us via email at careers@proje

jobs.title: Clinical Research Coordinator I
jobs.description:
**Location:** Chicago, Illinois


**Business Unit:** Rush Medical Center


**Hospital:** Rush University Medical Center


**Department:** Orthopedic Surgery\-Res Adm


**Work Type:** Restricted Part Time (Total FTE less than 0\.5\)


**Shift: Shift 1**

**Work Schedule:** 4 Hr (8:00:00 AM \- 4:00:00 PM)


**Rush offers exceptional rewards and benefits learn more at our** Rush benefits page (https://www.rush.edu/rush\-careers/employee\-benefits).


**Pay Range:** $23\.12 \- $32\.66 per hour
  

Rush salaries are determined by many factors including, but not limited to, education, job\-related experience and skills, as well as internal equity and industry specific market data. The pay range for each role reflects Rush’s anticipated wage or salary reasonably expected to be offered for the position. Offers may vary depending on the circumstances of each case.


Job Summary:
  

The Clinical Research Coordinator I (CRC I) supports the conduct of clinical research studies across a range of disciplines. Receives direction from principal investigator, supervisor, or other staff involved in research protocol(s). Responsibilities include participant recruitment and interaction, study data collection and entry, maintenance of study and regulatory documentation, sponsor communication, and adherence to study protocols and policies. The CRC I executes defined study tasks with guidance, ensuring operational compliance, accurate data entry, and participant safety. Exemplifies the Rush mission, vision and values and acts in accordance with Rush policies and procedures.


Required Job Qualifications:
  

Education:
  

* Bachelor’s degree

Experience:
  

* 0\-2 years of experience in a research study or other relevant experience

OR
  

Experience (in lieu of a degree)
  

* Two (2\) years’ total experience, where 1 year is supporting or coordinating research studies

  

Knowledge, Skills, \& Abilities:
  

* Time Management – Ability to meet deadlines and manage assigned study tasks.
* Problem\-Solving – Ability to troubleshoot routine field issues and use discretion to escalate appropriately when unplanned events arise.
* Attention to Detail – Strong attention to accuracy in data collection and documentation.
* Participant Relations – Ability to build rapport, navigate sensitive topics, and maintain participant confidentiality.
* Communication Skills – Effective verbal and written communication skills with participants and internal study teams.
* Team Collaboration – Ability to collaborate within multi\-disciplinary team settings and follow established workflows.
* Flexibility – Availability to work evenings, overnight shifts, or weekends if required by study protocols.
* Travel Readiness – Availability for local travel as necessary.
* Other duties as assigned.

  

Preferred Job Qualifications:
  

Experience:
  

* Two (2\) or more years prior experience in clinical research or related field
Job Responsibilities:
  

1\. Recruits, consents, screens, schedules, tracks and provides study updates to study participants throughout the conduct of the study.
  

2\. Collects and enters data into study case report forms and/or electronic data capture system and responds to queries in a timely manner.
  

3\. Assists in preparing simple data summaries, reports, or charts to support study documentation and reporting requirements.
  

4\. Maintains accurate and complete procedural documentation including study participant and site level documentation in compliance with institutional, local, state and federal guidelines and regulations related to clinical research.
  

5\. Verifies data against 100% of source documentation for accuracy before entry into case report forms and electronic data capture systems to ensure timeliness and audit readiness.
  

6\. May collect, process and ship potentially biohazardous specimens.
  

7\. Administers structured tests and questionnaires according to research study protocols. May utilize study\-related technology and equipment as part of assessment procedures.
  

8\. Provide ongoing study status updates and responds to questions from PI, Administrator, department stakeholders, Sponsor and Compliance throughout the conduct of the study.
  

9\. Maintains study flow by communicating promptly with study participants and coordinating with study team members as directed.
  

10\. Participate in auditing and monitoring visits. Gather and communicate unanticipated problems (protocol deviations, adverse events, and serious adverse events).
  

11\. Work with PI(s), sponsor, compliance, clinical staff and/or manager to identify and improve routine processes as it relates to the conduct of the research study.
  

12\. Other duties as assigned.  

  

  



Rush is an equal opportunity employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status, and other legally protected characteristics.

jobs.title: LTL Operations Coordinator
jobs.description:
FLS Transportation is seeking a highly organized and customer\-focused LTL Operations Coordinator to join our growing LTL team. This role is responsible for managing the day\-to\-day execution of LTL shipments and ensuring a seamless customer experience from quote to delivery. The ideal candidate will be detail\-oriented, proactive, and capable of handling multiple priorities in a fast\-paced transportation environment.  

  

The LTL Operations Coordinator will oversee daily operational activities including rate quoting, shipment booking, tracking and tracing, customer communication, invoicing, and claims management. This individual will work closely with carriers, customers, sales teams, and internal stakeholders to ensure efficient and profitable transportation solutions.

 **Responsibilities:**

  

**Operations Management**


* Manage all daily LTL shipment activities from order receipt through delivery.
* Prepare and provide accurate and competitive customer rate quotes.
* Book and dispatch LTL shipments with approved carrier partners.
* Coordinate pickups, deliveries, appointment scheduling, and special service requirements.
* Ensure shipment information is entered accurately into transportation management systems (TMS).


**Tracking \& Customer Support**


* Monitor shipments from pickup through final delivery.
* Proactively track and trace shipments to identify potential service issues or delays.
* Communicate shipment updates to customers and internal stakeholders.
* Resolve service failures and coordinate corrective actions with carriers.


**Invoicing \& Financial Administration**

jobs.title: Client Experience Coordinator
jobs.description:
Let's be honest: families don't remember the name of a scheduling system. They remember the person who made their week easier.



At North Shore Pediatric Therapy, that person is the Family Child Advocate (FCA) — the calm in the chaos, the voice of reassurance, the behind\-the\-scenes orchestrator ensuring every child gets the care they deserve and every clinician walks into a day that runs smoothly.



Here, FCAs are trusted partners to families, real\-time problem solvers, and key players in providing the exceptional experience NSPT is known for. When a parent is overwhelmed, a child needs an urgent reschedule, or a clinic is juggling 30 moving pieces at once… **you're the one who turns stress into solutions.**



This is a **full\-time, in\-center position** with a **schedule of 7:00 AM – 3:30 PM****.** You'll primarily work from our Chicago (Bucktown), IL location. Approximately 50% of your time will be spent in the community building relationships. Compensation ranges from $21\-25 per hour, based on experience and qualifications.


**Why This Role Matters**
-------------------------



Every hour of therapy counts — for a child learning to eat independently, say their sibling's name, or build the confidence they've never had before. You make those moments possible by keeping schedules full, communication clear, and families supported.



Across our centers, our therapists, Clinical Directors, and families will tell you the same thing: "I don't know what we'd do without our FCA."


**Who Thrives in This Role**
----------------------------


* A natural helper who finds joy in making someone's day smoother.
* A multitasker who can juggle 10 moving pieces without losing the warmth in their voice.
* A communicator who knows how to spin chaos into clarity.
* A schedules\-and\-systems thinker who loves finding the fastest path to a solution.
* A relationship\-builder who wants families to feel seen, supported, and appreciated.


If this sounds like you, we encourage you to apply!


**What** **You'll** **Do**
--------------------------


**Family Experience \& Operations**


* Be the go\-to support for families (schedule changes, questions, updates)
* Turn cancellations into makeups and keep schedules running smoothly
* Make real\-time adjustments as things shift
* Partner with Clinical Directors and therapists
* Keep the clinic organized, stocked, and running efficiently


**Marketing \& Growth (****50%)**


* Support local outreach efforts (schools, events, community partners)
* Help coordinate and host tours for prospective families
* Assist with center events and family engagement initiatives
* Drive online reputation (reviews, testimonials, family follow\-ups)
* Partner with leadership on simple, high\-impact marketing efforts
* Be the face of the center in the community

**Why** **You'll** **Love Working Here**
----------------------------------------



You're not just managing logistics — you're shaping a family's entire experience of therapy. You'll join a supportive team, build real relationships with families, and play a vital part in helping kids access the care they need.



If you're looking for a role where every day is meaningful and every detail matters, we'd love to talk.

jobs.title: Executive Assistant
jobs.description:
**About SLHeeley Tax**

SLHeeley Tax provides individuals and businesses with reliable, affordable tax preparation, bookkeeping, and payroll services. We are a close\-knit, highly collaborative team consisting of our President (who leads tax preparation and bookkeeping), our Vice President (who steers our HR, office management, and administrative operations), an additional tax accountant, 5 bookkeepers, 2 dedicated assistants, and an office coordinator.

**We are currently hiring for an Executive Assistant to the Vice President who will serve as the right hand to the VP.**

We pride ourselves on maintaining a low\-key, laid\-back environment with a relaxed, family feel. Our team is a group of sarcastic and snarky people who genuinely enjoy working together. If you prefer a workplace with absolute corporate stiffness, we are probably not the right fit. But if you have thick skin, appreciate good wit, and want an office where you can truly be yourself, you will fit right in.

**Why Join Us? (The Perks)**

* **The "No\-Fridays" Off\-Season:** Enjoy incredible work\-life balance! From May through December, our office is completely closed on Fridays.
* **Relaxed Dress Code:** We are strictly business\-casual even during the tax rush (jeans paired with a nice top, sweater, or an official SLHeeley sweatshirt).
* **Supportive, Educational Leadership:** Our Vice President is a patient, approachable former teacher who loves to guide, answer questions, and help you learn. Management will gradually add new things to your plate as you master tasks.
* **Growth\-Driven, Adaptive Roles:** Your compensation and daily focus will scale directly with your capabilities. We start pay on the standard end, but as you master tasks and take more off leadership's plate **during your initial 4 months with us, your hourly pay will increase.** These positions are built to adapt over time; as we see which high\-level aspects of the VP’s workload you can confidently take over, we will reshape the roles to lean into your personal strengths and maximize firm efficiency.
* **Annual July 1st Pay Reviews:** Following your initial onboarding period, we provide a yearly pay increase based on overall performance, evaluated every year on **July 1st**.
* **Annual Performance Bonus:** Every February, we award a year\-end bonus based on a percentage of your salary that scales upward based on management evaluation and the unique value you brought to the table throughout the year.
* **Robust Health Benefits:** We offer Blue Cross Blue Shield (BCBS) PPO and HMO health insurance plans, and **we cover 50% of the employee\-only premium.**
* **Generous Paid Time Off:** 10 paid days off for scheduled holiday office closures PLUS approximately 66 hours of individual PTO in your first year.

**Work Schedule \& Seasonal Realities**

Our workflow operates like a pendulum, and you must be comfortable managing both extremes:

* **Tax Season (January – April):** It is busy, high\-energy, and non\-stop. You will work 50–60 hours per week (with guaranteed time\-and\-a\-half overtime pay for all hours over 40\).
* *Standard office hours:* Monday – Friday, 9:00 AM – 5:00 PM.
* *Extended hours:* The office stays open late on **Mondays and Tuesdays until 8:00 PM**, and is open for **six Saturdays total (4 hours each)**. These shifts are **split across our entire 3\-person administrative team**, keeping your individual schedule fair. Exact schedule is finalized together as an Admin Team in December to give you time to plan for evening and Saturday hours.
* *Note on Leadership Presence:* The VP and President are remote a few days every week, making your role as an on\-site anchor and gatekeeper incredibly important.
* **Off\-Season (Mid\-April – December):** The office shifts to a quiet, slow, and relaxed pace. You will work 35–40 hours per week across a highly flexible Monday through Thursday schedule (Closed Fridays).

**Core Responsibilities**

**Process Improvement \& Workflow Optimization**

* Manage and track the internal flow of tax returns ensuring documents move efficiently from intake through final delivery.
* Manage secure electronic delivery of client tax returns to clients.
* Assist with tax return assembly, including organizing and cleaning up client documents electronically and manually.
* Compile tax return folders, handle year\-end mailings (including organizers), and respond to general inquiries regarding past, current, or pending returns.
* Bring an active eye for optimization; analyze current office flows, brainstorm creative ways to improve existing administrative systems, and help streamline office operations.

**Executive Support \& Client Relations**

* Serve as the primary communication liaison and professional gatekeeper for the VP, communicating with clients on their behalf regarding tax, administrative, or bookkeeping updates.
* Screen incoming correspondence, manage executive calendars, and accurately assess leadership availability.
* Draft memos on business topics and assist with special projects for senior leadership.
* Handle customer complaints with patience, provide appropriate solutions within time limits, and follow up to ensure total client satisfaction.
* Communicate with vendors on behalf of Executive Team.

* Serve as backup support for the Front Desk when necessary.
* Assist with Human Resources (HR) duties.

**Skills and Qualifications**

* **Experience:** 3\+ years of office administration or professional assistant experience required. Experience working within a CPA, accounting, or tax firm is highly preferred.
* **Software Savvy:** Highly computer literate and proficient with Microsoft Office products. Familiarity w

**Catering Operations Manager**

Hours: Tuesday\-Saturday


Customary Days: Sunday through Saturday


Customary Hours: Varies to include evenings, holidays, and extended hours as needed.


Location: Chicago,IL

**About One Off Hospitality:**


For almost 30 years, One Off Hospitality has developed and operated some of Chicago’s most beloved places to eat and drink. More importantly, we’re a group of people – chefs, hospitality veterans, managers and creators – who believe in the power of treating our guests like family and our restaurants like home.

**Job Summary**


The Operations Manager is responsible for overseeing the successful execution of off\-premise catering events from planning through completion. This position manages event logistics, staffing, food and equipment transportation, setup and breakdown, client service, and operational standards. The ideal candidate is highly organized, solutions\-oriented, and comfortable managing multiple events, teams, and priorities in a fast\-paced environment.

**Responsibilities**:


* Oversee daily catering operations and ensure events are executed efficiently, professionally, and according to company standards.
* Coordinate all operational details for off\-premise events, including staffing, transportation, equipment, food, rentals, setup, service, and breakdown.
* Review event orders and production sheets to ensure all event requirements are understood and properly communicated.
* Develop staffing plans and schedules based on event size, service style, location, and operational needs.
* Recruit, train, supervise, and evaluate catering staff, servers, bartenders, captains, porters, and event support personnel.
* Lead event teams onsite and serve as the primary operations contact for staff, vendors, venues, and clients when required.
* Collaborate with the warehouse manager to ensure food, beverage, equipment, décor, and supplies are accurately loaded, transported, delivered, and returned.
* Collaborate with the warehouse manager to establish and maintain efficient systems for loading vehicles, inventory control, equipment organization, and event breakdown.
* Monitor labor costs, overtime, product usage, and operational expenses while maintaining service quality.
* Coordinate with culinary, sales, event planning, and administrative teams to ensure seamless communication and execution.
* Troubleshoot event\-day issues and make quick, professional decisions when unexpected challenges arise.
* Maintain high standards for food safety, sanitation, personal appearance, customer service, and workplace safety.
* Conduct post\-event reviews and identify opportunities to improve efficiency, profitability, and guest experience.
* Manage relationships with venues, rental companies, staffing agencies, transportation providers, and other operational partners.
* Coordinate with the warehouse to ensure all company vehicles, catering equipment, tools, and supplies are properly maintained and accounted for.
* Assist with forecasting operational needs and developing procedures that support company growth.
* Attend menu meetings, sales meetings, and production meetings as scheduled
* Attend networking events
* Perform other duties as assigned

**Required Qualifications**

**Skills and Traits for Success:**

* Highly organized with strong attention to detail and reliable follow through
* A customer\-centered approach to hospitality
* Knowledge of current industry trends
* Strong creative, presentation, and problem\-solving skills
* Creative skills to provide innovative solutions and strong presentation skills
* Ability to work collaboratively with staff, vendors, and cross\-functional teams
* Experience working with Microsoft Office, Tripleseat, Canva,7shifts, Gmail, Google Docs or similar programs a plus

**Required Education/Experience:**

**Qualifications**

* 3–5\+ years of experience in catering, hospitality, events, restaurant operations, or a related field.
* Previous management or supervisory experience.
* Experience with off\-premise catering and event execution strongly preferred.
* Strong organizational and time\-management skills.
* Ability to manage multiple events and priorities simultaneously.
* Excellent communication and leadership skills.
* Ability to remain calm and make decisions under pressure.
* Strong understanding of staffing, event logistics, and customer service.
* Comfortable working evenings, weekends, holidays, and extended hours based on event schedules.
* Valid driver’s license with a clean driving record, if driving company vehicles is required.
* Food safety certification such as ServSafe is preferred.
* Ability to lift and move catering equipment and supplies, typically up to 50 lbs.


Key Performance Indicators
Success in this role will be measured by:

* Successful, on\-time execution of events
* Client satisfaction and retention
* Labor cost management
* Accurate event staffing
* Minimal equipment/product loss
* Operational efficiency
* Staff performance and retention
* Food safety and compliance
* Effective communication between departments
* Profitability of catered events


Physical Requirements

* Regularly required to communicate with clients, team members, and vendors in person and by phone
* Frequently required to stand, walk, and use hands for office and event\-related activities

jobs.description:
**Division Information**  

The Pet Care business unit of Spectrum Brands is based in St. Louis, Missouri with distribution, manufacturing and sales offices throughout the US and globe. Owners of dogs, cats, birds, small animals, fish and reptiles rely on our brands for exceptional value and trusted results. Our industry\-leading brands include Tetra®, Instant Ocean®, Marineland®, 8\-in\-1®, Dingo®, FURminator®, Nature’s Miracle®, GloFish®, DreamBone® and SmartBones®.

 **Job Summary**  

The Associate National Account Manager will lead all activities related to sales and relationship growth, including strategic development, presentation creation, analysis, forecasting, and tactical preparation related to calls and events.



The region consists of several key Retail, Wholesale and Distributor partners including Super Valu, AWG, Winco, Hy\-Vee, and various other customers.

 **Primary Duties \& Responsibilities** *Procedures\-70%*


* Developing profitable strategies that will maximize the Spectrum Brands SKU listing and create a best\-in\-class assortment for our consumers.
* Lead development of annual quotas and profit plan.
* Create sales action plans; monitor actual results vs. plan throughout the year, adjusting and adapting as needed to maximize top\-line sales and bottom\-line profitability.
* Learn and utilize Category Management and Fact\-Based Selling concepts to uncover whitespace opportunities for Strategic Accounts.
* Manage the Broker partnership to effectively complete all administrative forms, programs, resets, or projects necessary.
* Partner with the Brand, Product and Trade Marketing teams to identify and evaluate new product ideas.
* Build and deliver specific presentations for line reviews, programs, mid\-season updates, etc. that align with Spectrum Brands mission and vision.
* Build and closely manage relationships with customers at the buyer level and beyond to create or enhance the partnership.
* Provide the team leader with regular updates of total POS performance vs. prior year same period, identifying sales trends and opportunities.


*Promotion\-25%*


* Develop the annual Omni\-Channel promotional plan to maximize sales opportunities by having the right product, in the right quantity, at the right time.
* Use data analysis (AC Nielsen, Comp market data, Store Level POS, etc.) to assist in the coordination of promotional plans. Integrate national promotional plans (FSI’s, IRC’s, etc.) into the promotional plan as applicable.
* Recommend and assist development of unique Omni\-Channel promotional ideas.
* Evaluate the performance of all promotions, including those from our competitors.
* Accurate and timely forecast with Demand and Supply Planning to guarantee on\-time delivery.
* Develop and coordinate the plan for product delivery and merchandising.


*Pricing\-5%*


* Develop sales strategies, programs, and plans that will maximize the Spectrum Brands SKU listing.
* Identify opportunities from within the existing Spectrum Brands line that will achieve the "best practice" scenario and recommend additions.
* Analyze retailer GM by SKU and retain a running average weighted margin. Evaluate against industry standards, customer goals, and competition. Recommend pricing and programs that will achieve the customer goals and maximize the Spectrum Brands AGM.
* Develop/manage account\-specific promotional plan, coordinating with finance, trade marketing, brand marketing and sales management to align with brand strategies and advertising plans as appropriate.
* Manage the P\&L by recommending opportunities for increased penetration; assist in accurate and timely forecasting and work with Forecasting/Demand Planning to guarantee on\-time delivery.

  

**Education and Experience Profile** *An equivalent combination of:*


* Bachelor’s degree in business or related discipline preferred.
* 5 years in retail field sales and direct account responsibility.
* A minimum of 2\-4 years’ work experience in consumer products industry.
* High level proficiency working with syndicated data or category management.

  

**Required Skills**  

* Robust analytical skills: ability to learn and use syndicated data to forecast trends and projections and analyze the effectiveness of promotional activity.
* Excellent presentation and interpersonal skills; ability to communicate effectively with all levels within the organization and customer organizations.
* Solid tactical and strategic abilities; ability to manage multiple tasks.
* Teamwork approach to accomplishing goals.
* Customer and consumer focused.
* High level of organizational skills and attention to detail.
* Strong PC skills (spreadsheet, word processing, presentations).
* Approximately 20% of travel required.

  

**Work Environment**  

* Working conditions are normal for an office sales environment. Flexible office/home office opportunities exist.
* Occasional exposure to weather when traveling.

jobs.title: Associate Account Manager, Enterprise
jobs.description:
**About Grubhub**

  

At Grubhub, we believe food is more than just a meal: It’s a source of discovery, connection, and pure enjoyment. There’s a time and place for every type of dish, from hidden neighborhood gems to tried\-and\-true favorites, and we exist to connect people with the food they love in all the ways they like to dig in. We’ve been at it since 2004, but now, as part of Wonder, Grubhub is operating with a renewed sense of momentum and the high\-velocity energy of a powerhouse startup.

  

As a leading U.S. ordering and delivery marketplace, we feature over 415,000 merchants in more than 4,000 cities, creating the ultimate food experience by elevating online ordering through innovative restaurant technology, easy\-to\-use platforms, and an improved delivery experience. We are constantly finding new ways to innovate—from integrated grocery delivery with groceries powered by Instacart to exclusive loyalty programs. Join our team, based out of New York City and Chicago, and help us give our diners the exceptional value they deserve.

 **About The Opportunity**


The Associate Account Manager role is the main point of contact for Grubhub Enterprise Marketplace franchise group accounts. You will be tasked with developing successful client partnerships by overseeing experiences and expectations while building the value of Grubhub and its affiliate sites.

  

Your goals will focus on launch, retention, account maintenance, and revenue generation of franchised accounts. Working with internal stakeholders, you will be responsible for coordinating across multiple internal teams to help ensure a successful launch. Post\-launch, you will be communicating with clients on a regular basis, maintaining a high retention rate of your portfolio, as well as exploring ways to grow each account.

  

This role requires the keen ability to assess, triage, diagnose and prescribe solutions to support our restaurant partners in a variety of ad hoc scenarios. You are expected to work both as a collaborative team member and an autonomous and independently critical thinker when the situation calls.

  



**The Impact You Will Make**
----------------------------

* Serve as day to day point of contact for Franchisees and Franchise groups
* Upsell Franchise Partners on rate increases, marketing opportunities, and new tools/features
* Have ownership on accurate account information and pipeline in Salesforce
* Collaborate with the Account Manager with compiling and presenting information for Quarterly Business Reviews and strategic client meetings
* Participate in weekly client calls with the Account Manager
* Execute individual and regional marketing campaigns for Franchise Partners
* Increase revenue across book of business and reduce cancellations/attritions
* Manage external restaurant trainings and operational efficiencies
* Monitor market closures: special events, holidays, natural disaster notifications
* Follow\-up on inbound requests from clients or the Grubhub Care Team
* Route all escalations in a timely manner to correct internal departments and ensure proper expectations are set and met with Franchise Partners

**What You Bring to the Table**
-------------------------------

* Bachelor’s Degree preferred or highschool diploma/GED
* 1\-2 Years in Account Management, Sales, or experience working with large clients
* Strong computer skills (MS Office, Google products) with the ability to quickly learn new software. Experience with Salesforce.com or similar and JIRA a plus
* Dynamic personality who possesses a positive attitude and desire to find mutually beneficial solutions
* Coach\-ability. Open to new ideas and continuous feedback. Constantly looking to grow your skills
* Strong verbal and written communication skills; ability to communicate clearly, appropriately, and professionally to clients/internal audiences
* Expertise in problem\-solving skills – identifying root causes, customer needs, and providing solutions quickly and efficiently in real\-time
* Confident making outbound dials on the phone
* Passion for working in a fast\-paced, evolving environment
* Experience working with or selling to restaurant owners a plus

  

Our hybrid model requires 3 days a week in the office. That said, many team members choose to come in more often to take advantage of in\-person collaboration and connection. You're welcome—and encouraged—to be in the office up to 5 days a week if it works for you.

  

\#LI\- hybrid

  

We reward our Sales positions with competitive pay. For this role, we offer uncapped commission with a base salary range as outlined below.

  

Illinois: $44,800\-56,000 ( $56,000\- $70,000 OTE range)


DC, California, Massachussets: $49,280 \- $61,500 ($61,500 \- $77,000 OTE Range)


Wonder uses geographic\-specific salary structures, which means the salary offered may vary depending on where the job is located. The final salary offer will take into account various factors, such as the candidate's skills, education, training, credentials, and experience.

**Benefits**

  

The benefits applicable to this role include a competitive compensation package with equity and a 401(k). We also offer a choice of medical, dental, and vision plans, company paid short and long term disability coverage, paid time off including flexible time off for exempt employees, paid vacation for non\-exempt employees, and paid sick leave in compliance with applicable law in addition to paid parental leave, discounted meals and exclusive perks across the Wonder family of brands.

  

Eligibility, effective dates, and available plan options vary by employment classification and location. To learn more about benefits for this role, visit our Careers page here.

 **A Final Note**


At Wonder, we build the best teams by hiring with an objective lens — evaluating people for their potential while championing diversity, equity, and inclusion. We do not discriminate based on race, color, religion, gender identity

jobs.description:

RXO is a leading provider of transportation solutions. With cutting\-edge technology at the center, we're revolutionizing the industry with our massive network and commitment to finding solutions for every challenge. We create more efficient ways for shippers and carriers to transport goods across North America.

jobs.description:
**Job description**

**Location: Los Angeles, California**

**Position Summary**


Lead and direct V\&V’s account development/management and selling efforts to assertively increase revenue and tonnage sales through national and regional Food Service chains.

**Five Primary Responsibilities**

* Develop and aggressively implement formalized plans to gain and expand sales to major/national supermarket chains and position V\&V Supremo Foods as a “value creating” supplier and business partner.
* Responsible for calling key customers, directs and coordinates the involvement of V\&V Supremo foods sales resources, brokers and distributors in selling to and supporting these customers.
* Hands on customer development and business manage with customers and other key decision makers/influencers within headquarter locations.
* Partner with Sales Managers and their sales teams to develop and manage relationships with buyers and other key decision makers/influencers at these customers’ buying/operating centers.
* Responsible for managing customer total profit and loss results. Develop, monitor and support the implementation of agreed to marketing and sales promotion plans with these customer.

**Key Activities**

* Work with the National Sales Director to identify and prioritize national Food Service chains and regional chains in target markets for growth that V\&V Supremo Foods will aggressively pursue
* For each high\-priority Food Service chain, develop and monitor/manage the implementation of an overall account plan that defines the following: specific V\&V Supremo Foods sales objectives, approved sales and marketing programs, if/where/how third\-party brokers and distributors will be used in selling to and supporting the customer, key contacts in the customer’s organization and who is responsible for developing relationships with these people, and clarifies the accountabilities and expectations of both parties for increasing V\&V Supremo Foods sales
* Proactively build senior level relationships, introduce new products, identify and gain agreement for immediate sales opportunities and marketing programs, review historical sales results and the value they have created for Food Service chains, and develop longer\-term account strategies by calling on these customers’ headquarters location.
* Establish and communicate priorities to brokers and distributors in implementing longer\-term account plans and short\-term sales plans for these national accounts.
* Partner with the Sales teams, brokers and distributors to develop and manage relationships and achieve sales goals with key individuals at these customers’ regional offices and to ensure that agreed to sales and marketing programs are effectively implemented in the field.
* Work with customer buyers and Sales Managers to develop accurate sales budgets and forecasts for designated customers.
* Responsible for resolving problems that negatively impact sales with designated customers
* Share important customer and competitor information with the Sales team.
* Provide timely and accurate reports, budgets, forecasts and other data as required.

* Responsible for complying to all Safe Quality Food (SQF) polices/procedures and requirements for position.

* Food Service national accounts revenue and tonnage attainment vs. goals

* Customer Relationship Associates
* Finance Dept.
* Other functional managers
* V\&V Supremo Foods senior management
* Other National Accounts Managers

**Skills Required**

* Knowledgeable of sales through customer warehouses, distributors, brokers and DSD.
* Able to take ownership for the Food Service business nationwide from a strategic perspective, and to drive sales with national accounts.
* Effective leader/communicator
* Strong interpersonal skills with the ability to build very good working relationships at the national account and major regional account level.
* Hands\-on and can\-do attitude
* Analytic skills, data interpretation, ability to prepare and deliver effective presentations.

**Necessary Experience**

**Requirements:**

* Outside B2B sales and proven successful track record, including national. Grocery account management experience
* 5 plus years continuous experience in Food Industry sales.
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent.

**Preferred:**

* Experience in perishables, ideally dairy.
* Experience successfully targeting the Latino and General market.
* A plus if fully fluent in English and Spanish (written and spoken)

Reporting to a Senior Account Manager, this role sits at the center of our client experience and ensures campaigns launch smoothly, perform strongly, and ultimately turn into long\-term partnerships.  

As the primary post\-sale lead for your accounts, you will guide campaigns from kickoff through reporting while partnering closely with internal teams to drive revenue and repeat business. You will combine strong client instincts, attention to detail, and a solutions\-first mindset to help clients get the most from Big Happy's platform. A white\-glove approach to service, paired with close coordination across teams, is central to succeeding in this role.
  

The ideal candidate thrives in a fast\-moving environment, enjoys building meaningful relationships, and takes pride in delivering thoughtful work that drives client success.### **Key Responsibilities**

  

* Serve as the main point of contact for brand and agency clients across all post\-sale activities, including:
	+ Leading campaign kick\-off calls with media and creative agencies to ensure creative production aligns with campaign objectives, brainstorming custom creative (Sunrises, AR, 3D, Games, etc.), reviewing production timelines, and serving as a subject matter expert on all things Big Happy
	+ Gathering campaign launch materials — assets, brand guidelines, campaign messaging, third\-party tracking, site lists, block lists, etc. — and confirming accuracy for timely launch
	+ Leading creative production with the creative team and serving as liaison between the client and internal teams to bring a client's creative vision to life while aligning with Big Happy best practices
	+ Monitoring campaign performance and providing clients with weekly reporting, with an eye toward optimizing and showing improvement week over week against client KPIs
	+ Ensuring all campaign elements are accurately tracking and flagging discrepancies with PAS, Ops, and Tech teams
	+ Building and presenting end\-of\-campaign reports with a focus on actionable learnings and recommendations that drive client renewals or incremental growth
* Partner closely with Sales, Strategy, Creative, Tech, and Ops to keep client deliverables, campaign launches, and execution on track

### **Skills, Knowledge and Experience**

  

* 2\-4 years of experience in digital advertising, ideally within an agency, publisher, or ad tech environment
* Strong understanding of the digital media ecosystem and how brands, agencies, and publishers collaborate
* Experience managing campaigns across the full lifecycle, from kickoff to reporting
* Comfort working with third\-party measurement and verification partners such as IAS, DoubleVerify, DCM, Lucid, or Nielsen, — and ability to lead troubleshooting with third\-party vendors
* Proficiency in PowerPoint, Excel, and the broader Microsoft Office suite, with the ability to translate campaign data into clear insights and compelling client narratives
* Familiarity with programmatic and managed service media environments; experience with platforms like DV360, Xandr, or The Trade Desk is a plus
* Strong organizational skills and attention to detail
* Excellent presentation skills, including public speaking, and the ability to navigate ambiguity during client conversations
* Confidence engaging with senior leadership
* A genuine commitment to white\-glove client service — proactive, resourceful, and always looking to go the extra mile
* A team\-first mindset; this role depends on working closely and effectively across departments on a daily basis
* A collaborative, solutions\-oriented approach, with a genuine interest in refining processes to drive efficiency as the company grows
* Ability to work in a friendly and respectful manner at all times with Big Happy employees, partners, and clients

  

### **Benefits**

  

* Full\-time position with a competitive base salary
* Access to benefits, including Healthcare, Dental, and Vision
* FSA/HSA matching program
* Unlimited PTO — take what you need
* Big Happy\-provided laptop
* Participation in Big Happy's stock program
* Paid Parental Leave
* Half Day Fridays (excluding Q4\)
* Team Happy camaraderie — celebrating wins, learning from challenges, and fostering continuous career growth
* A workplace culture where you can be yourself, contribute meaningfully, and be valued for your impact


  

**Location:** Chicago \| Hybrid \| 3x/week in office  


  

**Total Compensation:** $80,500 \- $97,750 includes base pay \+ bonuses.### **About Big Happy**


Big Happy is a high\-growth company that combines the next generation of DOOH \+ mobile focused creative with publisher media to create an interaction across publisher web pages that wows the modern\-day consumer and drives brand outcomes. As the leader in highly engaging 2D and 3D DOOH and mobile ad creatives, Fortune 500 brand partners are constantly tapping into our end\-to\-end mobile targeting and creative platforms to reach their audiences on the go in the physical word, or at home \- wherever they may be.

jobs.title: Account Manager
jobs.description:
A position at White Cap isn’t your ordinary job. You’ll work in an exciting and diverse environment, meet interesting people, and have a variety of career opportunities.


The White Cap family is committed to Building Trust on Every Job. We do this by being deeply knowledgeable, fully capable, and always dependable, and our associates are the driving force behind this commitment.


White Cap is hiring immediately for an **Account Manager!**


Do you want to help build America’s skyline and your own future? White Cap is North America’s leading distributor for professional contractors. We supply everything contractors need to build our nation’s remarkable construction projects, including stadiums, roads, bridges, highways, residential housing, and more. We are hiring immediately for an **Account Manager!**


*Why a* ***career*** *with White Cap?*


* **Comprehensive wellness and financial benefits:** White Cap offers excellent benefits, including Medical, Dental, Vision, 401(k) with company match, tuition reimbursement, and more! Out Account Managers have **unlimited earning potential!**
* **Relax and recharge:** We offer a generous time off package, including paid maternity and parental leave.
* **Stability:** Since 2020, White Cap has doubled in size and continues to grow.
* **Unlimited career potential:** White Cap is a stable and growing company offering unlimited career potential.
* **Love where you work:** White Cap has been certified as a *Great Place to Work* .
* **Inclusive culture:** Work in a place that values and celebrates who you are.

*An* ***Account Manager*** *at White Cap…*


* Builds relationships and develops plans to increase sales and profitability for mid\-size accounts.
* Generates viable sales leads and prospects through market and account research, sales events, networking, vendor events and computer programs. Contacts assigned and prospective accounts to secure new business.
* Develops and executes profitable business plans for managing accounts. Teams with individuals within sales and key corporate personnel to communicate account plans, pricing, and offer assistance to drive sales.
* Accountable for attaining assigned sales quota, part margin and controllable expense objectives.
* Interacts with customers, vendors, and associates to resolve customer and service related issues.
* Maintains a current and competent base of product knowledge and applies that knowledge when servicing customers.
* Maintains and submits all required sales administration reports. Regularly attends company meetings.
* Generally has 2\-5 years of experience.
* Performs other duties as assigned.
* This position requires operation of a Company Vehicle or a Personal Vehicle and such operation is done consistently more than 20% of the average work week. If selected for this position, the company will run a Motor Vehicle Record (MVR) report. A requirement of this position is an acceptable MVR report.

**Preferred Qualifications**


* Prior experience in Outside Sales to professional contractors.
* Familiarity with Company products and services.
* Spanish language proficiency.

If you’re looking to play a role in building America, consider one of our open opportunities. We can’t wait to meet you.

jobs.description:
#### **About this Position**

At Henkel, you’ll be part of an organization that’s shaping the future through innovation, sustainability and collaboration. With our trusted brands like Persil®, ‘all®, Loctite®, Snuggle®, and Schwarzkopf® and our cutting\-edge technologies, you’ll have countless opportunities to explore new paths and grow.
  

  

This position is with our Consumer Brands business unit – where we empower our employees to bring the best Laundry \& Home Care and Hair products to people around the world.
  

  

**Dare to learn new skills, advance in your career and make an impact at Henkel.**  

  

#### **What you´ll do**

* Own and grow the Ulta business, managing day\-to\-day account performance and delivering sales objectives.
* Build and maintain strong relationships with Ulta buying teams and key stakeholders.
* Lead account planning, forecasting, budgeting, and business reviews to identify growth opportunities and mitigate risks.
* Develop and execute strategies that drive distribution, placement, promotions, and retail sales.
* Leverage business insights, market trends, and competitive analysis to support decision\-making and account growth.
* Partner cross\-functionally with Sales, Marketing, Education, Supply Chain, and other internal teams to execute key initiatives and product launches.
* Operate independently, proactively solving challenges and driving continuous improvement across the business.


#### **What makes you a good fit**

* Bachelor's degree preferred or equivalent relevant experience.
* 5\+ years of sales or account management experience within the beauty industry.
* Direct Ulta account management experience strongly preferred.
* Experience managing large\-scale beauty businesses, including assortment, planogram, and retailer growth initiatives.
* Proven track record of building customer relationships and delivering sales growth.
* Strong analytical, negotiation, communication, and problem\-solving skills.
* Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel (Pivot Tables preferred), PowerPoint, and Word.
* Experience with Ulta's PIM Portal is a plus.
* Self\-starter with an entrepreneurial mindset, strong business acumen, and ambition to grow within the organization.
* Ability to travel up to 30%.


#### **Some benefits of joining Henkel**

* **Health Insurance:** affordable plans for medical, dental, vision and wellbeing starting on day 1
* **Work\-Life Balance:** Paid time off including sick, vacation, holiday and volunteer time, flexible \& hybrid work policies (depending on role), and vacation buy / sell program
* **Financial:** 401k matching, employee share plan with voluntary investment and Henkel matching shares, annual performance bonus, service awards and student loan reimbursement
* **Family Support:** 12\-week gender neutral parental leave (up to 20 weeks for parents giving birth), fertility support, adoption \& surrogacy reimbursement, discounted child and elderly care, and scholarships
* **Career Growth:** diverse national and international growth opportunities, access to thousands of skills development courses, and tuition reimbursement


The salary range for this role is **$100,000\.00 and $115,000\.00\.** This range represents the good‑faith minimum and maximum wages the Company reasonably expects to offer for this role at the time of posting. Actual compensation will be based on factors such as the candidate’s skills, experience, education, training, and work location. This posting is intended to comply with all applicable state and local pay transparency laws.  

  

Henkel does not accept unsolicited resumes from search firms or employment agencies. Unsolicited referrals and resumes are considered Henkel property and therefore, Henkel will not pay a fee for any placement resulting from the receipt of an unsolicited referral.  

  

At Henkel, we come from a broad range of backgrounds, perspectives, and life experiences. We believe the uniqueness of all our employees is the power in us. Henkel is an equal opportunity employer. jobs.title: Customer Account Manager - Schaumburg, IL
jobs.description:
**Job Description**
-------------------

**What is a Customer Account Manager (CAM)?**


At Advance Auto Parts, a Customer Account Manager (CAM) sells or oversees the selling of automotive products for repair or distribution to automotive repair shops and other commercial businesses. The CAM must be committed to inspiring our team, helping our customers succeed, and growing the business and profitability with integrity.

**Key Duties and Responsibilities**

* Work with District Leaders, General Managers and other key personnel to achieve all agreed upon goals for assigned accounts
* Implement new Commercial Sales programs, as well as support current programs
* Visit assigned accounts, making sales calls and developing approaches that best position products, services, or ideas; identify and meet the needs of commercial customers. Maintain database of account sales call activity, etc.
* Proactively communicate with Store Team on a regular basis to ensure that customer expectations concerning product availability, accuracy, and delivery timelines are realistic and being met
* Provide feedback and input to business partners regarding competitive information, merchandising suggestions, and other services to strengthen the market position of the company
* Partner in the development and retention of Commercial Parts Pros to support the Advance plan for internal growth and career opportunities
* Demonstrate an eagerness to be a team player and assist in other functions as assigned by Region and Area leaders and as needed, including, but not limited to: cleaning, organizing, stocking, operating POS equipment, truck loading/unloading, etc.

**Essential Job Skills Necessary for Success as a CAM**

* Working knowledge of Advance products and services and the ability to market those products and services to meet customer need
* Working knowledge of the APAL system, including Inventory Management and processing of Commercial account paperwork
* Working knowledge of automotive systems and traditional automotive aftermarket
* Speak and write English (Spanish a plus); communicate effectively and build strong relationships with customers, peers and upper management
* Strong presentation and verbal and written communications skills, including ability to write reports, business correspondence and procedural manuals
* Use Microsoft software effectively (Word, Excel required – PowerPoint preferred)
* Calculate figures and amounts such as discounts, percentages, sales increases, and gross profit percent
* Ability to review and analyze business reports, such as profit and loss statement (P\&L)
* Think strategically, analyze issues and options, and effectively manage and facilitate change
* Ability to work an assortment of days, evenings, and weekends as needed
* Ability to travel overnight occasionally

**Prior Experiences that Set a CAM up for Success**

* Proven sales track record with 3\-5 years related selling experience.

**Education**

* High School diploma or general education degree (GED)
* Associate’s degree or equivalent from a two\-year college or technical school preferred

**Certificates, Licenses, Registrations**

* Must have a valid driver's license and be fleet safety certified.
* ASE certification preferred, but not required

**Physical Demands**


The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by a Team Member to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.


While performing the duties of this job, the Team Member is frequently required to stand; walk; sit; use hands to finger, handle, or feel; reach with hands and arms; climb or balance; stoop, kneel, crouch, or crawl; and talk or hear. The Team Member must frequently lift and/or move up to 50 pounds and occasionally lift and/or move up to 100


pounds. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, distance vision, color vision, peripheral vision, depth perception, and ability to adjust focus.

**Work Environment**


The work environment characteristics described here are representative of those a Team Member encounters while performing the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.


While performing the duties of this job, the Team Member is occasionally exposed to wet and/or humid conditions; moving mechanical parts; high, precarious places; toxic or caustic chemicals; outside weather conditions; extreme cold; extreme heat; risk of electrical shock; explosives; and vibration. The noise level in the work environment is usually moderate.

*Position is eligible for sales commission based on individual or store performance.*


We are an Equal Opportunity Employer and do not discriminate against any employee or applicant for employment because of race, color, sex, age national origin, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, status as a veteran and basis of disability or any other federal, state or local protected class. We comply with all applicable federal, state, and local laws.
**Compensation Range**


The good faith estimate for this role is between 51,500\.00 USD and 63,100\.00 USD salary for a new team member.
The rate offered depends on a number of factors, including geographic location, experience in retail, automotive knowledge, education, leadership roles, and other skillsets ideal for this position and shift differential (if applicable).

**Benefits:** Advance Auto Parts offers a comprehensive health and wellness benefits program to improve the way of life for our Team Members and those who mean the most to them: their families. Find out more by visiting:


Advance Auto Parts\-Home

**California** **Residents click below for Privacy Notice:**


https://jobs.advanceautoparts.com/us/en/disclosures

jobs.title: Field Sales Representative
jobs.description:
GardaWorld is shaping the future of cash management! We provide our clients with solutions in every phase of their cash supply chain, including secured transportation, cash management, cash vault processing, forecasting, ATM, and cash recycler services. We are equipped with the largest fleet of armored vehicles in the industry, sophisticated technology, and an expansive network of experienced employees and innovative partners. We process, manage, and move over $8B in cash every day while delivering 24/7 client support and logistical expertise.
  
  

Field Sales Representative
  
Own a territory. Build a market. Win new business.
  
GardaWorld Cash Services is seeking a driven Field Sales Representative to expand our presence with local and regional commercial customers. This field\-based new\-business development role is designed for a true sales hunter—someone energized by opening doors, building relationships, creating opportunities, and closing profitable business.
  
You will develop your assigned territory through face\-to\-face prospecting, consultative selling, networking, referrals, and targeted outreach. By understanding how prospective customers manage cash today, you will recommend GardaWorld solutions that improve security, visibility, efficiency, and control.
  
This is not an account\-management or primarily desk\-based sales position. Success requires a consistent market presence, disciplined pipeline development, and the resilience to turn initial conversations into long\-term customer partnerships.
  
**Compensation:** $65,000 \- $75,000 base salary plus commission.
  
**Location:** Chicago, IL
  
**Travel:** Significant local and regional travel based on territory size, customer needs, and business requirements. Regular face\-to\-face prospecting and customer meetings are essential. Limited overnight travel may be required.
  
  

Responsibilities
  
* Develop and execute a new\-business sales strategy for an assigned geographic territory.
* Identify high\-potential prospects, industries, and commercial areas within the market.
* Build a qualified sales pipeline through in\-person prospecting, telephone outreach, referrals, networking, and other lead\-generation activities.
* Establish relationships with decision\-makers at local, regional, and multi\-location businesses.
* Conduct discovery conversations to understand prospective customers’ cash\-handling practices, operational challenges, and business priorities.
* Present GardaWorld Cash Services capabilities, including secure cash transportation, deposit solutions, cash automation, cash recycling, cash\-management services, cash information and reporting solutions, ClearValue, and other evolving solutions.
* Recommend solutions that align with each customer’s operational and commercial requirements.
* Prepare and deliver compelling sales presentations and proposals.
* Partner with Operations, Pricing, Finance, Legal, Implementation, and Sales leadership to develop solutions that can be successfully delivered.
* Participate in pricing and contract discussions and negotiate within established approval requirements.
* Advance qualified opportunities through the full sales cycle and close profitable new business.
* Maintain ownership of new opportunities through contract execution and support a successful transition to implementation.
* Maintain accurate and timely prospecting, pipeline, and sales activity information in applicable systems.
* Monitor market conditions, customer needs, competitive activity, and emerging growth opportunities.
* Provide leadership with actionable feedback regarding territory potential and market trends.
* Meet or exceed individual objectives for prospecting, customer meetings, qualified opportunities, pipeline growth, proposals, new\-customer acquisition, revenue, profitability, and territory penetration.
* Operate as a collaborative member of a high\-performance sales organization built on accountability, communication, positive energy, and execution.


Skills/Qualifications
  
* Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of relevant education and professional experience.
* Demonstrated success in B2B sales, outside sales, territory sales, or new\-business development.
* Proven ability to generate leads independently, build a qualified pipeline, and close new customers.
* Strong consultative selling, presentation, negotiation, and relationship\-building skills.
* Confidence initiating conversations with prospective customers through face\-to\-face and telephone outreach.
* Ability to understand customer business needs and translate them into practical solutions.
* Strong territory\-planning, organizational, and pipeline\-management capabilities.
* Self\-motivated, resilient, competitive, and comfortable operating with a high degree of independence.
* Ability to collaborate effectively across Sales, Operations, Pricing, Finance, Legal, and Implementation.
* Proficiency with CRM platforms and standard business technology.
* Valid driver’s license and the ability to travel regularly throughout the assigned territory.


Experience in cash management, payments, merchant services, financial services, commercial banking, treasury services, ATM technology, cash automation, secure logistics, route\-based commercial services, retail technology, business services, security services, or another complex B2B service environment is preferred.
  
Direct cash\-in\-transit or armored transportation experience is not required. We are looking for candidates with a demonstrated ability to enter a market, develop relationships, create pipeline, and win new business.
  
  

EOE, Drug\-Free Workplace
  
  

GardaWorld is an equal opportunity employer and drug free workplace. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to their race, color, religion, national origin, sex, protected veteran status or disability.
  
  

Cash Services Headquarters
  
2000 NW Corporate Boulevard

jobs.title: Social Media Specialist
jobs.description:
**About Us**  
Excel Restoration is a fast\-growing restoration company specializing in water, fire, and mold mitigation, along with full\-service reconstruction. We pride ourselves on professionalism, accountability, and delivering exceptional service to our customers and partners.

As we continue to grow across our Elk Grove Village, IL and West Allis, WI locations, we’re looking for a creative, energetic Social Media \& Content Creator to help us build our brand and tell the Excel Restoration story online.

**The Opportunity**  
We’re looking for someone who can take the work we do every day and turn it into engaging content that people actually want to watch.

From documenting restoration projects and before\-and\-after transformations to highlighting our team, sharing educational content, and showcasing the day\-to\-day life of a restoration company, you’ll help bring the Excel Restoration brand to life across social media.

This role is ideal for someone who enjoys being behind the camera just as much as they enjoy being behind a computer. You should be comfortable coming up with content ideas, filming on location, editing videos, writing captions, and staying on top of social media trends.

You’ll work closely with our team and leadership to develop a consistent content strategy and create content that increases brand awareness, builds trust with customers and partners, and helps position Excel Restoration as a leader in the restoration industry.

**What You'll Do**

* Develop and execute a consistent social media content strategy across platforms such as Instagram, Facebook, TikTok, and YouTube
* Film high\-quality video and photo content at our offices, job sites, and restoration projects
* Capture before\-and\-after transformations, project walkthroughs, team spotlights, educational content, customer\-focused stories, and behind\-the\-scenes footage
* Edit short\-form videos and other social media content for online publishing
* Create engaging Reels, TikToks, Stories, Shorts, and other platform\-specific content
* Write captions, develop hooks, and help create content that encourages engagement
* Identify trending formats, sounds, topics, and content opportunities that can be adapted to the restoration industry
* Build and maintain a consistent social media posting schedule
* Collaborate with leadership and team members to develop new content ideas
* Help showcase the expertise, professionalism, culture, and personality of Excel Restoration
* Monitor social media performance and use analytics to identify what content is performing well
* Help grow our audience, engagement, and overall online presence
* Maintain an organized library of photos and video footage
* Travel between our Elk Grove Village, IL and West Allis, WI locations and job sites as needed

**What We're Looking For**

* Experience creating content for social media, either professionally or through personal projects
* Strong knowledge of platforms such as Instagram, Facebook, TikTok, and YouTube
* Experience filming and editing video
* Familiarity with video editing software such as Adobe Premiere Pro, Final Cut Pro, CapCut, or similar
* A strong understanding of what makes short\-form content engaging
* Creative instincts and the ability to come up with new content ideas
* Strong communication and storytelling skills
* Ability to work independently and take ownership of projects
* Comfortable being around active job sites and working in a hands\-on environment
* Highly organized and able to manage multiple pieces of content at different stages
* Willingness to get out from behind the desk and capture content in the field
* A valid driver's license and reliable transportation

**Bonus Points**

* Experience with photography or videography
* Experience operating DSLR or mirrorless cameras
* Experience with Adobe Creative Cloud
* Experience creating TikToks, Reels, or YouTube Shorts
* Experience managing a business or brand's social media accounts
* Experience with paid social media advertising
* Experience with graphic design
* Experience in construction, restoration, home services, real estate, or another field\-based industry
* A portfolio or examples of content you've created

**What Success Looks Like**  
In this role, success means making Excel Restoration more visible, recognizable, and engaging online.

* You'll help us consistently publish content that showcases our projects, educates our audience, highlights our team, and gives potential customers and partners a reason to trust and remember Excel Restoration.
* We aren't looking for someone who simply checks a box by posting three times a week. We're looking for someone who sees an interesting project, grabs a camera, finds the story, edits the footage, and turns it into something people want to watch.
* If you're creative, self\-motivated, comfortable in a fast\-paced environment, and excited about building something from the ground up, we'd love to hear from you.

Pay: $60,000\.00 \- $70,000\.00 per year

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule
* Health insurance
* Retirement plan

Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Operations Coordinator (In Store)
jobs.description:
### **Position**

**Overview:**

Tiffany \& Co… the name instills images of Beauty, Romance and the iconic Blue Box. It is a Symbol of Excellence. For 175 years, Tiffany has created a legacy of exquisite designs and romantic ideals. Tiffany \& Co.'s rich heritage of celebrated artists, historic milestones and magnificent jewelry creates the foundation from which our employees build upon each day. Tiffany employees are passionate, kind and professionally committed. We hold ourselves and our co\-workers to very high standards. We continually educate ourselves about new merchandise collections, cultures and the evolving luxury market. Our respect and love for the brand creates a workplace like no other.  



Tiffany employees honor every special moment in our customer's lives and every unique gift that commemorates their milestones. This differentiating factor, known as the Tiffany Experience ( *Creating Connections, Providing Personalized Experiences and Honoring the Tiffany Legacy)* is never compromised…. and it never will be.  



We expect our employees to deliver the Tiffany Experience to each and every customer and Tiffany is committed to creating an organization that recognizes and rewards excellence in service of this promise. For us, it is a dream to be associated with a company that is forever aligned with exquisite craftsmanship, timeless design and a dedicated commitment to corporate sustainability.  



**Responsibilities:**

The Operations Coordinator takes the lead by performing all back of house operations in a Tiffany store. The Coordinator has a passion for providing excellent client service and partners with store leadership on key initiatives which supports the team and drives sales goals. The Coordinator is a key holder who acts as a manager on duty when a manager is unavailable. Duties include coordinating order fulfillment, managing inventory, coordinating client service activities, and may open and close the store.  



**Sales:** Deepen the relationship with our clients to drive lifetime loyalty and spend. Carry out operations and sales support functions to support the store in consistently achieving or exceeding monthly, quarterly and annual store sales plan. Capture customer data during interactions to cultivate new and existing customers. Act as Guest Experience Manager, key holder, and carryout opening and closing procedures in the absence of a manager. Drive business through key product pillars.  



**Service:** Elevate in store experience by consistently delivering memorable moments. Demonstrate passion as a Tiffany brand ambassador, providing the Tiffany Touch during every client interaction. Demonstrate Client Experience Behaviors identified within the TEI program (Voice of Client Survey). Execute best practices by optimizing hospitality and store amenities to create unique experiences and take action on TEI performance and client feedback. Resolve client and employee concerns utilizing judgment and thorough knowledge of policy, procedure and practice.  



**Operational Excellence:** Provide exceptional operational support to drive sales and service. Execute daily tasks such as order fulfillment, shipping, receiving and replenishment, cleaning jewelry, transferring merchandise, taking in jewelry repairs and cleaning merchandise, following company operational policies and procedures. Ensure compliance with all internal control procedures and maintain inventory accuracy. Partner and communicate effectively with Sales Professionals, Management and clients to respond and follow up to requests quickly and accurately. Support Company operations efficiency objectives by ensuring all activities maximize productivity and by providing feedback on process changes through appropriate channels. Assist management in coordinating work and coaching team members to improve performance when acting as manager on duty. Takes the lead, partnering with the operations professional to ensure operational excellence in all tasks.  



**Qualifications:**

Required Qualifications:


* 2\-3 years of prior retail experience in retail operations with comprehensive knowledge of merchandising, client service, administration and shipping.
* Strong Analytical skills.
* Proficient in Microsoft Word and Excel.
* Ability to work retail store hours as necessary, including nights, weekends and holidays.
* Organized and detail oriented.
* Flexibility to perform different tasks based on day\-to\-day business needs.
* Must have authorization to work in the United States or in the country where the position is based.

Preferred Qualifications:


* A college/university degree.
Graduate Gemologist degree or previous Gemological Institute of America (GIA) course work.  
* 

Illinois Wage Transparency Disclosure\-$24\.65\-$29\.00


***TIFFANY \& CO.***
**MAISON**
-------------------------------

Founded in 1837 by Charles Lewis Tiffany in New York City, Tiffany \& Co. is one of the world’s most prestigious houses for jewelry and accessories. Love has been the driving force of Tiffany \& Co. since its inception, uniting the jeweler’s core values of inventiveness, craft and joy in designs that endure across generations.
  

As a global pioneer in the art of fine jewelry, Tiffany has spent almost two centuries perfecting its craft and setting benchmarks within the industry. It is through this unwavering vow to excellence and expertise, to heritage and innovation, to optimism and possibility that Tiffany continues its legacy, creating designs that inspire people to express and celebrate the many facets of love.

jobs.title: Sales Development Representative (Chicago)
jobs.description:
**Sales Development Representative (Chicago)**

  

You don't pay us. We pay you.


SV Academy is hiring Sales Development Representatives. This is a full\-time job that includes free sales training, a 90\-day paid Residency at a partner company, and a clear path to a long\-term sales role at one of our 400\+ partner companies.


Cohorts begin every week and are limited to 25 Residents. Apply early to be considered for the next available start date.


Compensation

* **Days 1–10** — Free sales training. No tuition, no fee, no debt. Live, instructor\-led training on Zoom, Monday through Thursday, 6–9 pm (ET or PT).
* **Days 11–100** — Paid Residency. $2,500/month base \+ 100% of the commissions you earn. You'll be a W\-2 employee of SV Academy, embedded at a partner company.
* **Day 100 onward** — Transfer to the partner's payroll. $50k \- $85k in total annual compensation (base \+ commission). Full health, dental, vision, and retirement benefits begin the day you transfer to the partner.


No tuition. No loans. No deferred\-income agreement.


We're paid out of the hiring budget the partner was already going to spend — which means our incentive is to make you successful in the role!

**How the 100 Days Work**

**Days 1–10** — Free sales training. Ten days of live, instructor\-led training. Monday through Thursday, 6–9 pm (ET or PT), on Zoom. No cost to you.
