**Days 11–100** — Paid Residency at a partner company. You'll work full\-time at one of our partner companies as a W\-2 employee of SV Academy. Real sales work: outbound prospecting via phone, email, and LinkedIn; qualifying inbound leads; scheduling discovery meetings for Account Executives. You'll get daily coaching from an SV Academy mentor and from the partner's sales leadership.

**Day 100** — Transfer to the partner. Successful Residents transfer directly onto the partner's payroll at the compensation above, with full benefits starting that day.

**About SV Academy**


Since 2017, we've placed more than 6,000 people into full\-time tech sales careers and worked with 400\+ employer partners across SaaS, AI, fintech, cybersecurity, and other high\-growth verticals.


Led by CEO Michael Colonnese, a 15\+ year veteran of workforce development focused on building debt\-free pathways into tech careers.


Our partners pay us. You don't. That's the entire business model.

**Who Tends to Succeed Here**


No prior sales experience required. We hire people who are:

* Competitive and motivated by clear goals
* Comfortable on the phone, including cold calls
* Coachable — you take feedback and act on it
* Resilient — sales involves rejection, and you can keep going
* Strong written and spoken communicators


If you've worked in retail, hospitality, customer service, fundraising, fitness instruction, teaching, or any role where you spent your day talking to people and meeting goals — you already have the foundation to be excellent at this.

**What Happens After You Apply**

* Apply through this posting — takes about 3 minutes.
* We respond within 2 business days. If you're a fit, we'll set up a 20\-minute intro call.
* Cohort placement. If you move forward, we'll match you with a partner company and a start date. Cohorts begin every Monday and are limited to 25 Residents — apply early for priority consideration.


Apply today. The next cohort starts soon and spots fill on a first\-reviewed basis.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

Hollywood Park is a premier, nearly 300\-acre global sports and entertainment destination in Inglewood, California. Owned, operated, and being developed by Los Angeles Rams Owner/Chairman E. new_jobs.title: Client Experience Coordinator
new_jobs.description:
**Position Summary**

The Client Experience Coordinator (CEC) manages the client experience from the time an order has been released and acknowledged through installation, project completion, and closeout.

This role combines project coordination with proactive client communication. The CEC keeps clients informed, coordinates installation scheduling, prepares projects for installation, manages post\-installation issues and service items, and ensures consistent communication through final completion.

**Our objective:** Clients should always understand where their project stands, what happens next, and who to contact.

**Key Responsibilities:**

**Client Introduction \& Communication**

* Receive new projects from the Project Readiness Coordinator and review the complete project file before contacting the client.
* Introduce yourself as the client's primary Project Coordinator and establish expectations regarding communication and next steps.
* Maintain proactive communication throughout the remainder of the project and respond promptly and professionally to client questions.
* Personally communicate delays, changes, problems, or other exceptions rather than relying solely on automated communication.
* Document meaningful client communication within the CRM/ERP.
* Production \& Project Tracking
* Review manufacturer acknowledgements and anticipated product availability.
* Monitor project and product status and identify potential delays or issues that may impact installation.
* Keep clients informed of meaningful changes and coordinate internally with Project Managers and Operations when issues require attention.

**Installation Coordination**

* Coordinate installation timing based on product availability and operational capacity; schedule and confirm installation dates with clients.
* Create and complete installer packets and confirm required project and installation documentation is available.
* Verify projects are administratively prepared for installation and ensure clients receive appropriate pre\-installation instructions.
* Confirm upcoming installations and manage scheduling changes when necessary.

**Installation Support**

* Monitor project status during installation and coordinate with the Project Manager regarding installation progress.
* Receive documentation of missing parts, damage, service requirements, or incomplete work.
* Communicate promptly with clients when an installation is not First Time Complete (FTC) and establish clear expectations regarding next steps.

**Service \& Outstanding Items**

* Order required replacement parts or materials and track outstanding parts through receipt.
* Maintain accurate service and outstanding\-item records and coordinate return visits and service appointments.
* Keep clients proactively updated while outstanding items are being resolved.
* Work with Project Management and Operations to drive projects to final completion.

**Project Completion \& Closeout**

* Confirm completion with the client and conduct a post\-installation follow\-up call and/or email.
* Confirm client satisfaction and identify unresolved concerns.
* Coordinate final payment as part of project closeout and confirm all outstanding work has been completed.
* Request a client review when appropriate, complete all required closeout documentation, and formally close completed projects.

**CRM \& Automated Communication:**

The CEC is responsible for ensuring the CRM is used effectively to support the client experience. Automated communication may include production/project updates, installation confirmations and reminders, pre\-installation instructions, and appointment reminders.

Automation should supplement, not to replace personal communication. When a project falls outside the normal process, the CEC is responsible for personally communicating with the client.

**Skills \& Qualifications**

* Excellent verbal and written communication skills with strong customer service and relationship\-management ability.
* Highly organized, detail\-oriented, and accountable, with strong follow\-through.
* Ability to manage multiple active projects, competing priorities, and deadlines simultaneously.
* Comfortable communicating difficult news, project delays, and changing expectations professionally.
* Strong problem\-solving, conflict\-resolution, and cross\-functional coordination skills.
* Comfortable working within CRM, ERP, scheduling, and project\-management systems.
* Ability to maintain composure and professionalism when managing escalated client situations.
* Experience in construction, home improvement, windows and doors, or another project\-based client service environment preferred.

Pay: $25\.00 per hour

Expected hours: 40\.0 per week

Benefits:

* Dental insurance
* Health insurance
* Life insurance
* Paid time off
* Vision insurance

Work Location: In person

new_jobs.title: Product Development Coordinator
new_jobs.description:
**Location:** On\-Site — Santa Ana, CA (this is not a hybrid or remote role)  

**Compensation:** $55,000 – $72,000


**About Us**  

Shameless Snacks makes low\-sugar gummy candy that tastes like the real thing. Every bag has 3g of sugar, is packed with fiber, and is vegan and gluten\-free. Our lineup of sour and fruit gummies (worms, bears, peach rings, Cherry Bomb, Green Apple Blast, and more) is sold on Amazon, DTC, and at major retailers across the country.


Shameless is part of eJam, a bootstrapped consumer products company that has built, scaled, and exited multiple brands without taking a dollar of outside capital. That means you get the focus of a single brand with the resources and playbook of a team that has taken products from zero to eight figures more than once. Small team, no bureaucracy, massive ownership.


If you want to learn how a food brand actually gets built, from flavor development and co\-manufacturing to packaging, labeling, and landing on retail shelves, there's no faster education than this.

**The Role**  

We're looking for a Product Development Coordinator to drive new product development for Shameless Snacks. This is a hands\-on role at the center of our innovation pipeline. You'll:

* Research new flavor, format, and line\-extension opportunities, and evaluate the better\-for\-you candy category and competitive landscape
* Coordinate with our manufacturers and ingredient suppliers, including overseas partners, on formulation, samples, and production timelines
* Manage sample rounds and taste testing, tracking feedback on flavor, texture, and shelf stability
* Own packaging development with our design team, including nutrition panels, claims, and label approvals
* Track every project timeline from idea to production\-ready, and present progress to leadership weekly


You'll be the person who takes a new Shameless product from concept to launch\-ready, working directly with the CEO and across our marketing, marketplace, and retail teams from day one.

**What You'll Do Everyday**


Research New Product Opportunities

* Use tools like Helium 10, Jungle Scout, and similar platforms to identify high\-potential SKUs and category opportunities across Amazon, DTC, and retail
* Conduct competitive research — pricing, features, positioning, packaging, reviews, and gaps in the market
* Compile category analyses and present findings to leadership with clear recommendations
* Maintain organized files of benchmarks, specs, market data, and reference materials


Manage the Product Development Pipeline

* Own the product pipeline in ClickUp — Kanban boards, project lists, status updates, and timelines across all active SKUs
* Track all active development projects and keep deliverables on schedule
* Surface blockers early, flag slippage before it becomes a fire, and keep cross\-functional teams aligned
* Own the accuracy of project documentation — if it’s in the system, it’s correct and current


Coordinate with Manufacturers \& Vendors

* Communicate directly with manufacturers in China on pricing, samples, specs, timelines, and production issues
* Manage the RFQ process: solicit quotes, organize vendor responses, maintain comparison documents
* Coordinate sample shipments, evaluate quality, and manage the feedback loop with manufacturers
* Track compliance documentation and product testing requirements
* Maintain vendor communication logs and track progress across SKUs


Drive Packaging \& Design

* Work with the design team on packaging concepts, dielines, and creative assets
* Manage the design approval process — route concepts through stakeholders, collect feedback, push to final approval
* Coordinate with printers and packaging vendors on specs, proofs, and production timelines


Present to Leadership Weekly

* Prepare and deliver a weekly product development presentation to management
* Make sure decision\-makers have what they need to make calls — not scrambling for data in the room
* Cover project status, milestones hit, blockers, timeline changes, and key decisions needed
* Distribute meeting notes, action items, and follow\-ups — everyone knows what they owe and when


Be the Communication Hub

* Coordinate with designers, vendors, manufacturers, and internal teams to keep every deliverable on track
* Work with external partners on samples, proofs, timelines, and production schedules
* Follow up relentlessly — you are the person who makes sure things get done

  

**Requirements** **OU'RE A FIT IF**

* You have 2–4 years of experience in product development, sourcing, or product coordination in consumer products, CPG, eCommerce, or DTC
* You’ve worked with overseas manufacturers — ideally in China — and understand the sourcing and production workflow
* You’re experienced with Amazon product research tools (Helium 10, Jungle Scout, or similar)

new_jobs.title: OluKai, melin, Roark (Tradewind Services) International Distributor Account Manager
new_jobs.description:
**Who We Are:**



Archipelago Companies, a portfolio of highly successful consumer lifestyle brands, is seeking a talented and passionate individual with an entrepreneurial mindset to join our team. Our brands, including OluKai, Kaenon, Melin, Roark, and Tradewind Services are leaders in their respective markets, offering high\-quality products and authentic marketing stories direct to consumers. At Archipelago Companies, we pride ourselves on our commitment to integrity, and we strive to create a culture of excellence in everything we do. If you are a driven and innovative individual with a passion for consumer brands, we invite you to apply for our open position and become a part of our dynamic and growing team.

 **About the Role:**



The International Distributor Account Manager owns the day\-to\-day commercial relationship with the distributor partners who represent OluKai, Melin, and Roark outside our directly operated markets. These distributors represent our brands in their local markets (i.e. Japan, LATAM, Australia, New Zealand, South Korea, etc).

  

This is a cross\-brand individual contributor role that sits within Tradewind Services and is based in our Irvine, California office. You will be the commercial and operational center of gravity for an assigned book of distributor accounts: building and defending the seasonal forecast, driving prebook and at\-once order flow, tracking sell\-in against sell\-thru, and holding partners to brand standards in every market where they carry our labels.

  

We are looking for someone equally comfortable in a line presentation and in a pivot table, who can hold a partner accountable to a number without damaging the relationship, and who understands that in a distributor model your partner’s inventory position is your problem too.

 **Key responsibilities in the following areas include but are not limited to:**

 **Distributor Account Management**


* Serve as the primary day to day contact for an assigned portfolio of international distributors across all three brands
* Run the seasonal sell\-in cycle end to end: line presentation, market\-level assortment planning, prebook collection, order entry accuracy, and confirmation
* Manage at\-once demand and in\-season replenishment against available inventory, and coordinate seasonal samples, price lists, and asset delivery to partners
* Own the order book: monitor open orders, ship windows, cancellations, and backorders, and drive on\-time delivery in partnership with Planning and Operations

  


**Forecasting and Planning**


* Build and maintain rolling seasonal forecasts by distributor, brand, and category, and reconcile them to the annual plan
* Partner with Planning and Production on demand signals, buy quantities, and inventory positioning for the International channel
* Track sell\-in against sell\-thru by partner, and flag risk to plan early with a recommended course of action rather than a report of the problem

  


**Commercial Performance**


* Own revenue, margin, and order fill targets for the assigned book of business
* Prepare and present monthly and quarterly business reviews covering performance to plan, category and product mix, sell\-thru trends, open opportunities, and corrective actions
* Support pricing, terms, and margin discipline within approved guardrails, and escalate exceptions with a clear recommendation
* Partner with Credit and Finance on payment terms, credit exposure, and collections issues affecting the book

  


**Brand and Market Stewardship**


* Hold distributors to brand standards for assortment, presentation, pricing integrity, and channel distribution in their markets
* Review distributor retailer lists, marketing plans, and go to market activity against each brand’s guidelines, and route brand asset requests appropriately
* Surface market intelligence (competitive activity, retail trends, product gaps, pricing pressure) back to the brand and product teams

  


**Cross\-functional Partnership**


* Work daily with Planning, Production, Operations, Customer Service, Credit, and the three brand teams to keep the distributor experience seamless
* Partner with Logistics and trade compliance resources on export documentation, freight, incoterms, and country specific requirements
* Contribute the International point of view to seasonal go to market and range planning

  


**Requirements \& Qualifications:**

  

* Four or more years in wholesale account management, international sales, or distributor management, in consumer products. Footwear, apparel, headwear, or an adjacent premium lifestyle category is strongly preferred
* Demonstrated ownership of a revenue book with personal accountability for forecast accuracy and delivery to plan
* Working command of the wholesale seasonal calendar and how prebook, at\-once, sell\-in, and sell\-thru each move the order book
* Advanced Excel (pivot tables, lookups, large data sets) and the ability to build a forecast you can defend line by line
* Experience operating in an ERP and a BI or reporting environment, and the judgment to move from raw order data to a clear recommendation
* Clear, organized written and verbal communication with partners across time zones, languages, and business cultures
* Actively seeks out AI\-enabled tools and emerging technologies, adapting quickly to leverage them for improved productivity, deeper insights, and more effective processes, while exercising sound judgment and maintaining compliance with organizational standards
* A valid passport and the ability to travel internationally

  


**Preferred Experience**


* Direct experience managing distributor relationships, as distinct from direct wholesale accounts
* Familiarity with export logistics, incoterms, customs documentation, and international trade compliance
* Professional working proficiency in a second language
* Experience with Full Circle, Domo, or comparable ERP and BI platforms
* Experience supporting more than on

Compensation: $40\.00 \- $45\.00 per hour, depending on experience and qualifications


**About Cargomatic**  

Founded in 2013, Cargomatic is revolutionizing the transportation industry by powering local freight through the first and largest digital marketplace for local trucking. Our proprietary, AI\-enabled platform uses real\-time location data to match available cargo space and drivers with shippers who need freight moved—creating capacity on demand.

Cargomatic is seeking a **Customer Success Specialist** to join our team in **Long Beach, CA**. In this role, you will collaborate across the Cargomatic network to ensure shipment operations run smoothly for our most complex customers. You'll serve as a primary point of contact, manage day\-to\-day operations, and help drive customer satisfaction through proactive problem solving and clear communication.

* Bachelor's degree strongly preferred

* Strong customer support and customer satisfaction experience
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills
* Ability to think on your feet and solve problems analytically
* Comfort working in a fast\-changing environment with shifting priorities
* Strong sense of urgency and ability to prioritize daily tasks

**Benefits \& Perks**

* Opportunities for professional growth and career development

* Collaborative, people\-first culture focused on safety, compliance, and continuous improvement.


The hourly rate for this position ranges from $40\.00 – $45\.00\. Actual compensation will be determined based on job\-related factors such as skills, experience, and qualifications, and may vary from the posted range.

You will be part of a collaborative team responsible for creating elevated imagery to showcase our new and signature products. **About the Role**

In this role, you will be responsible for organizing, transporting, and staging merchandise, props, surfaces, grip, crafty, and other supplies necessary to efficiently execute each shoot. You will be relied on by the Producer for any updates regarding product issues, supply shortages, equipment and truck maintenance, etc. We are seeking someone who is a self\-starter, detail\-oriented, and able to work independently and proactively to constantly support all facets of our photo teams while maintaining a can\-do attitude.

new_jobs.title: Production Assistant
new_jobs.description:
**Respect the Root LLC — Production Assistant**

Oakland, CA · Part time

Are you a beverage connoisseur with a love for e\-commerce and the fast\-paced energy of startup culture? We're on the lookout for a dynamic and tech\-savvy Production Assistant to support our rapidly growing kombucha and kava production business. This is an unparalleled opportunity to leave a lasting impact on the beverage industry, driving the success of our unique, high\-quality products in the global market.

**Description**

Respect the Root is the beverage manufacturing and production arm of the MeloMelo Kava bars located throughout the Bay Area and greater California. Offering noble kava to the Bay Area since 2013\.

We continually work with our farmers, distributors and suppliers to establish fair trade and sustainability in the South Pacific Islands. Respect the Root continues to celebrate the tradition of kava while maintaining its inherited roots as we share this elixir and experience with you.

**Work Environment — Please Read Carefully**

This role is based in a private warehouse, and you will be working **mostly alone**. There is no supervisor standing next to you for most of your shift. Day\-to\-day direction, questions, and updates happen over **Slack**, so the ability to communicate clearly, promptly, and professionally in writing is essential to this job — not a nice\-to\-have.

The person who will excel in this role is someone who feels genuinely comfortable and capable working independently: self\-directed, organized, steady without supervision, and confident making reasonable decisions on their own. If you do your best work with a quiet space, a clear task list, and a Slack thread, you will thrive here.

Just as important: **you must be able to stay productive while waiting for an answer.** Questions come up, and a reply may not be instant. We expect you to ask the question, then move on to the next productive task rather than stopping all work and waiting. Filling that time well is part of the job.

**Responsibilities**

Duties cover, but are not limited to:

* Receiving incoming kava shipments and properly entering them into our CRM system, then organizing and labeling the product with the date it was received.
* Following established SOPs to properly label and fill bags using our equipment — including scales, an impulse heat sealer, a printer, and a label printer.
* Generating and printing order paperwork, and correctly labeling properly packaged boxes for outgoing orders. This includes Shopify orders and dropping shipments off at the post office.
* Learning and accurately executing different recipes for our various retail offerings, including products that require combination and mixture of multiple ingredients.
* Inventory and clearly communicating reorder needs to the team in a timely way.
* Picking up supplies as needed.
* Identifying, locating, and preparing equipment or packaging materials for the next stage of production, such as scales, paper bags and glass containers.
* Inspecting and organizing equipment or packaging materials to ensure quality and accuracy, and reporting any defects.
* Maintaining supply inventory and communicating with team members to ensure smooth production flow.
* Assisting with machine setup and changeover, gathering tools, and preparing materials.
* Keeping accurate records of production activities, ensuring traceability and proper labeling.
* Maintaining a clean and safe work environment, following company policies, and reporting any potential hazards.
* Communicating with other team members over Slack to keep production moving smoothly.
* Brewing kombucha or bottling/kegging, which is at a secondary location.
* Performing other tasks as assigned by leadership.

**Requirements**

* **Reliable personal transportation is a must.** You may be asked to drop packages at the post office, pick up ingredients and supplies, or other miscellaneous tasks. Reimbursement for transportation required for work will be provided.
* **Strong, self\-directed time management.** Because you are working largely on your own, the ability to organize your own day, prioritize, and manage your own time is a high requirement of this role.
* **Effective written communication over Slack**, including clear status updates, questions, and reorder requests.
* Comfort and confidence working independently in a private warehouse setting for the majority of your shift.
* Willingness and ability to be trained on new recipes, SOPs, and to cover a shift at a secondary location, potentially on short notice.
* Understanding of manufacturing processes and machinery.
* Ability to identify and address defects in parts and products.
* Ability to communicate effectively with team members.
* Ability to manage inventory and maintain a clean work environment.
* Must be able to regularly lift up to 25 pounds, and occasionally lift up to 50 pounds (25 kg).
* Must be able to safely lift, pick up or otherwise handle bags, boxes, equipment or packaging materials.
* Associate's degree in Food Science, Engineering, Business, or related field preferred.
* 1\-2 years of experience in the coffee, tea, or similar beverage production industry preferred.
* Experience working in a manufacturing environment, especially as a production assistant, is preferred.

**What We Offer**

* A competitive salary and benefits package, commensurate with experience and qualifications.
* The opportunity to join a passionate and driven team of kava enthusiasts, dedicated to revolutionizing the kava industry.
* Ongoing learning and professional development opportunities to expand your skillset and advance your career.
* The satisfaction of contributing to a thriving global kava community and be at the ground floor of an exciting and new drink phenomena.

If this exhilarating opportunity resonates with you, apply now! Become an integral part of our mission to transform the kava industry and let your passion for kava and e\-commerce propel y

We provide our clients with solutions in every phase of their cash supply chain, including secured transportation, cash management, cash vault processing, forecasting, ATM, and cash recycler services. We are equipped with the largest fleet of armored vehicles in the industry, sophisticated technology, and an expansive network of experienced employees and innovative partners. We process, manage, and move over $8B in cash every day while delivering 24/7 client support and logistical expertise.
  
  

Field Sales Representative
  
Own a territory. Build a market. Win new business.
  
GardaWorld Cash Services is seeking a driven Field Sales Representative to expand our presence with local and regional commercial customers. This field\-based new\-business development role is designed for a true sales hunter—someone energized by opening doors, building relationships, creating opportunities, and closing profitable business.
  
You will develop your assigned territory through face\-to\-face prospecting, consultative selling, networking, referrals, and targeted outreach. By understanding how prospective customers manage cash today, you will recommend GardaWorld solutions that improve security, visibility, efficiency, and control.
  
This is not an account\-management or primarily desk\-based sales position. Success requires a consistent market presence, disciplined pipeline development, and the resilience to turn initial conversations into long\-term customer partnerships.
  
**Compensation:** $65,000 \- $75,000 base salary plus commission.
  
**Location:** New York, NY
  
**Travel:** Significant local and regional travel based on territory size, customer needs, and business requirements. Regular face\-to\-face prospecting and customer meetings are essential. Limited overnight travel may be required.
  
  

Responsibilities
  
* Develop and execute a new\-business sales strategy for an assigned geographic territory.
* Identify high\-potential prospects, industries, and commercial areas within the market.
* Build a qualified sales pipeline through in\-person prospecting, telephone outreach, referrals, networking, and other lead\-generation activities.
* Establish relationships with decision\-makers at local, regional, and multi\-location businesses.
* Conduct discovery conversations to understand prospective customers’ cash\-handling practices, operational challenges, and business priorities.
* Present GardaWorld Cash Services capabilities, including secure cash transportation, deposit solutions, cash automation, cash recycling, cash\-management services, cash information and reporting solutions, ClearValue, and other evolving solutions.
* Recommend solutions that align with each customer’s operational and commercial requirements.
* Prepare and deliver compelling sales presentations and proposals.
* Partner with Operations, Pricing, Finance, Legal, Implementation, and Sales leadership to develop solutions that can be successfully delivered.
* Participate in pricing and contract discussions and negotiate within established approval requirements.
* Advance qualified opportunities through the full sales cycle and close profitable new business.
* Maintain ownership of new opportunities through contract execution and support a successful transition to implementation.
* Maintain accurate and timely prospecting, pipeline, and sales activity information in applicable systems.
* Monitor market conditions, customer needs, competitive activity, and emerging growth opportunities.
* Provide leadership with actionable feedback regarding territory potential and market trends.
* Meet or exceed individual objectives for prospecting, customer meetings, qualified opportunities, pipeline growth, proposals, new\-customer acquisition, revenue, profitability, and territory penetration.
* Operate as a collaborative member of a high\-performance sales organization built on accountability, communication, positive energy, and execution.


Skills/Qualifications
  
* Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of relevant education and professional experience.
* Demonstrated success in B2B sales, outside sales, territory sales, or new\-business development.
* Proven ability to generate leads independently, build a qualified pipeline, and close new customers.
* Strong consultative selling, presentation, negotiation, and relationship\-building skills.
* Confidence initiating conversations with prospective customers through face\-to\-face and telephone outreach.
* Ability to understand customer business needs and translate them into practical solutions.
* Strong territory\-planning, organizational, and pipeline\-management capabilities.
* Self\-motivated, resilient, competitive, and comfortable operating with a high degree of independence.
* Ability to collaborate effectively across Sales, Operations, Pricing, Finance, Legal, and Implementation.
* Proficiency with CRM platforms and standard business technology.
* Valid driver’s license and the ability to travel regularly throughout the assigned territory.


Experience in cash management, payments, merchant services, financial services, commercial banking, treasury services, ATM technology, cash automation, secure logistics, route\-based commercial services, retail technology, business services, security services, or another complex B2B service environment is preferred.
  
Direct cash\-in\-transit or armored transportation experience is not required. We are looking for candidates with a demonstrated ability to enter a market, develop relationships, create pipeline, and win new business.
  
  

EOE, Drug\-Free Workplace
  
  

GardaWorld is an equal opportunity employer and drug free workplace. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to their race, color, religion, national origin, sex, protected veteran status or disability.

new_jobs.title: Digital Marketing Intern - Technical AI & Automation
new_jobs.description:
Eulerity is an AI\-native marketing automation platform. Our software runs paid advertising, social, listings, reputation, and call tracking for thousands of locations across enterprise franchises and SMB networks, executing autonomously across Google, Meta, Apple, and Microsoft. The Technical Operations team is the analytical engine that keeps that execution sharp.



We are hiring an intern to sit with this team for the summer.


**Who we are looking for**
--------------------------



This is not just a marketing internship. We are looking for someone who is genuinely analytical. The kind of person who opens a messy dataset and gets curious instead of overwhelmed. Who enjoys figuring out why a number moved. Who can read a chunk of SQL or Python and follow what it does, even if they would not write it from scratch. Who would otherwise be heading toward an analyst seat at a consulting firm or a product role at a startup.



If you love spreadsheets, you will feel at home here. If you have ever built a model in Excel just to understand something better, even more so.


**What you will actually do**
-----------------------------



You will work directly with our Technical Account Management and Analytics teams on the parts of campaign management that require thinking, not clicking. That includes:


* Diagnosing why specific campaigns are underperforming and proposing fixes grounded in the data.
* Building and refining Excel and Sheets models that our account teams use to make decisions.
* Auditing campaigns at scale, often across hundreds of locations for a single brand, and surfacing patterns no one else has noticed.
* Pulling, cleaning, and analyzing performance data from Google Ads, Meta, LinkedIn, and our internal platform.
* Helping operationalize new analytical workflows, including ones we are building on top of AI tooling.
* Contributing to internal projects that make our team faster and smarter.


You will not be writing ad copy or designing creative. You will be doing the analytical work that makes the campaigns actually perform.


**What we want from you**
-------------------------


* Current student or recent graduate, ideally with coursework in something quantitative. Economics, statistics, computer science, engineering, math, finance, or similar. A traditional marketing background is not what we are looking for here.
* Strong Excel chops. Comfort with pivot tables, lookups, conditional logic, and building models from scratch.
* Basic code literacy. You do not need to be a programmer, but you should be able to read SQL, Python, or JavaScript and roughly understand what it is doing.
* Comfort with AI tools as a daily part of how you work. We expect everyone here to use them aggressively and intelligently, and you should be the kind of person who already does.
* Sharp written communication. You can take a messy analysis and explain the takeaway in three sentences.
* Detail\-oriented and self\-directed. You catch things other people miss and you do not need to be told twice.

**Logistics**
-------------


* Fall 2026, October start with potential to extend based on performance.
* Hybrid out of our NYC office, 2 to 3 days per week in person.
* Minimum 20 hours per week, flexible schedule.
* $18 to $20 per hour.
* Lunch credits and unlimited snacks when in\-office.
* Direct mentorship from senior operators on our team.

new_jobs.title: Business Development Representative
new_jobs.description:
**Description**


**Job Overview:**


FirstService Project Management (FSPM) provides project management and capital planning services to cooperative, condominium, and residential communities throughout the New York metropolitan area, helping boards and property managers navigate regulatory compliance, capital repairs, building system replacements, and major construction initiatives.


The Business Development Representative is responsible for identifying, developing, and advancing capital project opportunities within the FirstService Residential portfolio and the external marketplace. This role includes building and maintaining an organized pipeline, driving consistent outreach efforts, securing business development meetings, and delivering qualified opportunities to FSPM leadership.

**Responsibilities:**

* Identify buildings likely to require project management support using property data, regulatory requirements, LL11/FISP filing cycles, inspection requirements, repair deadlines, and internal relationships.
* Track known and anticipated capital needs, including elevators, HVAC systems, roofs, garages, façades, plumbing risers, waterproofing, interior renovations, and building\-system replacements.
* Maintain a master database of FirstService properties, capital needs, deadlines, and FSPM engagement status.
* Utilize internal systems, public records, and meeting minutes to identify and prioritize project opportunities.
* Maintain accurate and complete CRM and business intelligence records, including next steps, responsible parties, and follow\-up dates for every opportunity.
* Conduct consistent outreach through phone, email, and approved communication tools to property managers, team leaders, and board members.
* Coordinate with property managers before contacting boards directly.
* Secure educational and business development meetings for FSPM leadership, positioning FSPM as a resource for compliance guidance, project planning, and risk reduction.
* Maintain persistent and scheduled follow\-up activities until opportunities are qualified, advanced, deferred, or closed.
* Re\-engage deferred opportunities at established intervals.
* Qualify opportunities based on project type, timing, scope, board readiness, consultant involvement, and funding considerations.
* Prioritize opportunities that do not have existing project management support.
* Escalate high\-value, time\-sensitive, or high\-risk opportunities to FSPM leadership.
* Prepare concise opportunity briefs, including known building conditions, project history, and regulatory deadlines before meetings.
* Transition qualified opportunities to the appropriate FSPM executive or representative.
* Advance opportunities through the sales pipeline from identification through meeting, proposal, award, deferral, or loss.
* Maintain current pipeline stages, opportunity values, probability metrics, and anticipated timelines.
* Coordinate with FSPM leadership regarding client engagement, proposal follow\-up, and recurring client concerns.
* Partner with Marketing to develop outreach campaigns and business development initiatives.
* Monitor and report activity levels, conversion metrics, and portfolio penetration trends.
* Support external prospecting efforts as the internal FirstService portfolio program continues to expand.
* Meet regularly with FSPM, Business Development, Marketing, Compliance, and Property Management leadership teams to coordinate opportunities and strategic priorities.
* Coordinate with portfolio managers, team leaders, and senior leaders to identify and advance project opportunities.
* Maintain continuity of opportunity information through property management personnel changes.
* Follow established standard operating procedures for outreach, qualification, escalation, and handoff processes.
* Practice and adhere to FirstService Residential Global Service Standards.
* Conduct business at all times with the highest standards of personal, professional, and ethical conduct.
* Maintain regular and punctual attendance at required meetings, training sessions, and related business activities.
* Participate in meetings and work groups to coordinate activities, communicate and resolve issues, and obtain approvals.
* Follow all company policies, safety requirements, and standard operating procedures.
* Perform additional projects, tasks, and related duties as assigned.

**Skills \& Qualifications**:

* Bachelor's degree in Business, Real Estate, Construction Management, or a related field preferred.
* Two or more years of experience in business development, property management, real estate, or construction services preferred.
* Experience with CRM platforms such as HubSpot, Salesforce, Dynamics, or similar systems preferred.
* Experience managing databases, sales pipelines, and portfolio\-level opportunity tracking preferred.
* Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage a large volume of opportunities, priorities, deadlines, and follow\-up activities.
* Persistent, disciplined, and professional approach to outreach and relationship management.
* Ability to build credibility and develop relationships with property managers, board members, executives, and prospective clients.
* Strong research, analytical, written, and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to gather information, prioritize opportunities, and communicate effectively across stakeholder groups.
* Self\-motivated and accountable, with the ability to work independently and exercise sound judgment.
* Ability to communicate effectively about capital projects and building compliance topics without serving as the technical subject matter expert.
* Strong collaboration and relationship\-building skills with internal and external stakeholders.
* Ability to manage and prioritize multiple projects simultaneously in a fast\-paced environment.

**Who We Are:** CAMBA is a community of staff, volunteers, clients, donors, neighbors and partners who work together to build an inclusive New York City, where all children and adults have access to the resources and supports they need to thrive. We take a comprehensive approach by offering more than 180 integrated programs in: Education \& Youth Development, Family Support, Job Training \& Employment Support Services, Health, Housing, and Legal Services. We reach more than 72,000 individuals and families each year at our 100 locations, including 10,000 youth. CAMBA serves a diverse cross section of New Yorkers from new mothers in Brownsville to job seekers in the Rockaways. More than half of our clients are immigrants and refugees from around the globe. new_jobs.title: Key Account Manager (Atlanta, GA)
new_jobs.description:
**Description:**

The Key Account Manager (KAM) is responsible for the promotion of products and achievement of assigned goals, within legal and regulatory guidelines, to customers and accounts within a geographic territory. The KAM role also involves targeted educational and promotional efforts leading to the identification and development of new customers and accounts within the territory and increased therapy/ product adoption for appropriate patients. This will entail presenting information on products and services associated with the products to physicians, health care professionals, pharmacy directors and staff, buyers, professional groups, and others involved in the decision\-making process in the clinical environment as well as at conferences and other similar events.  



  

**Essential Functions:**

* Drive regional sales performance through effective account management.
	+ Exceed sales targets by leveraging data to strategically prioritize activities and allocate resources.
	+ Develop strong relationships with HCPs by understanding each customer's needs, goals and prescribing habits and competitive product standing.
	+ Effectively sell a portfolio of products and balance priorities and responsibilities so that territory goals are exceeded for all products promoted.
	+ Manage sales efforts within assigned promotional and operational budgets
	+ Utilize and leverage all available sales data to prioritize activities and resources and achieve territory objectives.
	+ Consistently target, develop, maintain and sell to existing customers and accounts. This includes accessing difficult to see customers on a regular basis.
	+ Routinely identify and develop new business opportunities within assigned territory.
	+ When applicable to products reimbursed through a buy and bill model, use good judgement in establishing and negotiating contracts for customers within a framework of company pricing strategy and parameters.
* Support the development of Key Opinion Leaders from targeted accounts.
* Identify and attend industry events, including society conferences.
* Participate in regional and national sales meetings.
* Complete call reporting and samples records, maintain accounts records and submit timely and thorough account and territory reports.
	+ Comply with all deadlines including territory information requests, project assignments and other requests by various departments.
* Share important learnings and information, such as best practices, opportunities and competitive threats with sales management and peers.
* Maintain a high degree of competence in the areas of product knowledge, disease state knowledge, and industry knowledge impacted by Amneal's products.
* Successfully complete all required training.
* Responsible for maintaining a high degree of honesty, integrity, diplomacy and ethical behavior.

  
**Education:**

Bachelors Degree (BA/BS) preferably in a scientific/medical or business discipline \- Required  

* 

**Experience:**

5 years or more in in the pharmaceutical, medical device, and or biotech industries  

* 

**Skills:**

* Two consecutive years of documented sales success in the top 20% of the nation and verifiable performance review ratings of Exceeds Expectations or Outstanding in the last two years
* Demonstrated ability to sell in a competitive marketplace
Strong clinical sales acumen  
* 

**Specialized Knowledge:**

* Hospital pharmacy sales experience ideal
Product focus on biologics, expensive therapies, or injectables  
* 

The base salary for this position ranges from $140,000 to $160,000 per year. In addition, Amneal offers a short\-term incentive opportunity, such as a bonus or performance\-based award, with this position within the first 12 months. Amneal ranges reflect the Company’s good faith estimate of what Amneal reasonably believes that it will pay for said position at the time of the posting. Individual compensation will ultimately be determined based on a variety of relevant factors, including but not limited to, qualifications, experience, geographic location and other relevant skills.


At the heart of our Total Rewards commitment is a comprehensive, flexible and competitive benefits program for eligible positions that enables you to choose the plans and coverage that meet your personal needs. This includes above\-market, diverse and robust health and insurance benefits to meet the varied needs of our employees as well as a significant 401(k) matching contribution to help our employees save for retirement. We also promote employee well\-being with programs that help you enjoy your career alongside life’s many other commitments and opportunities.

new_jobs.title: Account Manager
new_jobs.description:
**What We Do:**



Florence software advances cures by helping the world’s most important research sites do their best work. Our solutions are now used by over 30,000 research teams in 70 countries around the world—we’re the most widely deployed site workflow tool in the industry. By the end of the decade, we’ll double the pace at which new medicines get to market by doubling the output of trial site teams. To date, we were named a Deloitte Fast 50 business, G2 Category Leader, an Inc. \& AJC best place to work, and an Inc. 5000 company five years in a row.



At Florence, we are committed to make the world a better place by accelerating research while providing an environment for our employees where they can be happy in their lives, enjoy their jobs, and grow.

**What You’ll Bring To The Team:**



As an Account Manager, you will be responsible for managing a portfolio of key accounts, ensuring their satisfaction, driving renewals, and fostering growth opportunities. You will serve as the primary commercial point of contact for our valued clients, understanding their needs, and proactively working to strengthen the relationship. You will work in conjunction with our customer success team to ensure that clients receive the value from their investment in Florence solutions.



If you are a motivated and client\-focused professional with a passion for account management, renewals, and driving account growth, we invite you to apply and join our team at Florence Healthcare. Help us continue to build strong client partnerships and make a significant impact on our clients' success


**You Will:**


* Client Relationship Management:
* + Build and maintain strong relationships with existing clients, becoming a trusted advisor.
	+ Understand clients' business objectives and challenges to align our solutions with their needs.
* Renewal Management:
* + Develop and execute strategies to ensure high renewal rates for subscription\-based services.
	+ Monitor contract expiration dates and proactively engage with clients to secure early and multi\-year renewals.
* Account Health Monitoring:
* + Regularly assess the health of client accounts and identify potential issues or opportunities.
	+ Collaborate with cross\-functional teams to address any client concerns and deliver solutions.
* Account Growth and Upselling:
* + Identify opportunities to expand our services and upsell additional solutions to existing clients.
	+ Develop account plans and strategies for account expansion and growth.
* Client Advocacy:
* + Act as a client advocate within the company, representing client interests and feedback.
	+ Provide clients with insights, best practices, and recommendations to maximize the value of our offerings in conjunction with your customer success partner.
* Reporting and Analytics:
* + Maintain accurate records of client interactions, renewals, and account growth activities.
	+ Utilize data and analytics to track progress, identify trends, and make data\-driven decisions.
* Cross\-functional Collaboration:
* + Collaborate with customer success, customer support, marketing, product, and sales to ensure a seamless client experience.
	+ Provide feedback to internal teams to improve product/service offerings based on client input.
	+ Onboard new clients in partnership with sales and professional services to ensure a successful beginning to the relationship.

**An Ideal Candidate Has:**


* Bachelor's degree in Business, Marketing, or a related field (MBA is a plus).

new_jobs.title: Field Sales Representative
new_jobs.description:
GardaWorld is shaping the future of cash management! We provide our clients with solutions in every phase of their cash supply chain, including secured transportation, cash management, cash vault processing, forecasting, ATM, and cash recycler services. We are equipped with the largest fleet of armored vehicles in the industry, sophisticated technology, and an expansive network of experienced employees and innovative partners. We process, manage, and move over $8B in cash every day while delivering 24/7 client support and logistical expertise.
  
  

Field Sales Representative
  
Own a territory. Build a market. Win new business.
  
GardaWorld Cash Services is seeking a driven Field Sales Representative to expand our presence with local and regional commercial customers. This field\-based new\-business development role is designed for a true sales hunter—someone energized by opening doors, building relationships, creating opportunities, and closing profitable business.
  
You will develop your assigned territory through face\-to\-face prospecting, consultative selling, networking, referrals, and targeted outreach. By understanding how prospective customers manage cash today, you will recommend GardaWorld solutions that improve security, visibility, efficiency, and control.
  
This is not an account\-management or primarily desk\-based sales position. Success requires a consistent market presence, disciplined pipeline development, and the resilience to turn initial conversations into long\-term customer partnerships.
  
**Compensation:** $65,000 \- $75,000 base salary plus commission.
  
**Location:** Atlanta, GA
  
**Travel:** Significant local and regional travel based on territory size, customer needs, and business requirements. Regular face\-to\-face prospecting and customer meetings are essential. Limited overnight travel may be required.
  
  

Responsibilities
  
* Develop and execute a new\-business sales strategy for an assigned geographic territory.
* Identify high\-potential prospects, industries, and commercial areas within the market.
* Build a qualified sales pipeline through in\-person prospecting, telephone outreach, referrals, networking, and other lead\-generation activities.
* Establish relationships with decision\-makers at local, regional, and multi\-location businesses.
* Conduct discovery conversations to understand prospective customers’ cash\-handling practices, operational challenges, and business priorities.
* Present GardaWorld Cash Services capabilities, including secure cash transportation, deposit solutions, cash automation, cash recycling, cash\-management services, cash information and reporting solutions, ClearValue, and other evolving solutions.
* Recommend solutions that align with each customer’s operational and commercial requirements.
* Prepare and deliver compelling sales presentations and proposals.
* Partner with Operations, Pricing, Finance, Legal, Implementation, and Sales leadership to develop solutions that can be successfully delivered.
* Participate in pricing and contract discussions and negotiate within established approval requirements.
* Advance qualified opportunities through the full sales cycle and close profitable new business.
* Maintain ownership of new opportunities through contract execution and support a successful transition to implementation.
* Maintain accurate and timely prospecting, pipeline, and sales activity information in applicable systems.
* Monitor market conditions, customer needs, competitive activity, and emerging growth opportunities.
* Provide leadership with actionable feedback regarding territory potential and market trends.
* Meet or exceed individual objectives for prospecting, customer meetings, qualified opportunities, pipeline growth, proposals, new\-customer acquisition, revenue, profitability, and territory penetration.
* Operate as a collaborative member of a high\-performance sales organization built on accountability, communication, positive energy, and execution.


Skills/Qualifications
  
* Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of relevant education and professional experience.
* Demonstrated success in B2B sales, outside sales, territory sales, or new\-business development.
* Proven ability to generate leads independently, build a qualified pipeline, and close new customers.
* Strong consultative selling, presentation, negotiation, and relationship\-building skills.
* Confidence initiating conversations with prospective customers through face\-to\-face and telephone outreach.
* Ability to understand customer business needs and translate them into practical solutions.
* Strong territory\-planning, organizational, and pipeline\-management capabilities.
* Self\-motivated, resilient, competitive, and comfortable operating with a high degree of independence.
* Ability to collaborate effectively across Sales, Operations, Pricing, Finance, Legal, and Implementation.
* Proficiency with CRM platforms and standard business technology.
* Valid driver’s license and the ability to travel regularly throughout the assigned territory.


Experience in cash management, payments, merchant services, financial services, commercial banking, treasury services, ATM technology, cash automation, secure logistics, route\-based commercial services, retail technology, business services, security services, or another complex B2B service environment is preferred.
  
Direct cash\-in\-transit or armored transportation experience is not required. We are looking for candidates with a demonstrated ability to enter a market, develop relationships, create pipeline, and win new business.
  
  

EOE, Drug\-Free Workplace
  
  

GardaWorld is an equal opportunity employer and drug free workplace. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to their race, color, religion, national origin, sex, protected veteran status or disability.
  
  

Cash Services Headquarters
  
2000 NW Corporate Boulevard

**Description**


Are you motivated by the satisfaction of positively affecting someone’s day?!


As a Part\-Time Sales Representative you will be responsible for greeting and assisting customers, maintaining a neat, maintain in stock of merchandise, organized and clean sales floor promoting the Northern Tool credit card program, selling extended service protection plans on qualifying items, and supporting the management team with day\-to\-day store merchandise and operations directions. At Northern Tool \+ Equipment we get up every day to serve the tradespeople who keep our country running strong and the weekend warriors who want to work like them. It’s our mission to make sure they have the right tools for the job, and an easy, hassle\-free experience at our store so they can get in, get out and get on with the job at hand. Your positive and professional attitude contributes to our winning culture and makes sure we leave a lasting impression.  



  

Role Specific Details:

* Schedule Requirements: Open Availability


Key Responsibilities:

* Create a one\-stop shopping experience with exceptional customer service, ask probing inquiries to better understand the customer's needs.
* Greeting customers wherever they are in the store, assisting them with product selection, merchandising aisles and endcaps, and positioning merchandise appropriately.
* Offering our Protection Plans on all eligible products and offering our credit card on all customer transactions (Incentive pay for selling protection plans and credit cards).
* Being a team player by assisting with tasks that improve the way your team serves our consumers.


What you will bring to the table:

* Prior retail sales, cashier or customer service experience admired, but not required.
* Flexible availability and willingness to work some weekends and holidays as needed.
* A love of tools \& equipment.
* Excellent communication skills.
* Ability to lift 70 Lbs.
* Service focused mindset.


About Us


Northern Tool \+ Equipment is a family business with roots stretching back three generations to Minnesota’s Iron Range, where our blue\-collar work ethic and commitment to serving the people who do the tough jobs was born. Our mission is to be the best in the world at serving the professional tradespeople and those who want to work like them. With over 130 retail stores across 24 states, top national brands and global manufacturing operations designed to create our own specialized tools and equipment, we are busting our knuckles to deliver the products, prices and advice our customers need to succeed. We’re looking for people who share our blue\-collar work ethic. If you’re the kind of person who likes to put your nose to the grindstone to help your customers and company succeed, we’d love to talk to you about becoming a member of our team.


Northern Tool \+ Equipment is proud to be recognized by Forbes as a Top Midsize Employer in 2023\. We are committed to creating a workplace where your contributions are valued, and your professional growth is encouraged. When you join our team, you’ll enjoy a comprehensive and competitive compensation package that includes:

* Competitive Pay: Earn $14\.00 \- $20\.70 hourly, with your exact compensation personalized based on your skills, experience, and location. We believe in rewarding top talent with pay that reflects your value.
* Flexible Work Schedule: Achieve the work\-life balance you deserve with our flexible scheduling, this is a part\-time position.
* Comprehensive Benefits Package: Your health and well\-being are our priority. We offer a variety of health plans, so you can choose what best fits your needs. Employees working 30\+ hours per week enjoy a robust benefits package, including medical, dental, vision, and a 401(k) plan with an enhanced company match to support your financial future.
* Generous Employee Discount: Love our products? So do we! Enjoy a significant discount on the quality tools and equipment we offer, helping you save on the items you love to use.
* Get Paid on Your Terms: With our Daily Pay option, you don’t have to wait for payday—access your earnings whenever you need them for added financial flexibility.
* Holidays and Time Off: We believe in giving our team time to relax and recharge. Our stores are closed on Easter, Thanksgiving, and Christmas, ensuring you can enjoy these special occasions with your loved ones. Additionally, we operate with reduced hours on five other federal holidays, recognizing the importance of personal time. Employees working 30\+ hours per week are eligible for paid holidays and paid time off.
* Incentives: Be rewarded for eligible incentive programs.


When you join Northern Tool \+ Equipment, you're not just starting a job—you're joining a community that supports your success. Come be a part of a team where your skills, dedication, and passion are recognized and celebrated. Your future starts here!

new_jobs.title: Community Manager
new_jobs.description:
TriBridge Residential is seeking a **Community Manager** for our Collier Trailside property, located in West Midtown Atlanta.  

The ideal candidate will be responsible for managing the day\-to\-day operations of our apartment community, adhering to the company's policies and procedures. We are looking for a candidate who brings enthusiasm, passion, and a creative spirit to help ensure the team's success.

**Job Summary**: The Community Manager will successfully execute the property’s leasing strategy, financial plan, and operating budget. This includes marketing, budgeting, operations, team management, and development.

 **Essential Functions:**

* Provide daily leadership and direction to the team. Ensure that all leasing tasks are performed according to established guidelines and that all associates receive appropriate training.
* Manage community operations to achieve expense and income levels in alignment with monthly, quarterly, and annual budget goals. \-  

 Communicate effectively with residents, addressing and resolving issues as they arise while involving additional resources when necessary.
* Manage and schedule the team, contractors, and vendors to ensure efficient turnover of vacant units, maintenance and repairs, and upkeep of common areas.
* Oversee collections, rent postings, and deposits to ensure they are completed in a timely and accurate manner.
* Supervise leasing operations to confirm that applications and paperwork are accurate and comply with company policies and guidelines.
* Demonstrate an ongoing understanding and commitment to fair housing, equal employment, and diversity policies.
* Ensure all staff members are appropriately trained on federal, state, and local Fair Housing laws.

**Knowledge and Experience:**

* A bachelor’s degree is preferred.
* A minimum of three years of experience in multifamily property management, with progressively increasing responsibilities.
* Proficiency in MS Office applications (Outlook, Word, and Excel) as well as property management software, preferably Yardi.
* Excellent organizational skills with the ability to work independently while maintaining high accuracy and productivity.
* A strong customer service orientation and effective oral and written communication skills, along with a positive and professional attitude.
* Ability to read and interpret documents such as leases, operating instructions, and procedure manuals.
* Ability to pass a background check and drug screening while maintaining a record that satisfies these requirements.

=================================

### **Earn $150,000 to $200,000\+ Per Year**

### **Pre\-Qualified Leads \| No Cold Calling \| Unlimited Earning Potential**

**Build a Six\-Figure Career With One of the Fastest\-Growing Bathroom Remodeling Companies**
---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------


Are you a proven sales professional looking for a company that provides the opportunities, support, and leads needed to maximize your income?


Quality Craftsmen is expanding and actively hiring high\-performing sales professionals to meet the growing demand for our premium bathroom remodeling products. We provide a steady flow of pre\-qualified appointments with homeowners who have already expressed interest in our services, allowing you to spend your time doing what you do best: building relationships, presenting solutions, and closing sales.


This is an excellent opportunity for motivated individuals who want to earn six figures while representing a trusted company with a proven sales process, industry\-leading products, and strong marketing support.


If you're driven, competitive, and ready to take control of your earnings, we want to hear from you.

-----------------

* First\-year earning potential of $150,000\+
* Top performers earn $250,000 to $300,000\+ annually
* Uncapped commission structure
* Weekly commission payouts
* Pre\-qualified, company\-generated appointments
* No cold calling, prospecting, canvassing, or door knocking
* High close\-rate sales system
* Industry\-leading products with strong consumer demand
* Comprehensive onboarding and paid training
* Ongoing coaching and professional development
* Flexible schedule
* Career advancement opportunities
* Supportive leadership and dedicated marketing team
* Established brand with an outstanding reputation

**Why Top Sales Professionals Choose Quality Craftsmen**
--------------------------------------------------------


Unlike many sales organizations, we invest heavily in marketing to ensure our sales consultants meet with homeowners who have already requested information about their remodeling projects.


Our sales team is not responsible for generating leads. There are no cold calls, no prospecting requirements, and no door\-to\-door sales. We fill your calendar with qualified appointments so you can focus on presenting solutions, closing sales, and increasing your income.


With our proven sales process, premium products, and ongoing support, you'll have the tools needed to build a rewarding and financially successful career.

**What You'll Do**
------------------

* Meet with homeowners during pre\-scheduled in\-home appointments
* Conduct professional design consultations using our interactive presentation system
* Evaluate customer needs and recommend customized bathroom remodeling solutions
* Educate homeowners on product options, features, financing, and pricing
* Create project proposals and present solutions that meet customers' goals
* Guide customers confidently through the decision\-making process
* Close sales and exceed performance goals
* Maintain accurate records and follow\-up activities
* Deliver a world\-class customer experience throughout the sales process
* Participate in ongoing training and development programs

**What We're Looking For**
--------------------------


Successful candidates are:

* Highly motivated and results\-driven
* Competitive with a strong desire to succeed
* Professional, polished, and confident
* Excellent communicators and relationship builders
* Comfortable presenting in customers' homes
* Self\-disciplined and able to work independently
* Coachable and committed to continuous improvement
* Organized and effective at managing their schedule
* Passionate about helping customers improve their homes

**Preferred Experience**
------------------------


Experience in any of the following industries is highly valued:

* Home Improvement Sales
* Bathroom Remodeling
* Kitchen Remodeling
* Roofing
* HVAC
* Windows and Doors
* Solar Energy
* Flooring
* Construction Sales
* Real Estate
* Automotive Sales
* Insurance Sales
* High\-Ticket Retail Sales
* In\-Home Sales


Previous in\-home sales experience is preferred but not required. Candidates with a proven track record of success in commission\-based sales environments are encouraged to apply.

**About Quality Craftsmen**
---------------------------


Quality Craftsmen is a recognized leader in bathroom remodeling, delivering exceptional products, professional installations, and outstanding customer service. As our company continues to grow, we remain committed to investing in our people through training, technology, marketing, and career development opportunities.


We believe top performers deserve to be rewarded for their results. That's why we provide the resources, support, and earning potential necessary to build a long\-term, six\-figure career.

**Apply Today**
---------------


If you're looking for a sales opportunity where your earnings are driven by your performance, not limited by a salary cap, this is the role for you.


Join Quality Craftsmen and build a career with unlimited income potential, pre\-qualified leads, and a company committed to your success.

new_jobs.description:

Purpose at Ashley  


The Local Customer Success (LCS) Lead is a frontline operational leader who guides agents in their daily work, answers process and approval questions, and supports consistent execution across LCS day\-of\-delivery activities. The role provides real\-time support for VIP deliveries, same\-day and next\-day saves, store support, proactive communication, customer and driver chats, case work, and escalations. The LCS Lead coaches’ agents using approved SOPs, verifies documentation and follow\-up, coordinate with RFC, store, delivery, Road Support, and Customer Success partners, and elevates blocked or high\-risk issues to the Supervisor. Success requires sound judgment, strong customer recovery skills, operational urgency, and disciplined ownership of customer\-impacting work.  


What You’ll Do  


This section describes the primary /essential responsibilities that this job performs.  
Professionally engage with customers in escalated situations, troubleshooting and resolving complex issues including defective products, incorrect shipments, and customer concerns.  
Collaborate cross\-functionally with Regional Managers, store personnel, warehouse staff, and other stakeholders to achieve timely and effective resolutions  
Maintain clear, accurate documentation of all customer interactions to ensure seamless handoffs between representatives. Follow path\-to\-resolution guidelines to gather complete information and determine effective solutions. Conduct follow\-up to verify resolution and customer satisfaction  
Coach and support Customer Experience Representatives through escalated issues, providing training via team meetings, small groups, and one\-on\-one sessions to develop skills and empower decision\-making

Partner with third\-party vendors (protection plans, tech support, delivery companies) to ensure adherence to Ashley's standards and exceptional customer service  
Partner with departmental managers to identify improvements, implement solutions, and coordinate integrated customer service activities  
Demonstrate the Company’s Core and Growth Values in the performance of all job functions.  
Maintain reliable attendance.  
Actively participate in departmental meetings, training and education. Assist with training other employees and providing backup.  
Complete other assignments and special projects as requested.  


What You Bring  


Legally authorized to work in the US  
At least 18 years old  
1\-2 years' experience in fast\-paced environments, bilingual preferred  
Strong attention to detail  
Excellent verbal and written communication skills  
Excellent interpersonal skills  
Effective time management and organizational skills  
Work independently as well as in a team environment  
Document management system  
Analytical and problem\-solving skills  
Maintain confidentiality  
Working knowledge of Continuous Improvement  
Handle multiple projects simultaneously within established time constraints  
Proficient computer skills, including experience with Microsoft Office Suite, and internet  
Perform under strong demands in a fast\-paced environment  
Work professionally with customers and co\-workers to efficiently serve our customers, treating both with enthusiasm and respect  
Display empathy, understanding and patience with employees and external customers  
Respond professionally in situations with difficult employee/vendor/customer issues or inquiries  


What’s In It for You  


When you join us, you are eligible to participate in our comprehensive benefits programs, which include:  


Extended health, dental benefits, and vision insurance  
Employee Discount from 10% \- 30%  
Life/Disability Insurance  
Flex Spending Account  
401K  
Paid Time Off  


Ashley values its diversity and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All employment decisions are made on the basis of an individual’s skills, qualifications, merit, and business needs.  


To learn more about Ashley Furniture, our community engagement programs, environmental stewardship, and our core values, please visit our Corporate Social Responsibility information page: Corporate Social Responsibility

* Managing delinquency and leading collection efforts with clear, consistent communication

We’re collaborative, accountable, and committed to excellence in everything we do. There’s a shared pride in our work and a shared understanding that the details matter.
